papers.title: Stress-Testing the Robustness of LLM-Based Causal Inference
papers.abstract: Why do some of the world's most powerful Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems still struggle to reason about cause and effect? Causal discovery, the ability to discern the underlying drivers of a system, is fundamental to scientific inquiry and has traditionally relied on structured data and statistical methods. Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have been explored as an alternative paradigm for causal inference, leveraging their broad knowledge and reasoning capabilities. Yet, despite their linguistic fluency, LLMs often rely on surface-level pattern recognition rather than genuine causal logic. While it is known that LLMs stumble in this domain, we lack a precise map of where, why, and how significantly these failures occur. In this paper, we propose a systematic stress-test framework across six critical dimensions: model scale, causal graph complexity, prompting strategy, metadata quality, data quality, and sensitivity to uncertainty. Our findings reveal a significant "optimism bias" in LLMs; models consistently overestimate causal links, leading to low precision across the board. Furthermore, we demonstrate that traditional evaluation metrics can be deceptive: while reasoning-heavy models lead in performance, the highest scores often occur when uncertainty in inference is overlooked. Once uncertainty is integrated into the evaluation, performance drops, providing a more honest reflection of causal reliability. We also find that, while scaling model size improves outcomes, these gains are fragile; performance degrades sharply as the quality of metadata decreases. This work serves as a practical guide to the blind spots of LLMs, offering a clear-eyed assessment of when these tools can be integrated into a causal discovery pipeline and when they are likely to lead researchers astray.

translation.title: 压力测试：基于LLM的因果推断的鲁棒性
translation.abstract: 为什么一些世界上最强大的人工智能（AI）系统仍然难以进行因果推理？因果发现，即辨别系统底层驱动因素的能力，是科学探究的基础，传统上依赖于结构化数据和统计方法。近年来，大语言模型（LLM）凭借其广泛的知识和推理能力，被探索作为因果推断的替代范式。然而，尽管LLM语言流畅，它们往往依赖表面模式识别而非真正的因果逻辑。虽然已知LLM在这一领域会出错，但我们缺乏对这些失败发生在何处、为何发生以及严重程度的精确刻画。本文提出了一个跨六个关键维度的系统性压力测试框架：模型规模、因果图复杂度、提示策略、元数据质量、数据质量以及对不确定性的敏感性。我们的发现揭示了LLM中显著的"乐观偏差"：模型持续高估因果联系，导致整体精确率偏低。此外，我们证明传统评估指标可能具有欺骗性：虽然重推理模型表现领先，但最高分往往出现在忽略推理不确定性的情况下。一旦将不确定性纳入评估，性能便会下降，从而更真实地反映因果可靠性。我们还发现，虽然扩大模型规模能改善结果，但这些收益是脆弱的；随着元数据质量下降，性能急剧退化。这项工作可作为LLM盲区的实用指南，清晰评估何时可将这些工具集成到因果发现流水线中，何时它们可能误导研究者。
translation.brief: 针对LLM因果推断能力缺乏系统性刻画的问题，提出一个覆盖模型规模、因果图复杂度、提示策略、元数据质量、数据质量和不确定性敏感性六个维度的压力测试框架。

papers.title: MCPGuard: Finding Conformance Gaps in MCP SDKs via Dual-Track Analysis and Dynamic Adjudication
papers.abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) connects large language model agents to external tools and services through official SDKs that implement message validation and session logic. Specification constraints omitted by these SDKs may propagate to downstream applications, highlighting the importance of SDK-level conformance testing. Yet existing MCP conformance tools mainly exercise running endpoints and reveal little about whether SDK models enforce specification requirements. We present MCPGuard, an automated LLM-based framework for detecting specification-to-SDK conformance gaps. Its structural track aligns JSON Schema constraints with normalized SDK models and produces constraint-specific evidence. Its behavioral track extracts normative prose rules, retrieves bounded function-level slices, and audits them with LLMs for candidate omissions. An evidence-aware dynamic adjudicator then inspects complete source context and builds PoCs to validate candidates. A shared kernel with language-specific adapters enables analysis across SDKs. On the official Python 1.26.0 and TypeScript 1.29.0 SDKs, MCPGuard confirms 13 and 19 findings, respectively, none of which are exposed by two black-box baselines. Tests on open MCP servers further show that these gaps can systematically propagate downstream. By making SDK conformance of specification constraints directly testable, MCPGuard complements conventional endpoint-oriented conformance suites.

translation.title: MCPGuard：通过双轨分析与动态裁决发现MCP SDK中的一致性缺口
translation.abstract: Model Context Protocol（MCP）通过实现消息验证与会话逻辑的官方SDK将大语言模型智能体连接到外部工具和服务。这些SDK遗漏的规范约束可能传播到下游应用，凸显了SDK级一致性测试的重要性。然而现有MCP一致性工具主要针对运行中的端点，很少揭示SDK实现是否强制执行规范要求。我们提出MCPGuard，一个用于检测规范到SDK一致性缺口的自动化LLM框架。其结构轨道将JSON Schema约束与规范化SDK模型对齐，并生成针对特定约束的证据。其行为轨道提取规范性散文规则，检索有界的函数级切片，并用LLM审计以发现候选遗漏。随后，证据感知的动态裁决器检查完整源码上下文并构建PoC来验证候选发现。共享内核配合语言特定适配器实现了跨SDK分析。在官方Python 1.26.0和TypeScript 1.29.0 SDK上，MCPGuard分别确认了13和19个发现，其中没有任何一个被两个黑盒基线暴露。对开放MCP服务器的测试进一步表明这些缺口会系统性地向下游传播。通过使SDK对规范约束的一致性可直接测试，MCPGuard补充了传统的面向端点的一致性测试套件。
translation.brief: 针对MCP官方SDK可能遗漏规范约束的问题，提出结合结构对齐与行为审计的双轨LLM分析框架，并用动态裁决和PoC验证来发现SDK与规范之间的一致性缺口。

papers.title: ReVi: Recursive Recap Video Generation
papers.abstract: Novels tell rich stories, but their textual form cannot directly present the sights and sounds of the worlds they describe. Film adaptations offer an audiovisual experience but require substantial production effort and viewing time; film recaps are shorter but depend on existing footage. Neither route directly provides a concise audiovisual account of a novel. We therefore study novel-to-recap video generation: producing a self-contained, source-grounded audiovisual retelling directly from a novel within a fixed viewing-time budget. This task requires compressing the story while preserving causal connections, allocating sufficient time to retained events, and aligning narration with newly generated visuals. We propose ReVi, a dual-loop multi-agent framework guided by edit first, generate second. Its Inner Loop plans story content, narration time, and corresponding shots before video generation. Across novels, its Outer Loop performs recursive self-improvement by revising both the editing policy and the meta policy that governs its revision. Experiments on two evaluation sets show that ReVi improves recap quality and duration compliance over representative baselines, with human ratings and multi-round improvement results providing further support.

translation.title: ReVi：递归回顾视频生成
translation.abstract: 小说讲述丰富的故事，但其文本形式无法直接呈现所描述世界的声画景象。电影改编提供视听体验，但需要大量制作投入和观看时间；电影回顾更短，却依赖已有影像素材。两条路径都无法直接提供小说的简明视听概述。因此我们研究小说到回顾视频生成：在固定观看时间预算内，直接从小说生成自包含、忠于原著的视听复述。该任务需要在压缩故事的同时保留因果联系，为保留事件分配足够时间，并将旁白与新生成的画面对齐。我们提出ReVi，一个遵循"先剪辑、后生成"的双循环多智能体框架。其内循环在视频生成前规划故事内容、旁白时长及对应镜头。跨小说层面，其外循环通过同时修订剪辑策略和管控修订过程的元策略，实现递归自我改进。在两个评估集上的实验表明，ReVi在回顾质量和时长合规性上优于代表性基线，人类评分和多轮改进结果提供了进一步支持。
translation.brief: 针对从小说直接生成简明视听回顾视频的问题，提出"先剪辑、后生成"的双循环多智能体框架ReVi，通过内外循环递归自我改进来规划故事内容、时长与镜头。

papers.title: Functional-Group Knowledge Is Structured in Language Models Before It Is Spoken
papers.abstract: Language models serve as the reasoning core of agents for chemistry and materials science, where they must interpret molecular structure before planning syntheses or proposing materials. Yet their outputs show only what they say, not what they know. Given a prompt such as ``The primary functional group in 1-Fluorobutane (CCCCF) is'', a small general-purpose model may answer ``the alkyne group'' instead of an alkyl fluoride. The output alone cannot tell whether the model failed to recognize the fluorine or recognized it and failed to say so. We address this by reading the internal representations of five open-source models on prompts covering 92 molecules and 20 functional groups. Even without chemistry training, the models organize functional groups by chemical family, and they encode chemical differences as consistent directions. The shift from thioether ($\mathrm{R{-}S{-}R'}$) to thiol ($\mathrm{R{-}SH}$), added to ether ($\mathrm{R{-}O{-}R'}$), lands nearest alcohol ($\mathrm{R{-}OH}$). This structure emerges abruptly in the middle layers, where representations shift from tracking the wording of the prompt to tracking the functional group. The base model names the correct functional group in only 58.5\% of prompts, the lowest of the five, yet it encodes functional-group families and preserves chemically meaningful patterns. Its errors are mostly failures to answer rather than wrong answers. Functional-group knowledge is structured in the model before it is spoken. Chemistry fine-tuning reorganizes it, making functional groups rather than prompt wording dominate the representation. These results suggest that evaluating chemical language models through outputs alone can underestimate the chemical information they encode. Representation analysis can distinguish a lack of knowledge from a failure to express it, which matters when choosing or adapting models for chemical agents.

translation.title: 官能团知识在语言模型中被说出之前已被结构化
translation.abstract: 语言模型是化学与材料科学智能体的推理核心，它们必须在规划合成或提出材料之前解读分子结构。然而其输出只显示它们说了什么，而非它们知道什么。给定诸如"1-Fluorobutane（CCCCF）的主要官能团是"这样的提示，一个小型通用模型可能回答"炔基"而非氟代烷基。仅凭输出无法判断模型是未能识别氟原子，还是识别了却未能说出。为此，我们读取五个开源模型在覆盖92个分子和20种官能团的提示上的内部表示。即使未经化学训练，模型也按化学族组织官能团，并将化学差异编码为一致的方向。从硫醚（R-S-R'）到硫醇（R-SH）的偏移，加上醚（R-O-R'），落在最接近醇（R-OH）的位置。这种结构在中间层突然涌现，此时表示从追踪提示措辞转向追踪官能团。基座模型仅在58.5%的提示中说出正确官能团，为五者中最低，但它编码了官能团族并保留了化学上有意义的模式。其错误多为未能作答而非答错。官能团知识在模型中被说出之前已被结构化。化学微调会重组这种结构，使官能团而非提示措辞主导表示。这些结果表明，仅通过输出评估化学语言模型可能低估其编码的化学信息。表示分析可以区分知识缺失与表达失败，这在为化学智能体选择或适配模型时非常重要。
translation.brief: 针对语言模型输出无法反映其化学知识真实水平的问题，通过分析内部表示研究官能团知识在模型中的结构化编码，区分知识缺失与表达失败。

papers.title: LOLPlay: Benchmarking Real-Time Visual Agents in League of Legends
papers.abstract: Visual agents need to coordinate reasoning and action while their environment evolves during inference. We introduce LOLPlay, a benchmark in native \emph{League of Legends} with 36 champion-specific tasks spanning resource management, combat, cooperation, and objectives. Agents interact through screenshots and mouse--keyboard actions; automated initialization and 82 executable subgoal checks distinguish partial progress from completion. Across 324 task evaluations of three models at three reasoning-effort settings, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest task success rate of 25.0\% at low and medium effort, and the highest subgoal success rate of 40.3\% at medium effort. However, high effort improves neither metric over low effort for any model. For Astra, longer requests leave fewer interaction rounds, suggesting a cost to additional reasoning in real-time control. Trajectories reveal incomplete subgoal composition and actions executing after the observed scene changes, motivating agents that combine visual reasoning with timely action.

translation.title: LOLPlay：在《英雄联盟》中基准测试实时视觉智能体
translation.abstract: 视觉智能体需要在环境于推理过程中持续演化的同时协调推理与行动。我们提出LOLPlay，一个原生《英雄联盟》基准，包含36个英雄专属任务，涵盖资源管理、战斗、合作与目标。智能体通过截图和鼠标键盘操作进行交互；自动化初始化和82个可执行的子目标检查可区分部分进展与完成。在对三个模型、三种推理努力档位的324次任务评估中，GPT-6 Astra在低、中档位下取得最高的25.0%任务成功率，并在中档位下取得最高的40.3%子目标成功率。然而，高档位相对低档位未改善任何模型的任何指标。对Astra而言，更长的请求会减少交互轮次，表明在实时控制中额外推理存在代价。轨迹分析揭示了子目标组合不完整以及场景变化后动作仍被执行的问题，这促使我们开发将视觉推理与及时行动相结合的智能体。
translation.brief: 针对实时演化环境中视觉智能体推理与行动协调能力缺乏评估的问题，构建了基于《英雄联盟》的LOLPlay基准，含36个英雄任务和82个可执行子目标检查。

papers.title: Training LLM Agents to Automate LLM Post-Training with RSI-Dojo
papers.abstract: Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) aims to enable AI systems to autonomously build and improve AI systems themselves, including models, harnesses, and underlying infrastructure. Within this broader agenda, a central capability is enabling agents to train and improve base models. However, existing studies on automated model training primarily focused on workflow- or harness-level optimizations, rather than internalizing the ability to conduct post-training into the model itself. Developing this capability requires executable model training environments that can produce high-quality trajectories demonstrating how to select data, train models, diagnose failures, and iteratively improve results. In this paper, we introduce RSI-Dojo, a collection of executable model training environments designed to teach LLM agents to conduct post-training. To construct RSI-Dojo, we develop RSI-Craft, an automatic pipeline that converts human research artifacts into executable model training environments. RSI-Craft automatically collects research papers from top venues, instantiates datasets and metrics into a unified interface, and reproduces evaluation dependencies. It then filters tasks by data size, execution reliability, and discriminability, yielding RSI-Dojo with 281 seed model training tasks. Building on RSI-Dojo, we employ a trajectory collection method with an improved harness to collect high-quality model-training trajectories from frontier models, then retain examples through rubric-based and outcome-based filtering. We fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on these trajectories. The resulting RSI-Dojo-9B and RSI-Dojo-35B-A3B improve over their base models by 8.74 and 16.87 PostTrainBench points, respectively. RSI-Dojo-35B-A3B reaches 29.95 on PostTrainBench and 53.29 on PostTrainBench-Lite, matching the performance of frontier models such as GLM-5.2 and GPT 5.5.

translation.title: 基于 RSI-Dojo 训练 LLM 智能体以自动化 LLM 后训练
translation.abstract: 递归自我改进（RSI）旨在使 AI 系统能够自主构建和改进 AI 系统本身，包括模型、harness 和底层基础设施。在这一更宏大的议程中，一项核心能力是让智能体能够训练和改进基础模型。然而，现有的自动化模型训练研究主要集中于工作流或 harness 层面的优化，而非将执行后训练的能力内化到模型本身。发展这种能力需要可执行的模型训练环境，能够产生高质量轨迹，展示如何选择数据、训练模型、诊断失败并迭代改进结果。本文提出 RSI-Dojo，一组可执行的模型训练环境，旨在教会 LLM 智能体执行后训练。为构建 RSI-Dojo，我们开发了 RSI-Craft，一个将人类研究成果转化为可执行模型训练环境的自动化流水线。RSI-Craft 自动从顶级会议收集研究论文，将数据集和指标实例化为统一接口，并复现评估依赖。随后按数据规模、执行可靠性和区分度过滤任务，最终得到包含 281 个种子模型训练任务的 RSI-Dojo。基于 RSI-Dojo，我们采用改进 harness 的轨迹收集方法，从前沿模型收集高质量模型训练轨迹，然后通过基于评分标准和基于结果的过滤保留样本。我们在这些轨迹上微调 Qwen3.5-9B 和 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B。得到的 RSI-Dojo-9B 和 RSI-Dojo-35B-A3B 分别比其基础模型提升 8.74 和 16.87 个 PostTrainBench 点。RSI-Dojo-35B-A3B 在 PostTrainBench 上达到 29.95，在 PostTrainBench-Lite 上达到 53.29，与 GLM-5.2 和 GPT 5.5 等前沿模型的表现相当。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 智能体缺乏内化后训练能力的问题，通过 RSI-Craft 流水线构建可执行模型训练环境 RSI-Dojo，并用其高质量轨迹微调模型。

papers.title: A Compact Formula-Aware Spreadsheet Abstraction for Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to assist spreadsheet users with tasks such as spreadsheet model construction, formula generation, and data analysis, yet their interaction with real-world spreadsheets remains limited by the mismatch between the structure of spreadsheets and the sequential textual representations typically provided to LLMs. We propose a compact formula-aware spreadsheet abstraction that represents large homogeneous ranges through their positions, types, R1C1 formula patterns, and selected boundary values. An efficient algorithm detects and structures these ranges before a textual serialization is supplied to an LLM. The abstraction is provided to the LLM before detailed spreadsheet content is submitted, improving the accuracy and efficiency of spreadsheet processing while reducing token consumption. We evaluate the method on 50 spreadsheet-query cases. The evaluation shows that the abstraction alone was sufficient to answer some queries. When additional spreadsheet content is required, the abstraction reduces the amount of data that must be submitted to the LLM, thereby reducing token consumption. The abstraction layer also improves the reliability and accuracy of spreadsheet processing. We conclude by discussing further techniques for combining spreadsheet static analysis with artificial intelligence to improve the reliability, accuracy, and efficiency of AI assisted spreadsheet tasks.

translation.title: 一种面向大语言模型的紧凑公式感知电子表格抽象
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于协助电子表格用户完成电子表格模型构建、公式生成和数据分析等任务，但它们与真实电子表格的交互仍受限于电子表格结构与通常提供给 LLM 的顺序文本表示之间的不匹配。我们提出一种紧凑的公式感知电子表格抽象，通过位置、类型、R1C1 公式模式和选定的边界值来表示大型同质区域。在将文本序列化提供给 LLM 之前，一个高效算法会检测并结构化这些区域。该抽象在提交详细电子表格内容之前提供给 LLM，提高了电子表格处理的准确性和效率，同时降低了 token 消耗。我们在 50 个电子表格查询案例上评估该方法。评估表明，仅凭该抽象就足以回答部分查询。当需要额外的电子表格内容时，该抽象减少了必须提交给 LLM 的数据量，从而降低 token 消耗。该抽象层还提高了电子表格处理的可靠性和准确性。最后我们讨论了将电子表格静态分析与人工智能结合以提升 AI 辅助电子表格任务的可靠性、准确性和效率的进一步技术。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 与电子表格结构不匹配导致效率低的问题，提出用位置、类型和 R1C1 公式模式表示同质区域的紧凑抽象以减少 token 消耗并提升准确性。

papers.title: Unsatz: Evaluating Scientific Discovery Without a Given Ansatz
papers.abstract: Before a scientist fits any parameter, they must decide what the model contains: which quantities exist, which are hidden, how they interact, and how they are measured. Physicists call such a trial form an ansatz. Benchmarks for automated equation discovery mostly supply it, by fixing the variables, a library of candidate terms, or a law to be modified. We introduce Unsatz, a benchmark in which an LLM agent must construct the ansatz itself. Each task is a simulated system, generated from a private seed as a program in a small modeling language: ordinary, delay, or partial differential equations, discrete maps, static and causal models, or stochastic processes, possibly with hidden states, distorted sensors, and uninformative measurement channels. The agent buys experiments within a budget, writes candidate programs in the same language, obtains their coefficients from the benchmark's fitter, and is scored only on how its final program predicts experiments it never saw: conditions outside the range it could explore, interventions, and longer runs. Across 80 systems in 20 domains, nine language models solve between 21% and 60%. On 44 of these systems, classical equation-discovery methods almost never succeed, although the same data usually suffice once the true equations are given with unknown coefficients; the difficulty lies in finding the structure, not in estimating it. Because mechanisms recur across systems, we also give agents the program they discovered for a related system; it helped only when the new system shared the mechanism and the first investigation had succeeded. Stronger agents make fewer unscientific errors; beyond these, agents find which variables a system has but not how they act, and prefer revisions that lower the training error to revisions that predict better.

translation.title: Unsatz：在没有给定 Ansatz 的情况下评估科学发现
translation.abstract: 在科学家拟合任何参数之前，他们必须决定模型包含什么：哪些量存在、哪些是隐藏的、它们如何相互作用以及如何被测量。物理学家将这种试探形式称为 ansatz。现有的自动化方程发现基准大多直接提供 ansatz，即固定变量、候选项库或待修改的定律。我们提出 Unsatz，一个要求 LLM 智能体自行构建 ansatz 的基准。每个任务都是一个模拟系统，由私有种子以小型建模语言生成的程序构成：常微分、时滞或偏微分方程、离散映射、静态和因果模型，或随机过程，可能带有隐藏状态、失真的传感器和无信息量的测量通道。智能体在预算内购买实验，用同一语言编写候选程序，从基准的拟合器获取系数，并且仅根据其最终程序对从未见过的实验的预测来评分：超出其可探索范围的条件、干预以及更长的运行。在 20 个领域的 80 个系统上，九个语言模型的解决率在 21% 到 60% 之间。在其中 44 个系统上，经典方程发现方法几乎从不成功，尽管在给定未知系数的真实方程时同样的数据通常已足够；难点在于找到结构，而非估计结构。由于机制会在系统间重复出现，我们还向智能体提供其为相关系统发现的程序；只有当新系统共享该机制且首次研究成功时才有帮助。更强的智能体犯的非科学性错误更少；除此之外，智能体能找出系统有哪些变量，却不能找出它们如何起作用，并且倾向于选择降低训练误差的修改而非预测更好的修改。
translation.brief: 解决现有方程发现基准都给定 ansatz 而无法评估真正科学发现的问题，构建要求 LLM 智能体自行构建模型结构的 Unsatz 基准。

papers.title: Counterexample-driven autonomous research with application to excess radiated energy in a Z-pinch
papers.abstract: Recent breakthroughs in artificial-intelligence-assisted mathematics show that open-ended machine search can outperform human mathematicians, yet transferring this paradigm to physics requires refactoring the research workflow. We introduce Simjecture, an open-source framework in which language-model agents pursue human-defined physical conjectures. The framework tackles two central challenges in this transfer: first, because physics is empirical and no model is final, it structures inquiry around counterexample-driven falsification and prospective hypothesis repair; second, because physical theories must interact with the real world, it uses computational physics as an executable testbed while separating the qualification of numerical instruments from scientific claim review so solvers and diagnostics can be adapted within a recorded investigation. We apply the framework in an 82.6 h investigation to tackle the long-standing problem of radiated energy exceeding the imploding-shell kinetic energy in a Z-pinch. The investigation reveals competing effects of energy conversion, retention, and release timing. Stronger coherent helical deformation increases resistive conversion while reducing radiation and increasing retained energy. A broader trailing-plasma profile delays the later radiation maximum and recovers much of its early bolometric deficit, with a spectral response that changes during the pulse. These results provide new insight into energy conversion in high-energy-density plasma physics and demonstrate a new paradigm for physics research.

translation.title: 反例驱动的自主研究及其在 Z-pinch 辐射能量过剩问题中的应用
translation.abstract: 人工智能辅助数学领域的最新突破表明，开放式机器搜索可以超越人类数学家，但将这一范式转移到物理学需要重构研究工作流。我们提出 Simjecture，一个开源框架，其中语言模型智能体致力于人类定义的物理猜想。该框架应对这一转移中的两大核心挑战：第一，由于物理学是经验性的且没有最终模型，它围绕反例驱动的证伪和前瞻性假设修复来组织探究；第二，由于物理理论必须与现实世界交互，它将计算物理作为可执行的试验台，同时将数值工具的资质认定与科学主张审查分离，使求解器和诊断工具可以在有记录的探究过程中进行调整。我们将该框架应用于一次 82.6 小时的探究，以解决 Z-pinch 中辐射能量超过内爆壳层动能这一长期存在的问题。该探究揭示了能量转换、保留和释放时机的竞争效应。更强的相干螺旋变形增加电阻性转换，同时减少辐射并增加保留能量。更宽的尾部等离子体分布延迟了后期辐射最大值，并弥补了其早期辐射测量的不足，其光谱响应在脉冲期间发生变化。这些结果为高能量密度等离子体物理中的能量转换提供了新见解，并展示了物理学研究的新范式。
translation.brief: 解决将开放式机器搜索范式转移到物理研究的问题，提出以反例驱动证伪和假设修复为核心的 Simjecture 框架，并应用于 Z-pinch 辐射能量过剩问题。

papers.title: EMBERS: Empirically Motivated Robustness Testing of Deep Research Systems via Defect-Guided Fuzzing
papers.abstract: Deep Research (DR) systems extend large language models into autonomous agents that decompose complex information needs, iteratively search the web, and synthesize evidence to answer challenging questions. However, their multi-stage execution may introduce robustness risks, as variations in user questions or intermediate search inputs may propagate across research stages and lead to incorrect answers. Existing evaluations focus on task-solving capabilities or robustness against external evidence disturbances, leaving intrinsic weaknesses in DR execution insufficiently explored. Thus, we conduct an empirical study of 1,932 execution trajectories from three representative DR systems and identify nine recurring defect categories across subquestion formulation, online search, and final reasoning. Guided by these findings, we propose EMBERS, an empirically motivated, defect-guided fuzzing framework for robustness testing of DR systems. Starting from correctly answered seed questions, EMBERS generates stage-targeted test inputs using defect-guided mutation, web-search-assisted fidelity assurance, and diversity-aware seed maintenance. Experiments across 16 framework--model--dataset settings show that EMBERS achieves 3.21 times the failure-discovery throughput of the strongest baseline under identical testing budgets. Human and LLM-assisted evaluations demonstrate that most generated inputs preserve the original information need and necessary contextual constraints. Moreover, model fine-tuning experiments show consistent-answer performance improvement, highlighting their value for robustness testing and model improvement.

translation.title: EMBERS：基于缺陷引导模糊测试的深度研究系统经验驱动鲁棒性测试
translation.abstract: 深度研究（DR）系统将大语言模型扩展为自主智能体，能够分解复杂信息需求、迭代搜索网络并综合证据以回答有挑战性的问题。然而，其多阶段执行可能引入鲁棒性风险，因为用户问题或中间搜索输入的变化可能在研究阶段间传播并导致错误答案。现有评估聚焦于任务解决能力或对外部证据扰动的鲁棒性，对 DR 执行中的内在弱点探索不足。因此，我们对来自三个代表性 DR 系统的 1,932 条执行轨迹进行了实证研究，识别出子问题表述、在线搜索和最终推理中的九类反复出现的缺陷。基于这些发现，我们提出 EMBERS，一个经验驱动、缺陷引导的 DR 系统鲁棒性测试模糊测试框架。从正确回答的种子问题出发，EMBERS 使用缺陷引导变异、网络搜索辅助的保真度保证和多样性感知的种子维护来生成面向特定阶段的测试输入。在 16 种框架—模型—数据集设置上的实验表明，在相同测试预算下，EMBERS 的失败发现吞吐量达到最强基线的 3.21 倍。人工和 LLM 辅助评估表明，大多数生成的输入保留了原始信息需求和必要的上下文约束。此外，模型微调实验显示一致回答性能有所提升，凸显了其在鲁棒性测试和模型改进方面的价值。
translation.brief: 解决深度研究系统多阶段执行内在鲁棒性弱点未被充分测试的问题，通过实证分析提炼九类缺陷并构建缺陷引导的模糊测试框架 EMBERS 生成阶段针对性测试输入。

papers.title: From Logs to Faults: Reference-Free Fault Localization for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Pipelines
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines are widely used for domain-specific question answering, yet locating faults remains manual and time-consuming. Fault localization is challenging because RAG pipelines consist of interdependent stages, where faults can propagate downstream, masking their origin, or remain undetected even when the final answer is correct. Existing evaluation approaches often focus on individual stages and rely on reference answers or code instrumentation. We present RAGLog, which detects and localizes faults across RAG stages using execution logs, without requiring reference answers or code instrumentation. RAGLog transforms heterogeneous API logs into a common RAG schema and combines rule-based, embedding-based, and LLM-based checks to identify faulty stages. We introduce a live fault injector and RAGLog Faults, a dataset of 3,134 runs from five RAG pipelines with stage-level fault labels. With Claude Haiku 5.5, RAGLog achieves a pooled F1 score of 0.73 on runs with naturally occurring faults, outperforming Claude Code (0.58) and Codex (0.52), and comparable effectiveness on runs with injected faults (0.84 versus 0.80 and 0.82, respectively). It analyzes runs in approximately five seconds at US\$0.005 each, with overall lower cost and latency than agent baselines. RAGLog is available as an open-source tool for debugging, evaluating, and monitoring RAG pipelines.

translation.title: 从日志到故障：面向检索增强生成流水线的无参考故障定位
translation.abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）流水线被广泛用于领域特定问答，但故障定位仍然依赖人工且耗时。故障定位之所以困难，是因为RAG流水线由相互依赖的阶段组成，故障可能向下游传播从而掩盖其来源，或者即使最终答案正确也未被察觉。现有评估方法往往只关注单个阶段，并依赖参考答案或代码插桩。我们提出RAGLog，它利用执行日志在RAG各阶段检测和定位故障，无需参考答案或代码插桩。RAGLog将异构的API日志转换为统一的RAG模式（schema），并结合基于规则、基于嵌入和基于LLM的检查来识别故障阶段。我们引入了一个实时故障注入器以及RAGLog Faults数据集，该数据集包含来自五个RAG流水线的3,134次运行，并带有阶段级故障标签。使用Claude Haiku 5.5，RAGLog在自然发生故障的运行上取得0.73的合并F1分数，优于Claude Code（0.58）和Codex（0.52），在注入故障的运行上也取得了相当的效果（0.84，对比0.80和0.82）。它分析一次运行约需五秒，成本为0.005美元，总体成本和延迟均低于智能体基线。RAGLog已作为开源工具发布，可用于调试、评估和监控RAG流水线。
translation.brief: 解决RAG流水线中故障定位依赖人工和参考答案的问题，核心方法是将异构执行日志转换为统一模式并结合规则、嵌入与LLM检查来定位故障阶段。

papers.title: EvoMemState: Evolving Memory State for Personal Agents
papers.abstract: Long-term memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to provide continuous personalized assistance by retaining user information across interactions. Existing systems support this process through fact extraction, organization, updating, and retrieval, but largely maintain memories as independent facts. This fact-centric paradigm may overlook how new facts update, constrain, or conflict with earlier ones, while leaving their applicability, role, and priority for the current request implicit. In this paper, we introduce EvoMemState, a state-centric framework that augments persistent facts with two complementary states: Relational States that capture how facts remain valid and relate to one another as memory evolves, and a Reasoning State that determines how these facts should be applied to the current request. Specifically, EvoMemState consists of three key components: (i) Ontology-Guided Memory State Induction extracts Persistent Facts and constructs Relational States that maintain their validity, scope, and evolving relations. (ii) RL-Based State Evolution internalizes memory-use experience into a policy through reinforcement learning to generate a request-specific Reasoning State. (iii) State-Aware Reasoning then combines the relevant facts with their Relational States and the generated Reasoning State to guide the personal agent. Extensive experiments on long-term dialogue and memory-use benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing memory systems in retrieval completeness and memory-grounded response accuracy. Our code and implementation details are available at this https URL.

translation.title: EvoMemState：面向个人智能体的演化记忆状态
translation.abstract: 长期记忆使大语言模型（LLM）智能体能够通过在多次交互中保留用户信息来提供持续的个性化帮助。现有系统通过事实抽取、组织、更新和检索来支持这一过程，但大多将记忆维护为独立的事实。这种以事实为中心的范式可能忽略新事实如何更新、约束或与早期事实冲突，同时使其对当前请求的适用性、角色和优先级保持隐式。本文提出EvoMemState，一个以状态为中心的框架，它用两种互补状态来增强持久事实：捕捉事实在记忆演化中如何保持有效并相互关联的关系状态（Relational States），以及决定这些事实应如何应用于当前请求的推理状态（Reasoning State）。具体而言，EvoMemState包含三个关键组件：(i) 本体引导的记忆状态归纳，抽取持久事实并构建维护其有效性、范围和演化关系的关系状态；(ii) 基于强化学习的状态演化，通过强化学习将记忆使用经验内化为策略，以生成针对请求的推理状态；(iii) 状态感知推理，将相关事实与其关系状态及生成的推理状态结合，指导个人智能体。在长期对话和记忆使用基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在检索完整性和基于记忆的回答准确性上持续优于现有记忆系统。代码和实现细节见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 解决现有记忆系统将记忆视为独立事实、忽略事实间关系与适用性的问题，核心方法是用本体引导的关系状态和强化学习生成的推理状态来增强持久事实。

papers.title: The Web Doesn't Sit Still: Adversarial Self-Evolving Attacks on Search Agents
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise for empowering search agents to tackle complex information-seeking tasks. However, since acquiring external information necessitates web search, these agents are highly susceptible to various adversarial attacks (e.g., malicious information injection or stealthy context manipulation). Existing attack strategies inevitably rely on static and human-crafted templates, failing to emulate the dynamic and complex nature of real-world threats. In this paper, we propose an adversarial self-evolution framework that integrates bi-level optimization between the attacker's strategy evolution and the defender's adaptive mitigation, to expose the vulnerabilities of search agents. Specifically, we introduce the Contrastive Rollout Evolutionary Optimization (CREO) method to drive the directional evolution of the attack strategy population via contrastive evolutionary signals. To provide a stable environment for this continuous evolution, we further construct a controlled sandbox and design fine-grained metrics to quantify internal vulnerabilities. Extensive experiments across various multi-hop QA benchmarks and frontier LLMs demonstrate that the proposed framework yields attack efficacy superior to static baselines, underscoring the urgent need to develop more robust defense frameworks.

translation.title: 网络并非静止不变：针对搜索智能体的对抗性自演化攻击
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在赋能搜索智能体处理复杂信息检索任务方面展现出潜力。然而，由于获取外部信息必须进行网络搜索，这些智能体极易受到各种对抗攻击（如恶意信息注入或隐蔽的上下文操纵）。现有攻击策略不可避免地依赖静态的人工设计模板，无法模拟真实世界威胁的动态性和复杂性。本文提出一个对抗性自演化框架，通过在攻击者策略演化与防御者自适应缓解之间进行双层优化，来暴露搜索智能体的漏洞。具体而言，我们引入对比 rollout 进化优化（CREO）方法，利用对比进化信号驱动攻击策略种群的方向性演化。为这一持续演化提供稳定环境，我们进一步构建了受控沙箱，并设计了细粒度指标来量化内部漏洞。在多个多跳问答基准和前沿LLM上的大量实验表明，所提框架的攻击效果优于静态基线，凸显了开发更鲁棒防御框架的迫切需求。
translation.brief: 解决现有攻击模板静态、无法模拟真实动态威胁的问题，核心方法是通过攻击者与防御者之间的双层优化和对比进化优化（CREO）实现攻击策略的自演化。

papers.title: Quantifying out-of-distribution data severity with Wasserstein distances: benchmarking large language models for alloy property prediction
papers.abstract: As general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs), such as Gemini and DeepSeek, exhibit increasingly advanced reasoning capabilities, a critical question arises: how do their property prediction abilities compare to those of domain-specific pretrained materials models? In this study, we evaluate predictions for Ti, steels, high-entropy alloy (HEA) and Al, demonstrating that general-purpose LLMs surprisingly outperform SteelBERT, MatSciBERT, and SciBERT. To further enhance performance, we introduce a hybrid approach that utilizes numerical priors from a prior model, such as CatBoost or SteelBERT, to guide the general LLMs (Deepseek V3.1, Gemini-2.5-Flash). By inputting these initial estimates from a prior model as prompts, the LLM acts as a reasoning corrector, achieving accuracy superior to the prior model and "unguided mode". Furthermore, we investigate the impact of data strategy using a similarity-based metric, revealing that data quality dominates quantity; using merely 5% of high-similarity reference data of training set as input yields performance similar to the results of using 100% of training set. Additionally, the LLMs demonstrate excellent uncertainty calibration, where self-reported "high" confidence strongly correlates with minimal deviation from ground truth. Our findings suggest that synergizing general-purpose LLMs with prior model numerical baselines and high-quality data curation creates a cost-effective and accurate paradigm for materials discovery, reducing the need for expensive domain-specific pretraining.

translation.title: 用Wasserstein距离量化分布外数据严重程度：面向合金性能预测的大语言模型基准测试
translation.abstract: 随着Gemini和DeepSeek等通用大语言模型（LLM）展现出日益先进的推理能力，一个关键问题随之而来：它们的性能预测能力与领域专用预训练材料模型相比如何？本研究对Ti、钢、高熵合金（HEA）和Al的预测进行评估，结果表明通用LLM出人意料地优于SteelBERT、MatSciBERT和SciBERT。为进一步提升性能，我们引入一种混合方法，利用先验模型（如CatBoost或SteelBERT）的数值先验来引导通用LLM（Deepseek V3.1、Gemini-2.5-Flash）。通过将先验模型的初始估计作为提示输入，LLM充当推理校正器，其准确性优于先验模型和"无引导模式"。此外，我们使用基于相似度的指标研究数据策略的影响，发现数据质量重于数量：仅使用训练集中5%的高相似度参考数据作为输入，即可获得与使用100%训练集相近的性能。此外，LLM展现出优秀的不确定性校准能力，其自报告的"高"置信度与偏离真实值的最小偏差高度相关。我们的发现表明，将通用LLM与先验模型数值基线及高质量数据筛选相结合，为材料发现提供了一种经济高效的准确范式，减少了对昂贵领域专用预训练的需求。
translation.brief: 解决通用LLM与领域专用材料模型在合金性能预测上的对比及性能提升问题，核心方法是用先验模型数值估计作为提示引导LLM进行推理校正，并用Wasserstein距离量化数据分布偏移。

papers.title: Multi-layer Indexer: Overlapping Selection and Attention in DeepSeek Sparse Attention
papers.abstract: Sparse attention cuts the cost of long-context inference by making the attention matrix sparse: each query attends only a subset of the sequence, chosen by a fixed pattern or, in recent production LLMs, learned per query. In DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA), the attention of DeepSeek-V3.2 and the GLM-5 family, every layer is preceded by a lightning indexer that scores the whole cache and keeps the k=2048 highest-scoring tokens for the layer to attend. At long context this indexer scan, not the sparse attention it feeds, is where the decode time goes. But adjacent layers select nearly the same tokens, so a layer can attend the selection of the previous indexer layer instead of its own. This removes the dependency: each indexer then runs concurrently with the attention of its layer. The resulting Multi-layer Indexer (MLI) needs no retraining and no new weights. Its default realization changes no kernel, running inside SGLang's production decode graph; an optional fused decode kernel accelerates it further on DeepSeek-V3.2. MLI composes with IndexCache (the cross-layer reuse GLM-5.2 ships as IndexShare): IndexCache drops the indexer from some layers, and MLI hides the scan on the rest. We serve DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5 under IndexCache's protocol at retentions 1/2 to 1/32 (the fraction of layers that keep an indexer) and contexts 10K to 195K. At equal retention the composition decodes faster than IndexCache: up to 14.5% faster on DeepSeek-V3.2 and 9.8% on GLM-5 at 1/2, and 7.9% and 5.1% at 1/4, largest where IndexCache keeps the most indexers and growing with context. At retention 1/r it is faster still than IndexCache at 1/(2r) while keeping twice the fresh selections: at 128K it reaches 1.32x the unmodified model's decode throughput at 1/4, above IndexCache's 1.28x at 1/8. Its LongBench, RULER and LongBench v2 accuracy stays within a few percentage points of IndexCache's.

translation.title: 多层索引器：DeepSeek稀疏注意力中的选择与注意力重叠
translation.abstract: 稀疏注意力通过使注意力矩阵稀疏化来降低长上下文推理成本：每个查询只关注序列的一个子集，子集由固定模式选择，或在近期的生产级LLM中按查询学习得到。在DeepSeek稀疏注意力（DSA）——即DeepSeek-V3.2和GLM-5系列所采用的注意力机制——中，每一层前都有一个lightning indexer对整个缓存打分，并保留得分最高的k=2048个token供该层关注。在长上下文下，解码时间主要消耗在索引器扫描而非其驱动的稀疏注意力上。但相邻层选择的token几乎相同，因此一层可以直接关注上一层索引器的选择结果，而非自己的。这消除了依赖关系：每个索引器随后可与所在层的注意力并发运行。由此得到的多层索引器（MLI）无需重新训练，也不需要新权重。其默认实现不改变任何内核，运行在SGLang的生产解码图中；一个可选的融合解码内核可在DeepSeek-V3.2上进一步加速。MLI可与IndexCache（GLM-5.2以IndexShare形式发布的跨层复用机制）组合：IndexCache去掉部分层的索引器，MLI则隐藏其余层的扫描。我们在IndexCache的协议下，以1/2到1/32的保留率（保留索引器的层比例）和10K到195K的上下文长度服务DeepSeek-V3.2和GLM-5。在相同保留率下，该组合的解码速度快于IndexCache：在1/2保留率下DeepSeek-V3.2最高快14.5%，GLM-5快9.8%；在1/4保留率下分别为7.9%和5.1%，在IndexCache保留最多索引器时提升最大，且随上下文增长而增大。在保留率1/r下，它比保留率1/(2r)的IndexCache更快，同时保留两倍的新鲜选择：在128K上下文、1/4保留率下达到未修改模型解码吞吐量的1.32倍，高于IndexCache在1/8保留率下的1.28倍。其在LongBench、RULER和LongBench v2上的准确率与IndexCache相差在几个百分点以内。
translation.brief: 解决DSA长上下文解码中索引器扫描成为瓶颈的问题，核心方法是利用相邻层token选择高度重叠的特性，让每层复用上一层索引器的选择结果，使索引器与注意力并发执行。

papers.title: RuntimeTickets: Source-Grounded Security Obligations for Agent Skills
papers.abstract: Third-party Agent Skills extend what an autonomous agent can do, but a malicious Skill can hide data exposure or output manipulation inside a legitimate workflow. Neither reading a Skill's description nor granting it tool permissions tells whether its execution meets the user's security requirements. We introduce RuntimeTickets, a protocol that enforces and audits these requirements while a Skill runs. From released malicious-Skill datasets we derive a risk model and build adversarial-benign Skill pairs. From the task's delivery contract, a language model proposes security obligations for that task. Each obligation cites the Skill lines it answers, and the ticket tightens the host's approvals into fine-grained allowed actions but never loosens them. A runtime gate checks the recipient, object and amount of every outbound send before forwarding it, and trusted monitors record the effects within their observation scope. The ticket links these checks and observations to the approved obligations of each Skill run, and a deterministic decoder turns the ticket's status into governable data flows and verifies each obligation. Neither enforcement nor decoding involves a language model, so text injected by a Skill can change the proposal but never the rule that decides a send. We evaluate RuntimeTickets at the network egress boundary of three unmodified agent frameworks against production Skill scanners and runtime baselines, among them an AgentBound-derived allow-list and SkillGuard. RuntimeTickets eliminated both failure modes of current Skill defenses, overlook (malicious Skills let through) and overkill (benign Skills blocked): its overlook rate was 0.0% and its overkill rate 0.0%, while the scanners erred on both sides. RuntimeTickets ties approved requirements to verifiable execution evidence and offers a common foundation for the safe and auditable deployment of third-party Skills.

translation.title: RuntimeTickets：面向 Agent Skill 的基于源码的安全义务机制
translation.abstract: 第三方 Agent Skill 扩展了自主 Agent 的能力，但恶意 Skill 可能在合法工作流中隐藏数据泄露或输出篡改。无论是阅读 Skill 的描述还是授予其工具权限，都无法判断其执行是否满足用户的安全要求。我们提出 RuntimeTickets，一种在 Skill 运行时强制执行并审计这些要求的协议。我们从已发布的恶意 Skill 数据集中推导出风险模型，并构建对抗-良性 Skill 配对。基于任务的交付契约，语言模型为该任务提出安全义务。每条义务都引用其对应的 Skill 代码行，ticket 将宿主的审批收紧为细粒度的允许操作，但绝不放宽。运行时网关在转发前检查每次外发的接收者、对象和金额，可信监视器在其观察范围内记录效果。ticket 将这些检查和观察与每次 Skill 运行已批准的义务关联，一个确定性解码器将 ticket 状态转化为可治理的数据流并验证每条义务。强制执行和解码均不涉及语言模型，因此 Skill 注入的文本可以改变提议，但永远无法改变决定外发的规则。我们在三个未修改的 Agent 框架的网络出口边界上评估 RuntimeTickets，与生产级 Skill 扫描器和运行时基线（包括源自 AgentBound 的允许列表和 SkillGuard）对比。RuntimeTickets 消除了当前 Skill 防御的两种失败模式——漏放（恶意 Skill 被放行）和误杀（良性 Skill 被拦截）：其漏放率为 0.0%，误杀率为 0.0%，而扫描器在两方面均有错误。RuntimeTickets 将已批准的要求与可验证的执行证据绑定，为第三方 Skill 的安全、可审计部署提供了共同基础。
translation.brief: 针对第三方 Agent Skill 的恶意行为难以在运行时被约束的问题，提出 RuntimeTickets 协议，通过语言模型从任务契约生成引用源码的安全义务，并用非 LLM 的运行时网关和确定性解码器强制执行与审计。

papers.title: What Malware Actually Does: An Empirical Analysis of Post-Infection Behavior Across Malware Families
papers.abstract: Most malware detection research focuses on identifying whether a file is malicious before it executes. Far less attention goes to what happens after infection. This paper presents an empirical analysis of post-infection malware behavior across 37 families, grounded in dynamic sandbox execution using CAPEv2. Behavioral traces are modeled as heterogeneous graphs with five node types and seven typed edge relationships, preserving relational structure that flat feature vectors discard. A voting ensemble trained on graph-derived structural features achieves 94.44% accuracy and MCC of 0.863, outperforming a flat behavioral baseline by 7.4 percentage points in MCC. A multiclass classifier distinguishes 24 malware families, and a per-family behavioral fingerprint analysis characterizes post-infection activity across registry, network, process, and API dimensions. An LLM explanation layer generates analyst-readable reports with MITRE ATT&CK mappings grounded in observed behavioral evidence. The full pipeline is deployed as HeteroScan at this https URL.

translation.title: 恶意软件究竟做了什么：跨恶意软件家族感染后行为的实证分析
translation.abstract: 大多数恶意软件检测研究专注于在文件执行前识别其是否恶意，而对感染后发生的事情关注甚少。本文基于 CAPEv2 动态沙箱执行，对 37 个家族的感染后恶意软件行为进行了实证分析。行为轨迹被建模为包含五种节点类型和七种类型化边关系的异构图，保留了扁平特征向量所丢弃的关系结构。基于图结构特征训练的投票集成模型达到 94.44% 的准确率和 0.863 的 MCC，在 MCC 上比扁平行为基线高出 7.4 个百分点。多分类器可区分 24 个恶意软件家族，逐家族的行为指纹分析刻画了注册表、网络、进程和 API 维度上的感染后活动。LLM 解释层基于观察到的行为证据生成可供分析师阅读的报告，并映射到 MITRE ATT&CK。完整流水线以 HeteroScan 的形式部署在该网址。
translation.brief: 针对恶意软件感染后行为分析不足的问题，基于 CAPEv2 沙箱将行为轨迹建模为异构图并训练集成分类器，实现家族分类与行为指纹刻画，并附 LLM 生成的 MITRE ATT&CK 报告。

papers.title: Rethinking Next-Visit Diagnosis Prediction Beyond Aggregate Metrics: Retrieval--Memory Multi-Agent Adjudication
papers.abstract: Next-visit diagnosis prediction forecasts the diagnoses documented at a patient's next encounter, turning retrospective electronic health records into prospective clinical prediction. However, conventional aggregate evaluation obscures its multifaceted nature: distributionally, models must handle variable-size diagnosis sets and long-tailed labels; temporally, they must distinguish persistent, newly recorded, and recurrent diagnoses; and both vary with observed history depth. We introduce an evaluation framework along these dimensions and apply it to rule-based heuristics, LLM-based prompting, retrieval, memory, and multi-agent approaches. This reveals that repeating the last visit outperforms most LLM-based approaches overall despite predicting no new or recurrent diagnoses, and that retrieval and memory exhibit distinct profiles whose relative strengths vary across temporal transitions and backbones. Motivated by this, we propose LONGINUS, a retrieval-memory multi-agent adjudication framework combining evidence retrieved from patient records with structured memory of the patient trajectory. Using cross-view agreement as a reliability heuristic, it preserves shared predictions and adjudicates disagreements without revealing their source. Across MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV with four LLM backbones, LONGINUS achieves the best transition-specific performance among LLM-based methods in nearly all settings while remaining competitive with them on aggregate metrics.

translation.title: 超越聚合指标的下次就诊诊断预测再思考：检索-记忆多智能体裁决
translation.abstract: 下次就诊诊断预测预测患者下次就诊时记录的诊断，将回顾性电子健康记录转化为前瞻性临床预测。然而，传统的聚合评估掩盖了其多面性：在分布上，模型必须处理大小可变的诊断集合和长尾标签；在时间上，必须区分持续、新记录和复发的诊断；且两者都随观察历史深度变化。我们沿这些维度引入一个评估框架，并将其应用于基于规则的启发式、基于 LLM 的提示、检索、记忆和多智能体方法。这揭示了重复上次就诊在总体上优于大多数基于 LLM 的方法，尽管它不预测任何新发或复发诊断；同时检索和记忆展现出不同的特性，其相对优势随时间转换类型和骨干模型而变化。受此启发，我们提出 LONGINUS，一个检索-记忆多智能体裁决框架，将从患者记录中检索的证据与患者轨迹的结构化记忆相结合。它以跨视图一致性作为可靠性启发式，保留一致的预测，并在不暴露来源的情况下裁决分歧。在 MIMIC-III 和 MIMIC-IV 上使用四种 LLM 骨干，LONGINUS 在几乎所有设置中实现了基于 LLM 方法中最佳的转换特定性能，同时在聚合指标上保持竞争力。
translation.brief: 针对下次就诊诊断预测中聚合评估掩盖分布与时间维度差异的问题，提出多维评估框架及 LONGINUS 检索-记忆多智能体裁决框架，以跨视图一致性裁决分歧预测。

papers.title: El Agente Fármaco: A Scalable AI Scientist for Drug Discovery
papers.abstract: Computational drug discovery offers a growing range of tools for proposing and evaluating molecules, but combining them and deciding what to do next still requires substantial expert effort. Here, we introduce El Agente Fármaco, an AI scientist that uses modern large language model (LLM) technology to turn discovery goals expressed in everyday language into complex, scalable computational screening workflows. The agentic harness selects scientific tools, reviews their results, and adjusts subsequent steps to the target and the user's objectives. Our approach centers on a shared scientific memory: Fármaco Atlas, which stores molecules, structures, and results together with their provenance -- a record of how they were obtained. The agent uses targeted database queries to retrieve the evidence needed for each decision. A single request can launch calculations for an entire collection of molecules, without requiring a separate LLM decision for every compound. This design limits the information the model must process as screening collections grow, while keeping the underlying results available for inspection and further analysis. The integrated tools support molecule generation, prediction of binding and molecular properties, and searches for compounds available for purchase. In a retrospective comparison with an expert-led campaign, the agent proposed chemically distinct candidates with competitive docking scores and higher calculated drug-likeness under explicitly imposed selection criteria. In a 22-task benchmark against plain tool calls and Codex, the agent achieved the highest observed mean model-judged score, with lower median cumulative token use and peak context. Fármaco provides a foundation for flexible, scalable drug discovery workflows that connect scientific reasoning with an enduring, traceable record of computational work.

translation.title: El Agente Fármaco：面向药物发现的可扩展 AI 科学家
translation.abstract: 计算药物发现为提出和评估分子提供了日益丰富的工具，但组合这些工具并决定下一步做什么仍需要大量专家投入。本文介绍 El Agente Fármaco，一个利用现代大语言模型（LLM）技术将日常语言表达的发现目标转化为复杂、可扩展计算筛选工作流的 AI 科学家。该智能体框架选择科学工具、审查其结果，并根据靶点和用户目标调整后续步骤。我们的方法以共享科学记忆 Fármaco Atlas 为核心，它将分子、结构和结果连同其来源（即它们如何获得的记录）一起存储。智能体通过有针对性的数据库查询检索每次决策所需的证据。单个请求即可启动对整个分子集合的计算，无需对每个化合物单独进行 LLM 决策。这种设计限制了模型在筛选集合增长时必须处理的信息量，同时保持底层结果可供检查和进一步分析。集成的工具支持分子生成、结合与分子性质预测，以及可购买化合物的搜索。在与专家主导活动的回顾性对比中，该智能体在明确施加的选择标准下提出了化学上不同、对接得分具有竞争力且计算类药性更高的候选分子。在与直接工具调用和 Codex 的 22 项任务基准对比中，该智能体获得了最高的平均模型评判得分，且累计 token 使用中位数和峰值上下文更低。Fármaco 为灵活、可扩展的药物发现工作流提供了基础，将科学推理与持久、可追溯的计算工作记录连接起来。
translation.brief: 针对组合药物发现工具仍需大量专家投入的问题，构建基于 LLM 的智能体系统 El Agente Fármaco，以共享科学记忆 Fármaco Atlas 为核心，将自然语言目标转化为可扩展的自动化筛选工作流。

papers.title: Why Pay for Long Reasoning When Rewrite Do Trick? Causal Effects of Reasoning History Compaction on Future Generation and Agent Cost
papers.abstract: Reasoning substantially improves language models' ability to solve difficult problems, but long reasoning traces make these gains expensive. Efficient reasoning should express useful analysis in fewer tokens by reducing repetition and text that adds little value to solving the problem. Progress in proprietary models motivates this goal, yet their hidden scratchpads limit direct study of how it is achieved. We investigate whether open-weight models can generate less verbose reasoning by changing the form of their own earlier thoughts, without retraining. Our intervention rewrites prior reasoning into compact state records before pending tool results are revealed, then compares continuations from original and compact histories. Across the tested models, accepted compact histories usually shorten future reasoning; a coding case study also shows less repeated verification after a shared candidate solution. In software-agent deployments, compaction can reduce total spending, although task quality and rewrite-inclusive time depend on the target and compressor. These findings identify reasoning history as one way to reduce future reasoning-token use and motivate model-specific compaction policies evaluated for both efficiency and retained capability.

translation.title: 既然重写就够了，为何还要为长推理付费？推理历史压缩对未来生成与 Agent 成本的因果效应
translation.abstract: 推理显著提升了语言模型解决难题的能力，但冗长的推理轨迹使这些收益代价高昂。高效推理应通过减少重复和对解决问题价值不大的文本，用更少的 token 表达有用的分析。专有模型的进展激发了这一目标，但其隐藏的草稿区限制了对实现方式的直接研究。我们研究开放权重模型能否通过改变自身先前思考的形式来生成更简洁的推理，而无需重新训练。我们的干预在待处理的工具结果揭示之前，将先前的推理重写为紧凑的状态记录，然后比较原始历史与紧凑历史产生的续写。在测试的模型中，被接受的紧凑历史通常会缩短未来的推理；一个编程案例研究还显示，在共享候选解之后重复验证减少。在软件 Agent 部署中，压缩可以降低总支出，尽管任务质量和包含重写的时间取决于目标和压缩器。这些发现将推理历史确定为减少未来推理 token 使用的一种途径，并推动针对效率和保留能力两方面进行评估的模型特定压缩策略。
translation.brief: 针对长推理链 token 开销过高的问题，研究在不重训的情况下将模型先前推理重写为紧凑状态记录的干预，验证其对未来推理长度和 Agent 成本的因果影响。

papers.title: Towards Effective Fuzzing of EDK2 Components
papers.abstract: Securing bootloaders is critical to establishing the trusted computing base of modern systems. TianoCore's edk2, the de facto UEFI-based bootloader, is widely deployed but has recently been shown to contain numerous high-severity vulnerabilities. Existing approaches either focus on post-boot interfaces or rely on heavyweight simulation, limiting their scalability, throughput, and coverage of boot-time components. We present Metis, an automated technique for fuzzing edk2 protocols (i.e., boot-time interfaces) by rehosting them as user-space applications. Our key insight is that effective fuzzing must exercise not only protocol interfaces but also their dependency interactions, which serve as additional input channels. Metis employs a Direct-dependency Component Rehosting (DCR)-based strategy to construct semantically meaningful mocks for dependencies, enabling controlled input injection across all channels. It further leverages a hybrid approach combining static analysis and Large Language Model (LLM)-guided synthesis to generate and refine fuzzing harnesses. We implement Metis on the Host Based Firmware Analyzer (HBFA) framework and evaluate it on 60 drivers covering 162 protocols. Metis achieves 73.1% coverage, approximately 1.7 times higher than FuzzUEr, the state-of-the-art edk2 fuzzing technique, and discovers 137 previously unknown bugs. We have already reported 26 of them, including 12 that are remotely triggerable, and all reported vulnerabilities have been acknowledged by the vendors.

papers.title: EvoGroup: A Self-Evolving Harness for Group Agents in Shared Contexts
papers.abstract: With the rise of Group Agent such as Claude Tag, agents increasingly serve as digital workers for long-term team collaboration. These agents operate over shared contexts that continuously accumulate through multi-user interactions. However, existing agent memory systems are mainly designed for individual users and struggle to capture group-level knowledge in shared contexts, including group relationships and collaboratively formed knowledge. Manual memory strategies further limit adaptation to diverse and evolving shared contexts. To this end, we propose \textbf{EvoGroup (EvoG)}, a self-evolving harness for group agents that starts from a minimal six-tool cold start and adapts through interaction with shared context. EvoG uses confidence and task outcomes to select informative trajectories, while also eliciting self-reflections on uncertainty in low-confidence cases. The analysis agent then examines selected trajectories through adaptive progressive disclosure, followed by bucketed analysis to synthesize high-level findings that guide the evolve agent in revising the Harness. Empirically, pass@1 on held-out split of EverMemBench improves from 71.07\% to 89.58\%, surpassing both self-evolving memory and human-designed harnesses, including Claude Code (85.83\%). To evaluate generalization, we freeze the evolved harness and evaluate it on the unseen GroupMemBench, where, with GPT-5.5, it demonstrates effective generalization and outperforms both memory baselines and human-designed harnesses.

papers.title: Embedding Semantic Entropy: NLI-Free Semantic Uncertainty Estimation with Geometry-Aware Clustering
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often generate fluent yet incorrect responses, making un- certainty estimation important for reliable deployment. Semantic Entropy (SE) estimates uncertainty by clustering responses based on semantic equivalence, but it relies on hard entailment-based clustering. We propose Embedding Semantic Entropy, which replaces entailment-based clustering with K-Medoids in semantic embedding space and uses dynamic cluster selection to account for intra-cluster compactness and inter-cluster separation. We evaluate the method on TriviaQA, SQuAD, NQ-Open, SVAMP, and BioASQ using Falcon- 7B-Instruct, LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-7B-Chat, and Gemma-7B. Results show competitive AUROC and AUARC performance, suggesting that NLI-based entailment clustering can be replaced with embedding-space clustering with limited degradation while improving the inspectability of semantic grouping. This matters because semantic uncertainty scores depend on underlying semantic groups; by making these groups explicit, compact, and separable in embedding space, Emb-SE turns uncertainty estimation from a black-box en- tailment decision into an inspectable clustering problem.

We propose Embedding Semantic Entropy, which replaces entailment-based clustering with K-Medoids in semantic embedding space and uses dynamic cluster selection to account for intra-cluster compactness and inter-cluster separation. Results show competitive AUROC and AUARC performance, suggesting that NLI-based entailment clustering can be replaced with embedding-space clustering with limited degradation while improving the inspectability of semantic grouping. This matters because semantic uncertainty scores depend on underlying semantic groups; by making these groups explicit, compact, and separable in embedding space, Emb-SE turns uncertainty estimation from a black-box en- tailment decision into an inspectable clustering problem.

papers.title: ProofPaths: An AI Agent Framework for Assessing Student Reasoning
papers.abstract: Students can use large language models to complete assignments, but a correct solution does not establish whether they understand the reasoning behind it. Individualized interviews can probe that understanding but require recurring staff effort. We introduce ProofPaths, an AI agentic framework that combines rubric-based grading with individualized and interactive interviews. Multiple grading agents assess a submission against instructor guidance, exchange critiques, and revise their judgments. Their scores determine which review supplies the grade and feedback. An interview agent asks students to justify steps in their submission and uses their answers to guide follow-up questions. Each question is linked to a retrieved submission excerpt, so instructors can compare the student's explanation with the cited passage. The system tracks assessment progress and stores grading reviews and interview transcripts for each submission. Several deterministic tests of the assessment controllers check source handling, score aggregation, and limits on correction attempts. Instructors can inspect all reviews and transcripts and override grades within the assignment workflow.

papers.title: EpiLoRA: Fusing Many LoRA Adapters into Low-Precision GEMMs for Serving and RL
papers.abstract: Low-rank adapters (LoRA) let one base model serve many fine-tuned variants: multi-tenant engines keep a single copy of the base and batch the requests of many tenants, each with its own adapter. As base models move to 8-bit (FP8) and 4-bit formats, their general matrix multiplications (GEMMs) become cheaper, but the adapters do not: engines run them as separate small GPU kernels beside the GEMM, whose latency takes a growing share of every decoding step. An adapter projects its input down to a low rank and back up, and our key observation is that the GEMM needs the down-projection only in its epilogue, the final stage in which it writes its output. EpiLoRA, a plugin for the vLLM engine, therefore launches the down-projection first and the low-precision GEMM as a dependent kernel that streams its weights meanwhile and adds every tenant's up-projection in its epilogue. On NVIDIA Hopper GPUs, EpiLoRA decodes for a single adapter with up to 24% lower time per token than vLLM's fastest configuration, and faster than SGLang and TensorRT-LLM; with many tenants, its adapter kernels deliver more throughput than vLLM's on most GPU-model pairs we tested. The same low-precision base also trains: a LoRA reinforcement-learning trainer that computes on the engine's FP8 weights needs no 16-bit copy, so a 27B model trains on one 48 GB GPU, and an engine that then keeps activations in 16 bits removes most of the remaining mismatch between the model generating training data and the one trained.

papers.title: What Is This Memory Useful For? Measuring Task-Conditioned Utility in Long-Term Agent Memory
papers.abstract: A stored experience may answer one future question and offer little help with another. We measure this task-conditioned utility rather than assigning each memory a single importance score. A task-blind writer stores a memory without seeing the later task; a frozen reader then answers that task with and without the memory, using identical filler. A cost ledger records the resources used to form, store and expose the memory. On single-call factual-recall tasks built from LongMemEval-V2 web-agent memories, the same memory helps more when it contains information needed for the answer. Its mean paired reward gain on these answer-bearing task pairs exceeds that on matched-control pairs by $+0.33$ (95% interval $+0.21$ to $+0.46$). The tested task-blind summaries and structured records yield smaller gains than Raw, including at fixed total context; a budget sweep is consistent with retention of answer-bearing content contributing to the difference. The bearing--control contrast remains positive in a new session with randomized memory position and under a second reader, although individual memory--task labels change. Generic retrieval performs above chance but misses most screen-defined answer-bearing memories. The factual-recall gains do not extend to the tested software-engineering and scientific-coding benchmarks, where even raw memories have no measurable effect. We provide a public, versioned Conditional Memory Utility Dataset of paired measurements and costs. The practical takeaway is to evaluate memory compression by the task utility it preserves alongside its costs. Task-conditioned measurements make this comparison possible; their stability must also be checked.

papers.title: Beyond Division of Labor: How Roles Shape Feedback and Recovery in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Roles in multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems allocate decisions as well as work. In a Planner--Executor--Reviewer team, the Reviewer's approval can determine when the team submits an answer and receives corrective feedback. We study both functions by varying role instructions while holding agents, topology, call budget, and ground-truth evaluator constant, using three open-weight models on Omni-MATH and two on SciBench. Removing roles largely eliminates functional specialization without lowering first-pass accuracy. After a failed first answer, however, submission decisions matter: a role-structured Reviewer often withholds approval, so its team submits less often and receives fewer evaluator verdicts. In an exploratory comparison with feedback available to both teams, the role-free team recovers more often across all five model--benchmark settings. Two further analyses support the importance of feedback opportunities. In a post hoc comparison at equal numbers of verdicts, the pooled recovery difference is small (role-structured minus role-free: $+0.009$, 95% interval $[-0.014,+0.033]$). In an exploratory intervention on $400$ Omni-MATH problems with gemma-4, keeping the role prompts but forcing submission in every cycle raises recovery from $0.198$ to $0.613$; the paired comparison detects no difference from the role-free team. The takeaway is to evaluate roles through recovery after failure as well as specialization. For systems with reliable external feedback, this requires measuring who may submit, how often the team receives feedback, and which agents can act on it.

papers.title: From Benchmarks to Behaviors: A Framework for Auditing AI Agents
papers.abstract: Generative AI systems increasingly mediate access to information. Their behavior depends on tools, instructions, and user memories that are often difficult for researchers to observe or control. Here, I introduce TRACE (Transparent Research on Agent Contexts and Environments), a framework for systematically auditing how these components shape AI agent behavior. Built on an open-source agent harness, TRACE enables controlled manipulation of system components. It also records inputs, outputs, and task execution for downstream analysis. I demonstrate this framework through an experiment examining how user memories influence source selection when agents answer questions about the 2026 U.S. midterm elections. I find that memories expressing explicit preference for a publisher increase its inclusion among the first three cited sources in a response by 33-39 percentage points. Memories identifying the user as a Republican or expressing distrust of mainstream media shift citations rightward. That same media distrust memory also increases citation of sources expressing misinformation or conspiracy theories by 6.3 percentage points, with substantial variation across models. These findings demonstrate that concise user memories can alter source selection in consequential settings, even when questions and search results remain fixed. TRACE extends algorithm auditing to agent harnesses, providing a transparent way to study agent behaviors that benchmarks or commercial interfaces may struggle to isolate.

papers.title: Forget What Comes Next: LLM Unlearning via Statistical Independence
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can memorize and reproduce fragments of their training data, raising privacy and legal concerns that motivate machine unlearning. Yet poisoned training examples can remain statistically detectable after unlearning, which raises the question of whether current unlearning objectives remove what the model has memorized at all. In this work, we introduce PINT, a novel algorithm for machine unlearning that uses the Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC) to reduce the statistical dependence between tokens to be forgotten and the internal representations used to predict them. We formally relate our HSIC-based objective to Exact Memorization through a computable upper bound, connecting the training objective directly to the model's ability to reproduce the forgotten tokens. In extensive experiments, we compare forgetting-utility trade-offs across eight settings with models up to 7B parameters and demonstrate scalability to 70B parameter models. Our evaluations cover unlearning Gaussian poisons, personal information, hazardous knowledge in biology and cybersecurity, and copyrighted books and news articles. PINT achieves the strongest forgetting-utility trade-off on average and is the only method to make Gaussian poisons undetectable while maintaining near-original model utility. Code is available at: this https URL

papers.title: Measuring Model-Specific Alignment Drift in LLM-Based Opinion Dynamics
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used as synthetic participants in opinion-dynamics experiments, often assuming that an agent's behaviour is fully determined by its prompt. We test this assumption with a framework in which LLM agents discuss a contested policy issue over repeated rounds while their stance is quantified by a fixed psychometric instrument independent of any dynamics model. Across six LLMs, committed personas are intrinsically stable: in each of the five models tested without peer input, every agent keeps its assigned side for 20 rounds. The observed loss of alignment under discussion is therefore interaction-induced, we call it alignment drift, and model-specific: gpt-4.1 keeps opinion clusters apart, claude-sonnet-5 holds them partially, and gpt-5.6-sol and claude-opus-5 abandon them. Under selective attention, one LLM maintains separated opinion clusters under stance-homophilous attention. Qualitative profiles persist at doubled population and horizon and on a second issue. Such heterogeneity makes the LLM choice a first-class validity variable for social simulation.

papers.title: Rapid Mean-Field Formation Transport with a Shared-Representation Neural Fokker-Planck Controller
papers.abstract: This paper develops a mean-field formation transport method with low online computational cost for large-scale multi-agent systems. Classical mean-field planners often require repeated solutions of coupled forward and backward partial differential equations, making online replanning computationally demanding. Density and control are therefore approximated by a common parameterized nonlinear map with separate scalar density and vector control outputs. Parameters are optimized using Fokker--Planck and initial-condition residuals, formation-matching costs on numerically simulated closed-loop particle trajectories, and control effort. Numerical computations are restricted to a bounded region of the state space, with an additional penalty on probability flux across its boundary. For the periodic-domain model, we establish well-posedness of the induced density evolution and bound the density-approximation error in terms of the dynamics and initial-condition residuals. Parameter optimization precedes online operation, during which controller coefficients remain fixed. Experiments quantify the accuracy--runtime trade-off relative to a mean-field planner, show lower transport error than classical feedback baselines, and demonstrate the benefits of the common parameterization.

translation.title: 基于共享表示神经 Fokker-Planck 控制器的快速平均队形编队输运
translation.abstract: 本文针对大规模多智能体系统提出一种在线计算开销低的平均场编队输运方法。经典平均场规划器通常需要反复求解耦合的前向和后向偏微分方程，使在线重规划计算代价高昂。为此，密度和控制由一个共同的参数化非线性映射近似，该映射分别输出标量密度和向量控制。参数通过 Fokker--Planck 残差和初始条件残差、在数值模拟闭环粒子轨迹上的编队匹配代价以及控制努力进行优化。数值计算限制在状态空间的有界区域内，并对穿越边界的概率流施加额外惩罚。对于周期域模型，我们建立了诱导密度演变的适定性，并用动力学和初始条件残差来界定密度近似误差。参数优化在在线运行之前完成，在线运行期间控制器系数保持固定。实验量化了相对于平均场规划器的精度--运行时间权衡，显示出比经典反馈基线更低的输运误差，并展示了共享参数化的优势。
translation.brief: 解决大规模多智能体平均场编队输运在线重规划计算代价高的问题，方法是用共享参数化神经映射近似密度与控制并离线优化参数。

papers.title: SLATE: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Long-Horizon API Selection in E-commerce Tool Use
papers.abstract: Enterprises increasingly want LLM agents to automate standard operating procedures over their software stacks -- mapping each step of a procedure to the right call among thousands of internal APIs, without hand-authored step-to-API mappings. The core difficulty is API selection at scale: choosing and composing the correct tools over a long horizon, judged only by whether the overall task succeeds. Current tool-use benchmarks do not test this regime -- they expose only a handful of tools, evaluate single-step invocation, or grade multi-step behavior with subjective LLM-as-a-judge scores that penalize valid alternative trajectories. We introduce SLATE (Synthetic Large-scale API Toolkit for E-commerce), a large-scale benchmark that tests large-toolset, long-horizon API selection in a realistic enterprise domain. SLATE couples (i) queries decomposed into hierarchical, tool-grounded procedures over a ~1,000-tool e-commerce library, (ii) a deterministic, context-aware simulator that returns recorded outputs for matching calls and default responses otherwise, and (iii) an end-to-end task-success metric -- a task succeeds when it reaches every reference outcome -- that credits diverse-but-valid trajectories while remaining fully automatic and reproducible. Experiments with six open decision models and the language models they are built on, from 3B to 12B parameters, show that even the best model completes only 5.0% of the tasks, establishing SLATE as a challenging testbed for reliable enterprise tool use. We release SLATE, its simulator, and the evaluation harness at this https URL

translation.title: SLATE：面向电商工具使用中长程 API 选择的大规模基准
translation.abstract: 企业越来越希望 LLM 智能体能在其软件栈上自动化标准操作流程——将流程的每一步映射到数千个内部 API 中的正确调用，而无需人工编写的步骤到 API 的映射。核心难点是大规模 API 选择：在长程中正确选择和组合工具，且仅以整体任务是否成功来评判。现有工具使用基准无法测试这一场景——它们只暴露少量工具、评估单步调用，或用主观的 LLM-as-a-judge 评分来评价多步行为，而这类评分会惩罚有效的替代轨迹。我们提出 SLATE（Synthetic Large-scale API Toolkit for E-commerce），一个在真实企业领域测试大工具集、长程 API 选择的大规模基准。SLATE 结合：(i) 分解为在约 1000 个工具的电商库上的层次化、工具化流程的查询；(ii) 一个确定性的、上下文感知的模拟器，对匹配调用返回录制输出，否则返回默认响应；(iii) 一个端到端任务成功指标——当任务达到每个参考结果时即成功——该指标认可多样但有效的轨迹，同时保持完全自动化和可复现。对六个开源决策模型及其基础语言模型（参数量从 3B 到 12B）的实验表明，即使最好的模型也只完成 5.0% 的任务，确立了 SLATE 作为可靠企业工具使用的挑战性测试平台。我们在该 https URL 发布 SLATE、其模拟器和评估框架。
translation.brief: 解决现有工具使用基准无法测试大工具集长程 API 选择的问题，构建了含约千个工具、确定性模拟器和端到端成功指标的电商基准 SLATE。

papers.title: A Guideline-Grounded Multi-Agent Framework for Personalized Exercise Prescription from Clinical and Wearable Data
papers.abstract: Translating population-level exercise guidance into individualized prescriptions requires integrating clinical and wearable data, including diagnoses, medications, functional limitations, and baseline activity, with condition-specific recommendations, a process difficult to scale beyond specialist rehabilitation settings. We developed FITTER, a multi-agent framework that integrates these data with condition-specific guidance to generate personalized FITT-VP prescriptions and applies deterministic safety audit and repair to correct rule-checkable violations. We evaluated FITTER using data from 400 All of Us participants (300 cancer, 100 stroke) against five LLM comparators through computational evaluation, ablation, and structured clinician review. FITTER achieved 98.5% safety-constraint compliance versus 75.8-85.8% for comparators and showed greater quantitative dosing precision and guideline alignment. Cancer-cohort ablation identified safety audit and repair as the largest contributor to safety-constraint compliance. Clinicians reviewed 80 prescriptions across safety, personalization, instruction concreteness, anticipated effectiveness, and clinical acceptability. FITTER provides a clinician-facing approach integrating clinical and wearable data, guidance, and explicit safety constraints.

translation.title: 基于临床与可穿戴数据的指南锚定多智能体个性化运动处方框架
translation.abstract: 将人群层面的运动指导转化为个体化处方需要整合临床和可穿戴数据，包括诊断、用药、功能限制和基线活动，并结合针对特定病症的建议，这一过程难以在专科康复场景之外规模化。我们开发了 FITTER，一个多智能体框架，将这些数据与针对特定病症的指导整合以生成个性化的 FITT-VP 处方，并应用确定性的安全审计与修复来纠正可规则检查的违规。我们使用 400 名 All of Us 参与者（300 名癌症、100 名中风）的数据，通过计算评估、消融实验和结构化临床医生评审，将 FITTER 与五个 LLM 对比方法进行评估。FITTER 达到 98.5% 的安全约束合规率，而对比方法为 75.8-85.8%，并在定量剂量精度和指南一致性方面表现更优。癌症队列的消融实验表明安全审计与修复是安全约束合规的最大贡献者。临床医生从安全性、个性化、指导具体性、预期有效性和临床可接受性五个方面评审了 80 份处方。FITTER 提供了一种面向临床医生的方法，整合临床与可穿戴数据、指南和显式安全约束。
translation.brief: 解决个性化运动处方难以规模化的问题，提出整合临床与可穿戴数据的多智能体框架 FITTER，并辅以确定性安全审计与修复机制。

papers.title: Thinking Fast, Trading Late: System One Decision Models vs the Market
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) read company news at scale, and backtests suggest that their readings predict stock returns. We ask how much of that predictability survives a test that rules out look-ahead, memorization and selection. We propose OLIVIA, a protocol for such tests: point-in-time inputs with company identities masked, selection on validation data only, an analysis plan frozen by cryptographic hash, and a test period unblinded once through a logged lock. We apply it to AI decision models, non-generative language models that return probabilities for typed questions, reading news about S&P 500 stocks: an open-weights model we fine-tuned on 2024-2025 data, three commercial models and standard baselines. The fine-tuned model's signal replicated on two validation quarters (daily information coefficients 0.055 and 0.065) but fell to 0.020 (t = 1.7) on the blinded January-July 2026 test. The commercial models' readings line up with the overnight move to the open (information coefficient 0.074 to 0.077) but not with the move after it, so the news is priced by the time a trader can act on it at the open. No model can tell over- from under-reaction, and no pre-registered strategy survives costs and a deflated Sharpe ratio. Commercial models identify masked companies in 62% to 74% of cases against a 28% baseline: masking hides names, not companies. The market reads the news first.

translation.title: 思考快、交易迟：系统一决策模型与市场的较量
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以大规模阅读公司新闻，回测表明其解读能预测股票收益。我们追问这种可预测性中有多少能在排除前视偏差、记忆和选择效应的检验中存活。我们提出 OLIVIA，一个此类检验的协议：使用公司身份被遮蔽的时点输入、仅在验证数据上做选择、由密码学哈希冻结的分析计划，以及通过记录的锁一次性解盲的测试期。我们将其应用于 AI 决策模型——对类型化问题返回概率的非生成式语言模型——阅读标普 500 股票的新闻：包括我们在 2024-2025 数据上微调的开源权重模型、三个商业模型和标准基线。微调模型的信号在两个验证季度上复现（日信息系数 0.055 和 0.065），但在盲测的 2026 年 1-7 月降至 0.020（t = 1.7）。商业模型的解读与开盘前的隔夜走势一致（信息系数 0.074 至 0.077），但与开盘后的走势不一致，因此新闻在交易者能于开盘时行动之前已被定价。没有任何模型能区分过度反应与反应不足，也没有预注册策略能在扣除成本和折减 Sharpe 比率后存活。商业模型在 62% 至 74% 的情况下识别出被遮蔽的公司，而基线为 28%：遮蔽隐藏了名字，却隐藏不了公司。市场总是先读到新闻。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 新闻解读预测股票收益的可信性问题，提出排除前视、记忆与选择偏差的 OLIVIA 检验协议并应用于多种语言决策模型。

papers.title: Whose startup does the AI back? An algorithm audit of reputation and demographic signals in LLM-assisted crowdfunding
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) assistants increasingly advise backers on which crowdfunding campaigns to support. LLMs have known race and gender problems, and it is unsettled whether they reproduce, erase, or reverse the discrimination documented in entrepreneurial finance. We ask when, and through which decision process, LLM assistants use founders' gender and ethnicity. In a pre-specified choice-based conjoint experiment, seven LLMs chose among five synthetic campaigns with independently randomized quality signals and founder names, under three backer personas and a persona-free control (40,248 responses). By default, founder names barely matter: under budget-conscious and delivery-focused personas, gender and Black-name effects are statistically equivalent to zero. When the backer wants to support underrepresented creators, the models favor Black-signaled (+8.1 percentage points; positive in all seven models) and female-signaled (+5.1) founders. They do so most strongly among near-tied campaigns and for the founder who alone carries the signal, and they almost never name gender or ethnicity in their reasons. The results fit an agency account of algorithmic discrimination: an aligned assistant takes its demographic preferences from its user rather than from its training data.

translation.title: AI 支持谁的创业项目？LLM 辅助众筹中声誉与人口统计学信号的算法审计
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）助手越来越多地为众筹支持者提供应支持哪些项目的建议。LLM 存在已知的种族和性别问题，而它们是复现、消除还是逆转创业金融中记录在案的歧视，尚无定论。我们追问 LLM 助手何时以及通过何种决策过程使用创始人的性别和种族。在一项预先设定的基于选择的联合实验中，七个 LLM 在三个支持者人设和一个无人设对照下，从五个质量信号独立随机化、创始人名字不同的合成项目中进行选择（40,248 次响应）。默认情况下，创始人名字几乎无关紧要：在预算敏感和交付导向的人设下，性别和黑人名字效应在统计上等同于零。当支持者想支持代表性不足的创作者时，模型偏向黑人信号（+8.1 个百分点；在全部七个模型中均为正）和女性信号（+5.1）的创始人。这种偏好在势均力敌的项目中以及信号仅由单一创始人携带时最强，且它们几乎从不在理由中提及性别或种族。结果符合算法歧视的代理理论：对齐的助手从其用户而非训练数据中获取人口统计学偏好。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 助手在众筹建议中如何使用创始人性别与种族信号的问题，通过预注册的选择联合实验对七个 LLM 进行算法审计。

papers.title: When Music Needs Meaning: Semantic Communication as a Transformative Enabler for the Musical Metaverse
papers.abstract: The Musical Metaverse (MM) enables geographically distributed musicians, audiences, sound engineers, and AI agents to interact through synchronized audio, visual, kinematic, and haptic streams, imposing latency, synchronization, bandwidth, and scalability requirements that are difficult to satisfy with conventional bit-level communication. This paper argues that semantic communication, understood here as the transmission of musically meaningful information rather than raw audio-visual-haptic samples, provides a principled communication paradigm for the MM. We define the MM from a communication perspective and derive modality-specific require ments; propose a three-pillar framework for musical semantic communication comprising semantics extraction, semantic-aware orchestration, and cross-modal semantic synchronization; survey representative work across semantic communication, music AI and edge orchestration, identifying the gaps that prevent their integration; and propose a semantic-first reference architecture based on device-side semantic encoders, edge semantic routers, and cross-modal semantic synchronization. The resulting framework positions the MM as a concrete and demanding use case for 6G semantic communication.

papers.title: Dory1.0-4B: A Looped Normalized-GPT
papers.abstract: We introduce Dory1.0-4B, a 4-billion-parameter looped (latent-recurrent) language model with elastic depth: a single checkpoint serves different inference compute budgets. Dory1.0-4B is built on a normalized Transformer (nGPT) backbone with interleaved sliding-window and full-attention layers, organized into an input block, a shared recurrent block, and an output block. At inference, the recurrent block can be applied a variable number of times. We pre-trained Dory1.0-4B on 6 trillion tokens. The first 4.5 trillion tokens were trained in NVFP4, and additional pre-training then extended the context length to 256K tokens. Next, we post-trained the model using Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), with a difficulty-aware loop curriculum that routes harder prompts to deeper loops. Increasing the loop count improves accuracy, with the largest gains on coding, agentic, and long-context benchmarks. With two or more loops, Dory1.0-4B outperforms larger models such as Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma 4 12B, and Gemma 4 26B-A4B on average across 12 benchmarks. Looping also makes Dory1.0-4B more token-efficient on agentic benchmarks: with four loops, it generates 1.3-2.5x fewer tokens than with one loop, as the extra computation is spent in latent space rather than on longer outputs. To reduce memory during looping, Dory1.0-4B caches keys and values only from the last loop, keeping its KV-cache footprint equal to that of a non-looped model at any loop count while retaining most of the accuracy gains. We open-source the BF16, MXFP8, NVFP4, and GGUF quantized checkpoints.

papers.title: WASP-Mem: Let Agent Organize Procedural Memory. Human Spend Effort on Diagnosis
papers.abstract: LLM agents struggle to automate complex enterprise procedures because static, pre-built harness cannot capture proprietary policies, undocumented behaviors, or state-dependent recovery paths that surface only during execution. Procedural memory accrued from agent experience offers a training-free path to closing this gap -- yet unlike episodic records or semantic facts, it must consolidate repeated successes and diagnosed failures into reusable actions and recovery strategies. We introduce WASP-Mem (Wiki-based Agent-Synthesized Procedural Memory), a nimble but effective method that distills execution traces and feedback into persistent, interlinked wiki pages, enabling continual agent learning. On TheAgentCompany benchmark, WASP-Mem raises the checkpoint pass rate by 4.6-6.1% over the strongest baseline we compared across three models while requiring 57-61% less storage. We further present a systematic controlled study spanning consolidation method, feedback type, trace ingestion scope, and refinement rounds. Our results reveal that prescriptive knowledge organization such as human defined schemas and explicit deduplication rules hurts performance rather than closing the procedural-knowledge gap. In contrast, human diagnosis converts failed traces into corrective knowledge and drives sustained improvement: a single round of human diagnosis outperforms four rounds of self-judgment by 7.0-10.9%. These findings point to a simple division of labor: let agents organize procedural memory, and invest human effort where it matters most -- diagnosis.
