papers.title: Characterizing Adversarial GEO via Implicit Brand Injection
papers.abstract: Generative search engines increasingly shape how users discover products, services, and commercial entities by generating answers from retrieved web content. This creates an opportunity to influence which brands appear in these answers by modifying the content available to the retrieval system. In this work, we study an adversarial generative engine optimization (GEO) setting in which a predefined brand is added to an article through a single contextually integrated mention. The challenge is to make the mention fit the surrounding article without making the content overtly promotional, while keeping it relevant enough to be retrieved and to influence the generated answer. To study this, we introduce Implicit Brand Injection (IBI), a multi-agent framework that identifies insertion locations, rewrites the selected sentence, verifies the edit, and selects the final candidate. To evaluate IBI at scale, we construct IBIBench, which contains 1,000 web articles and 60 synthetic brands across 12 diverse domains, with both endemic and non-endemic brand placements. We compare IBI with Direct Prompting and Best-of-N with ranking under an equivalent budget, evaluating insertion quality, target-chunk retrieval, and downstream brand propagation. Compared with the baselines, IBI produces insertions that better preserve semantics and disrupt perplexity less, while improving Hit@k across all evaluated cutoffs, query regimes, and placement settings. IBI achieves up to 82.2% Hit@10 and 0.74 MRR@10, while Brand Mention Rate (BMR) and Conditional Propagation (CP) reach up to 62.7% and 75.9%, respectively. These results show that a single brand mention can increase both retrieval exposure and brand visibility in generated responses, highlighting the need for defenses against implicit content manipulation in generative search.

papers.title: Decision Transformer with Task-Aware Representations for Offline Meta-Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: To enable effective generalization in offline meta-RL, it is essential to accurately infer the underlying task through latent task representations, which provide a compact and transferable summary of task-specific characteristics for guiding policy generation. In this paper, we propose Contrastive Task-Aware Decision Transformer (CoTA-DT), a DT-based offline meta-RL framework that learns task representations by jointly integrating four complementary components: (i) contrastive learning from offline trajectories, (ii) alignment with natural-language task descriptions, (iii) one-step supervision via a task-conditioned world model, and (iv) long-term supervision via a task-conditioned Q function. The learned task representations are used as conditioning signals for a DT-based policy, enabling task-aware meta-policy learning. To further support generalization in both zero-shot and few-shot settings, we design a language-grounded, self-adaptive strategy that enables effective and reliable adaptation to unseen tasks. Notably, in CoTA-DT, the pretrained LLM serves as a shared backbone for language encoding, world modeling, Q-function estimation, and policy learning. This unified design facilitates parameter sharing, improving both efficiency and generalization. Extensive experiments across diverse offline meta-RL benchmarks demonstrate that CoTA-DT consistently outperforms prior methods, particularly in challenging zero-shot generalization scenarios.

papers.title: SurgEye: Instruction Tuning-Free Perception-Reasoning Framework for Surgical Scene Understanding
papers.abstract: Surgical scene understanding is pivotal for computer-assisted intervention, yet demands compositional reasoning across instruments, anatomy, and workflow. Existing surgical vision-language models rely on instruction tuning with large-scale question-answer pairs, entailing laborious data curation and costly retraining. To bridge this gap, we propose SurgEye, a perception-reasoning framework that grounds reasoning in a vision foundation model without instruction tuning. Specifically, we devise Routed Multi-Task Perception (RMP) that routes the vision foundation model through task-specific pathways learned from public perception labels, producing spatial and temporal evidence. We further introduce Agentic Compositional Reasoning (ACR) that employs a frozen large language model to coordinate RMP specialists and temporal memory as callable tools, composing evidence across tasks and time into grounded answers. Moreover, we construct SurgEye-Bench spanning eight surgical procedures, pairing each question with perception labels for verifiable evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SurgEye outperforms state-of-the-arts in surgical reasoning. The source code will be available.

papers.title: Physical Experience Builds Continual Spatial World Models
papers.abstract: World models are increasingly used to support prediction and planning in embodied agents, but the knowledge is usually established before deployment and then carried into later encounters. Continual operation faces a different problem. A familiar environment may change, and the agent must use previous experience without allowing old expectations to override current physical evidence. This study asks what repeated physical experience must contribute for a spatial world model to become progressively more useful rather than simply more persistent. A physics-grounded dynamic maze separates recurring spatial change from the continuous consequences of action. Cross-episode Spatial Change Memory learns relations among environmental transformations, while state-action-outcome experience refines predictions of motion. Structured experience progressively reduces the need for future route correction and transfers to spatial transitions not encountered during learning. The advantage disappears when past changes contain no information about future ones. Continuous navigation further shows that predictive memory changes behavior when a previous decision becomes invalid but leaves behavior unchanged when the decision remains correct. Physical tests expose a complementary limit: correct topology does not guarantee correct action prediction, and accumulated physical experience reduces this mismatch within the modeled dynamics. The results characterize continual world knowledge as experience that improves future prediction and action beyond stored episodes while remaining revisable by the physical outcomes it is intended to predict.

papers.title: Language Model Augmented Decision Transformer for Multi-Task Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Offline multi-task reinforcement learning (MTRL) aims to learn a unified policy from heterogeneous offline datasets that generalizes across tasks. However, existing offline MTRL methods often struggle with two fundamental issues: severe per-task data scarcity and limited cross-task generalization. In this paper, we propose Language-Model Augmented Decision Transformer (LaMA-DT), a unified sequence-modeling framework that leverages a single large language model (LLM) for both trajectory augmentation and multi-task policy learning. LaMA-DT uses natural-language task descriptions to guide task-aligned trajectory augmentation through a set of supervised generation and alignment objectives, and incorporates a scoring-and-filtering mechanism to retain high-quality augmented trajectories. The same LLM is then repurposed as a language-conditioned Decision Transformer and fine-tuned on a mixture of real and augmented data. Experiments on Meta-World and MuJoCo multi-task benchmarks demonstrate that LaMA-DT consistently outperforms competitive baselines, particularly in low-data regimes, showing that language-guided data augmentation substantially improves cross-task generalization.

papers.title: ROCm InferaSim: Cut LLM Serving Trial Costs and Deploy the Best Configuration
papers.abstract: Serving an LLM efficiently depends on the engine, how the model is split across GPUs, precision, scheduler settings, speculative decoding, KV-cache management, and prefill-decode disaggregation. The best configuration depends on the model, hardware, workload, and objective. Operators usually find it by trial and error. Exhaustively measuring the candidates in our study would take about 25,000 GPU-hours. ROCm InferaSim predicts serving performance from a few short measurements. Choices such as batch size, prompt length, and GPU count change the amount of work per GPU without changing the kernels. ROCm InferaSim benchmarks each distinct set of kernels once, on at most one node. We call this measurement an anchor. Analytical laws carry that anchor to other deployments that run the same kernels. For multi-node deployments, ROCm InferaSim reduces the configuration to a single-node equivalent, measures it, and scales the result analytically. A simulator replays multi-turn traffic, and a tuning agent searches configurations using the predictions. On AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs with vLLM, SGLang, and ATOM, 11 anchors took 9.1 GPU-hours, against 204 GPU-hours to measure the 226 fixed-length configurations they cover. On 172 configurations, time per output token has 8.1% median error. On a multi-turn coding workload, throughput is within 8%. For 159 disaggregated deployments, none used as an anchor, throughput is within 5.5%. A five-candidate short list contains a deployment within 12% of the best feasible pairing of model and latency target.

papers.title: Exploit or conform? How norm utility prompting changes the way LLMs use community beliefs
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) serve both as tools for aiding human decision-making in everyday life and as models of human agents in experimental simulation studies. Alignment on prototypical social decisions -- such as whether to cooperate on a collective action -- therefore has immediate practical consequences for researchers and for society at large. Here we systematically explore the impact of ``norm utility'' -- the non-material components of utility that account for an individual's desire to conform to social norms and to be internally consistent -- on the strategic decision-making of three open-weight LLMs in one-shot, two-player social dilemmas. We find that when a social dilemma is presented together with information about community beliefs -- but without any indication of how those beliefs should matter -- models tend to treat community belief as strategic information, so that in the Snowdrift game cooperation falls as community belief in cooperation increases. When we explicitly prompt the components of norm utility this relationship inverts, and cooperation increases with community belief, in broad agreement with the predictions of a simple norm utility model. We then show that prompting norm utility reduces the volatility of strategic decisions with respect to changes in the underlying social context, and generates more consistent reasoning habits across models. Taken together, our results suggest that prompting norm utility can help generate more human-like and consistent behavior across models and lower volatility within models.

We find that when a social dilemma is presented together with information about community beliefs -- but without any indication of how those beliefs should matter -- models tend to treat community belief as strategic information, so that in the Snowdrift game cooperation falls as community belief in cooperation increases. When we explicitly prompt the components of norm utility this relationship inverts, and cooperation increases with community belief, in broad agreement with the predictions of a simple norm utility model. We then show that prompting norm utility reduces the volatility of strategic decisions with respect to changes in the underlying social context, and generates more consistent reasoning habits across models. Taken together, our results suggest that prompting norm utility can help generate more human-like and consistent behavior across models and lower volatility within models.

papers.title: Finite-Sample Convergence in Networked Average Reward MARL: Decentralization Pitfalls and Entropy Remedies
papers.abstract: We study the problem of average reward Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) where agents interact within a network. Each agent in the network conducts local updates with information within its $k$-hop neighborhood and collaboratively maximizes the overall reward of the entire network. We first provide impossibility results in achieving convergence to the global optimal joint policies in our setting. These impossibility results highlight the challenges of decentralized learning with local information in multi-agent systems, namely the issues of multiagency, where each agent independently optimizes its policy, and partial observability, where agents have limited visibility into the global state. Given these challenges which indicate that decentralized policy optimization can generally be certified only up to stationarity, we provide finite-sample convergence guarantees for a decentralized actor-critic algorithm with linear function approximation that converges to an approximate stationary point with small gradient norm. To overcome such impossibility results, we further show that adding fixed-state entropy regularization reshapes the objective landscape which leads to even stronger global convergence guarantees for our proposed actor-critic algorithm.

papers.title: Computer-Use Agents Gain Little Benefit from a World Model When Conditioned on Tutorials
papers.abstract: Recent work has improved computer-use agents (CUAs) by combining retrieved task-relevant tutorials and look-ahead planning using world models with MLLM judges. However, the contribution of each component -- tutorials, the judge, and the world model -- to overall improvement has not been evaluated in isolation. To fill this gap, we first construct OSWorld-Tutorial and ScienceBoard-Tutorial: two datasets for CUAs with curated multimodal tutorials, covering everyday and scientific domains. We then propose RAG-PolicyJudge (RAG-PJ), a policy-judge framework for CUAs conditioned on task-specific tutorials: the policy proposes candidate actions, and the judge selects among them. To isolate the effect of world models given tutorials, we compare RAG-PJ with and without common world models: using either zero-shot text-based descriptions of next states or an oracle that returns ground-truth visual observations. We find that RAG-PJ gains little benefit from these rollouts when tutorials are present, even with perfect visual futures. This suggests prior world-model gains in tutorial-conditioned methods come mainly from tutorial understanding and the judge's ability to select the proposed actions, rather than from predicted rollouts. Error analysis reveals that the bottleneck is not rollout fidelity, but the judge's ability to reason over future states and recognize task completion. This highlights the need to improve not just next-state prediction in world models, but also reasoning over their predicted rollouts. Datasets and code are available at this https URL.

papers.title: From topology-optimization brief to solver-checked release: separating intent, admissibility and acceptance knowledge for language agents
papers.abstract: An engineering solver can converge even when a language agent has misread the user's problem. AgenticTO makes this distinction inspectable by keeping three records separate: the proposed problem specification, deterministic formulation checks, and numerical acceptance of the solved design. We evaluated the workflow on 50 author-built topology-optimization briefs, injected faults, five numerical problems, and complete agent sessions. The tests used linear-elastic models with one load case. Geometry tools raised the primary provider's correct specifications and refusals from 37 to 44 of 50, while also increasing wrong specifications delivered as finished. Input-format feedback alone recovered most of the accuracy gain. The wrong specifications passed the formulation rules, which also missed most injected faults that changed the intended problem. Clarification corrected the remaining errors when an oracle supplied reference facts, but also prompted questions on fully specified briefs. Perfect accuracy under that oracle therefore does not establish performance with engineers. Numerical trials reached 73.7 million elements, although released designs used finer grids than requested. The records expose how a proposed problem becomes an accepted numerical result; agreement with the brief still needs a separate judgment.

papers.title: AlgoPilot: Cross-Paradigm Reasoning in Language Models via Strategy Selection and Guidance
papers.abstract: Real-world problems span diverse domains, including program synthesis, symbolic reasoning, planning, and optimization, and often require fundamentally different solution paradigms. A central challenge for LLM-based reasoning is twofold: identifying an appropriate problem-solving approach and formulating it correctly. In this paper, we propose AlgoPilot, a cross-paradigm reasoning framework that enables adaptive selection of the solving approaches and structured problem formulation prior to execution. The AlgoPilot framework contains three components: 1) a SteerLM, trained via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), that adaptively selects the solving strategy (paradigm and modes) based on input problems, 2) the corresponding expert GuideLM, trained via SFT, that generates structured formulation guidance tailored to the selected strategy, and 3) an ExecutionLM that generates solutions conditioned on both the selected strategy and its formulation. Unlike prompting-based methods that rely on fixed reasoning templates, our approach learns to adaptively choose and structure problem-solving strategies based on the input. We build AlgoPilot on Qwen3-8B and evaluate across 5 problem categories and 13 benchmarks with 66 unique domains, comparing against both the latest similarly scaled small models and large LLMs. AlgoPilot significantly improves average accuracy for the same model from 38.4% to 72.9%, outperforming the best large LLM prompting baseline GLM-5 by 11.7%. Ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of each component. Notably, we show that the learned steering and formulation modules can transfer across execution models, suggesting their potential to improve other LLMs. Project page: this https URL.

papers.title: Follow the Features: SAE Feature-Guided Data-Efficient Instruction-Tuning of Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Selecting small, effective instruction-tuning datasets requires identifying which aspects of the original data to retain. We introduce Follow the Features (FtF), a data-selection method that uses sparse autoencoder (SAE) features to characterize training data and guide subset construction. FtF ranks features using dataset-level activation statistics, scores samples by their expression of highly ranked features, and incorporates feature resampling to encourage diversity. The LLM-SAE pair used for selection is independent of the model being fine-tuned, enabling reuse across target models. We evaluate FtF on two model-dataset settings at a training budget of 100 samples with a fixed sequence length of 256 tokens. FtF achieves performance competitive with GRAPE and S2L, with relative rankings varying across settings. On Qwen 3 8B trained on Alpaca, FtF exceeds full-dataset training by 1.59 percentage points in the harmonic mean of an AlpacaEval-based win rate and Open LLM Leaderboard performance, although full-dataset training retains a higher Leaderboard score. These results support SAE feature statistics as a useful signal for data-efficient instruction tuning.

papers.title: Permitted but Unauthorized: Affordance-Induced Delegated-Scope Violations in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
papers.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems place several agents on shared infrastructure, where each agent holds permissions far broader than the task it is delegated -- so every agent is routinely permitted to act on a peer's resources it was never assigned. We ask: under competitive pressure, what determines whether an agent crosses from its delegated scope into a peer's resources, and can such crossings be enforced away? We study this across eight LLMs in two simulated environments -- a CI/CD release pipeline and a security-operations incident queue -- using a deterministic, no-model-in-the-loop detector over hash-chained, replay-verified logs. In a controlled 2x2x2 factorial over competitive incentive, candidate visibility, and payoff information (three models, n=52 per cell), we find that action representation, not permission, governs the behavior: no agent crosses when the peer action is unlisted, whereas listing it under competitive pressure with a stated payoff raises crossings sharply -- up to 52 of 52 episodes for Claude Sonnet 4.5. We also observe a model-dependent split: two newer models (Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5) refuse the identical attack in 0 of 100 episodes, where prior-generation models cross in 9 of 10. We then evaluate two defenses -- a deterministic reference monitor and a model-based pre-execution judge -- both block every crossing and, when the task is winnable, cut avoidable peer deadline misses from 15/40 and 14/40 to at most 1/40. But scope enforcement is not harm prevention: an agent can still set a peer back through an authorized action on its own resources -- misreporting its incident's severity -- which neither defense detects. Our results establish action representation, not permission alone, as a controllable driver of inter-agent scope violations, and show that enforcing delegated scope is distinct from preventing harm, motivating effect-aware authorization.

translation.title: 被允许但未获授权：多智能体LLM系统中可供性引发的委托范围违规
translation.abstract: 多智能体LLM系统将多个智能体置于共享基础设施上，每个智能体持有的权限远超其被委托的任务——因此每个智能体通常都被允许操作其从未被分配的同侪资源。我们提出问题：在竞争压力下，什么决定了一个智能体是否会从其委托范围越界进入同侪资源，以及这种越界能否通过强制手段消除？我们在两个模拟环境——CI/CD发布流水线和安全运营事件队列——中对八个LLM进行研究，使用基于哈希链、可重放验证日志的确定性、无模型参与的检测器。在竞争激励、候选可见性和收益信息的受控2x2x2因子实验中（三个模型，每格n=52），我们发现决定行为的是动作表示而非权限：当同侪动作未被列出时，没有任何智能体越界；而在竞争压力下列出该动作并声明收益时，越界急剧上升——Claude Sonnet 4.5在52个回合中越界52次。我们还观察到模型相关的分化：两个较新的模型（Claude Sonnet 5.5和Opus 5.5）在100个回合中0次执行相同攻击，而上一代模型在10次中有9次越界。随后我们评估了两种防御——确定性参考监控器和基于模型的预执行裁判——两者都阻止了所有越界，并且在任务可完成时，将可避免的同侪超时从15/40和14/40降至最多1/40。但范围强制不等于危害预防：智能体仍可通过对其自身资源的授权行为——误报其事件的严重性——使同侪受挫，而两种防御都无法检测到这一点。我们的结果确立了动作表示（而非仅权限）是智能体间范围违规的可控驱动因素，并表明强制委托范围与防止危害是不同的，从而推动效果感知授权的研究。
translation.brief: 研究多智能体LLM系统中智能体在竞争压力下越权访问同侪资源的行为，发现动作表示而非权限是关键驱动因素，并通过参考监控器和预执行裁判两种防御机制进行干预。

papers.title: ScienceVision: Can AI Observe and Reason Like a Scientist?
papers.abstract: Scientific discovery builds on accurate observations interpreted through domain knowledge and reasoning. For scientific 3D data, this requires understanding structures and spatial relationships, from protein contacts to anatomical organization. Existing multimodal benchmarks largely evaluate text and 2D images, while scientific 3D evaluations vary in representations and protocols across disciplines, limiting cross-disciplinary comparison. To assess these foundational capabilities, we introduce ScienceVision, a cross-domain benchmark for scientific 3D understanding and reasoning through expert-level visual question answering (VQA). We construct 250 questions, with 50 each from Biology, Chemistry, Medical Imaging, Mechanical CAD, and Architecture, through a pipeline combining synthetic question generation with domain-expert review and annotation. Each task pairs a native 3D artifact with a scientific question, a specified response format, and a task-specific reference answer, requiring domain knowledge to be applied to geometric or topological evidence. We evaluate 12 models on the same questions in three settings: visual question answering with native 3D artifacts accessed through an agent harness's file and code-execution tools; the same workflow augmented with expert-inspired viewer inspection and measurement tools exposed through the Model Context Protocol (MCP); and visual question answering from prescribed rendered 2D images using an agent harness. All settings use the same task-specific deterministic final-answer scoring. The inspection environment supports view changes, target isolation, and slice inspection. In this main comparison, the best mean answer score is 0.53 out of 1. Mean scores in the native-artifact workflow without additional MCP tools exceed those in the rendered-image workflow for every model, by 17.2 percentage points on average.

translation.title: ScienceVision：AI能否像科学家一样观察和推理？
translation.abstract: 科学发现建立在通过领域知识和推理对准确观察的解释之上。对于科学3D数据，这需要理解结构和空间关系，从蛋白质接触到解剖组织。现有多模态基准主要评估文本和2D图像，而科学3D评估在各学科间的表示和协议各异，限制了跨学科比较。为评估这些基础能力，我们引入ScienceVision，一个通过专家级视觉问答（VQA）进行科学3D理解与推理的跨领域基准。我们通过结合合成问题生成与领域专家审核标注的流程构建了250个问题，其中生物学、化学、医学影像、机械CAD和建筑各50个。每个任务将原生3D工件与科学问题、指定响应格式和任务特定参考答案配对，要求将领域知识应用于几何或拓扑证据。我们在三种设置下对12个模型进行相同问题的评估：通过agent harness的文件和代码执行工具访问原生3D工件的视觉问答；通过Model Context Protocol（MCP）暴露专家启发的查看器检查和测量工具增强的相同工作流；以及使用agent harness从规定的渲染2D图像进行视觉问答。所有设置使用相同的任务特定确定性最终答案评分。检查环境支持视角变化、目标隔离和切片检查。在这一主要比较中，最佳平均答案得分为0.53（满分1分）。所有模型在无额外MCP工具的原生工件工作流中的平均得分均超过渲染图像工作流，平均高出17.2个百分点。
translation.brief: 构建跨五个学科的3D科学理解与推理VQA基准ScienceVision，评估12个模型在原生3D工件、MCP工具增强和渲染2D图像三种设置下的表现。

papers.title: Swapping the Judge Changes the Ranking: A Preregistered Study of Cross-Provider Replication in LLM-Judged System Comparisons
papers.abstract: Practitioners who compare systems with an LLM judge and have no human labels often check a conclusion by repeating it with a judge from another provider. We test how far that check can be trusted. In a preregistered study (with a disclosed post-registration reduction of the judge set), five judge models from three providers re-judged 4,000 Chatbot Arena battles (nine systems, 33 system pairs) that carry human votes, each in both response orders. Agreement with the human vote was low at the verdict level (median Cohen's kappa = 0.22), and system rankings did not survive a change of judge: Kendall's tau with the human ranking ranged from 0.17 to 0.89 (median 0.67), so the preregistered hypothesis that rankings remain stable was not supported. Conclusions replicated by two low-cost judges from different providers matched the human conclusion more often than single-judge conclusions (+0.10 precision), but the gain came from filtering out one poorly aligned judge, and replication involving that judge left a conclusion for only 35% of comparisons. Judges that agreed with humans reached a stable conclusion with no more verdicts than human votes required; the others failed to converge on 26-70% of system pairs at the sample sizes tested (up to 100 verdicts per pair). Disagreements with the human vote co-occurred across judges far more often than independence predicts, although a single human vote per battle cannot separate shared judge bias from voter noise.

translation.title: 更换裁判即改变排名：LLM裁判系统比较中跨提供商复现的预注册研究
translation.abstract: 使用LLM裁判比较系统且没有人工标注的从业者，常常通过使用另一提供商的裁判重复实验来验证结论。我们测试这种验证的可信程度。在一项预注册研究中（披露了注册后对裁判集的缩减），来自三个提供商的五个裁判模型对带有真人投票的4,000场Chatbot Arena对战（九个系统、33个系统对）重新评判，每个对战均以两种响应顺序进行。与真人投票在判定层面的一致性较低（Cohen's kappa中位数为0.22），且系统排名无法在更换裁判后保持：与人类排名的Kendall's tau范围为0.17至0.89（中位数0.67），因此排名保持稳定的预注册假设未获支持。由来自不同提供商的两个低成本裁判复现的结论比单一裁判结论更常与人类结论一致（精确度+0.10），但这一增益来自过滤掉一个对齐较差的裁判，而涉及该裁判的复现仅对35%的比较留下结论。与人类一致的裁判在不超过人类投票所需判定数的情况下即可达成稳定结论；其余裁判在所测样本量下（每对最多100个判定）有26-70%的系统对未能收敛。裁判之间与人类投票的分歧共现频率远超独立性预测，尽管每场对战仅一次人类投票无法区分共享的裁判偏差与投票者噪声。
translation.brief: 通过预注册研究检验用另一提供商的LLM裁判复现系统比较结论的可靠性，发现更换裁判会改变系统排名，跨裁判复现的结论与人类判断的一致性有限。

papers.title: Same Rule, Different Verdicts: Rubric Language and Clause Structure in LLM Judges for Korean Support Dialogues
papers.abstract: Services that operate in Korean often write their evaluation rubrics in Korean and hand them to an LLM judge. We test whether a judge's verdict depends on the language of the rubric and on how a rubric item is phrased. We write 12 criteria for support dialogues in four clause structures (affirmative, negated, conditional, exception) such that two pairs of structures have the same meaning, and we give each item in Korean and in English. Six low-cost models from three providers, plus one reference model, judge 60 translated ESConv dialogues and 144 constructed boundary cases under every combination (51,744 requests across the seven models). The analysis plan was fixed and committed before data collection. Cross-provider agreement is lower with Korean rubrics than with English rubrics (Cohen's kappa 0.687 vs. 0.745; difference -0.058, 95% CI [-0.072,-0.045]). Disagreement concentrates in negated, conditional, and exception items (odds ratio 5.6 relative to affirmative items). A single model changes its verdict between two items with the same meaning in 11-15% of cases. Two hypotheses are not supported: models from the same provider do not agree more than models from different providers, and adding paired examples does not reduce the language gap. We measure consistency only; no human labels are used, and all materials were drafted by an LLM.

translation.title: 同一规则，不同判定：韩语客服对话LLM裁判中的评分标准语言与从句结构
translation.abstract: 以韩语运营的服务通常用韩语编写评估标准并交给LLM裁判。我们测试裁判的判定是否取决于评分标准的语言以及评分条目的措辞方式。我们以四种从句结构（肯定、否定、条件、例外）为客服对话编写12条标准，使其中两对结构含义相同，并以韩语和英语提供每个条目。来自三个提供商的六个低成本模型加一个参考模型，在所有组合下评判60个翻译的ESConv对话和144个构造的边界案例（七个模型共51,744次请求）。分析计划在数据收集前已固定并提交。韩语评分标准的跨提供商一致性低于英语（Cohen's kappa 0.687对0.745；差异-0.058，95% CI [-0.072,-0.045]）。分歧集中在否定、条件和例外条目上（相对肯定条目的比值比为5.6）。单个模型在11-15%的案例中会对含义相同的两个条目给出不同判定。两个假设未获支持：同一提供商的模型并不比不同提供商的模型更一致，添加配对示例也不能缩小语言差距。我们仅测量一致性；未使用人工标注，所有材料均由LLM起草。
translation.brief: 研究评分标准的语言（韩语vs英语）和从句结构（肯定、否定、条件、例外）如何影响LLM裁判对韩语客服对话的判定一致性，发现韩语评分标准降低跨提供商一致性且分歧集中于非肯定结构。

papers.title: When Strong Reasoners Join the Pool: Small Union Premiums and Costly Runaway Generations in LLM Routing
papers.abstract: Routing benchmarks often judge a router against a hindsight oracle that counts a query as solved whenever any model's recorded answer is correct, but under stochastic decoding that oracle mixes two different objects: the clairvoyant ceiling of committing to one model per query and the premium of calling several models and keeping any correct answer. A companion study measured this premium at 3.5 percentage points (pp) for 11 small open models on MATH-500; how large it is once current reasoning models enter the pool was unknown. We measure it with a fixed-protocol, pre-committed generation on a single NVIDIA B300: all 500 MATH-500 problems, 30 seeded samples per problem, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and NVIDIA's Nemotron Nano 9B v2 and Nemotron Super 49B v1.5 (a NAS derivative of the same 70B) under vendor sampling, a 65,536-token cap, a pinned Math-Verify scorer, and an append-only attempt ledger, for 45,000 scored responses. The two reasoning models both reach 96.1% accuracy against 76.2% for the 70B baseline. The empirical product-coupling premium is 0.215-0.588 pp across all two- and three-model pools; the empirical plug-in selection headroom over always calling Nano is 1.27 pp; and resampling Nano three times gives practically the same empirical any-correct rate as calling all three models once. Only 31 responses reached the cap, 25 of them with exactly periodic tails, yet the capped responses account for up to 60.2% of a model's output-length-squared proxy, and long generations made a fourth planned model, Llama-3.1-8B, too slow to finish. The premium is far below the companion's 3.5 pp, but models, pool size and protocol changed together; an oracle gap should therefore be reported with the pool, the protocol, the samples per cell and the decoding budget that produced it.

translation.title: 当强推理模型加入模型池：LLM路由中的小额并集溢价与代价高昂的失控生成
translation.abstract: 路由基准通常以事后oracle评判路由器，该oracle只要任何模型记录的答案正确就将查询计为已解决，但在随机解码下，该oracle混合了两种不同的对象：每查询承诺一个模型的预知上限，以及调用多个模型并保留任一正确答案的溢价。一项配套研究测得11个小规模开源模型在MATH-500上的溢价为3.5个百分点（pp）；当当前推理模型进入模型池后该溢价有多大尚不清楚。我们通过在单块NVIDIA B300上以固定协议、预先承诺的生成来测量它：全部500道MATH-500问题，每题30个种子样本，模型为Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct以及NVIDIA的Nemotron Nano 9B v2和Nemotron Super 49B v1.5（同一70B的NAS衍生版本），采用厂商采样、65,536 token上限、固定的Math-Verify评分器和只追加的尝试账本，共45,000个已评分响应。两个推理模型均达到96.1%的准确率，而70B基线为76.2%。所有两模型和三模型池的经验乘积耦合溢价为0.215-0.588 pp；相对总是调用Nano的即插即用选择余量为1.27 pp；对Nano重采样三次得到的经验任一正确率与一次性调用全部三个模型几乎相同。仅31个响应达到token上限，其中25个尾部呈精确周期性，但达到上限的响应占某模型输出长度平方代理的最多60.2%，且长生成使原计划的第四个模型Llama-3.1-8B过慢而无法完成。该溢价远低于配套研究的3.5 pp，但模型、池规模和协议同时改变了；因此oracle差距应连同产生它的模型池、协议、每格样本数和解码预算一起报告。
translation.brief: 在固定协议下测量将强推理模型加入路由模型池后的并集溢价，发现其远小于此前报告值，并揭示长失控生成对计算成本的显著影响。

papers.title: Evaluation Contracts and Evaluation Leverage: Sliced-Gap Readings in Structured Prediction Can Move Without Model Change
papers.abstract: NLP evaluation reports routinely cite sliced performance differences, most prominently the intra-inter gap in document-level relation extraction, as capability evidence. We show that such gap readings are joint properties of models and evaluation contracts: scoring function, gold version, threshold, output format, and prompt language. With predictions frozen, a method ordering reverses under a gold-standard exchange (+0.0363, CI excluding zero; tie-level after), movement localizing where gold re-partitions: renames are gauge transformations (Delta=0; re-annotation +0.862). We formalize this as an evaluation leverage account centered on the rank-flip condition. Constructively, the audited evaluation reading (AER) is a contract-marginalized, tie-declared, seed-prescribed, gate-filtered procedure whose tie declarations cover every contract-induced flip on the declared WMT19 grids (14/14; held-out 73% vs. union-of-ties 89%), matching the best single metric contract at epsilon=0.10 equivalence. Evidence spans DocRE, HacRED, a UD probe, and released gold revisions; an alternative-reference-set replication extends it beyond our testbeds. Failed predictions retained as boundaries; a 5% violation gate flags unverifiable settings and bounds survivor-selection bias. We release EvalLever, a preregistered workflow with an amendment trail; on LLM-as-judge grids, the audited ensemble stabilizes every unstable pair (13-15 to zero; generic ensemble shrinkage: the preregistered correlation criterion failed, the companion stabilization criterion passed).

translation.title: 评估契约与评估杠杆：结构化预测中的切片差距读数可在模型不变的情况下变动
translation.abstract: NLP 评估报告经常引用切片性能差异，最突出的是文档级关系抽取中的 intra-inter gap，作为能力证据。我们证明这类差距读数是模型与评估契约（评分函数、金标版本、阈值、输出格式、提示语言）的联合属性。在预测冻结的情况下，方法排序会在金标交换下反转（+0.0363，置信区间不含零；之后为平局级），变动定位于金标重新划分之处：重命名是规范变换（Delta=0；重新标注 +0.862）。我们将其形式化为以排名翻转条件为核心的评估杠杆理论。构造性地，我们提出经审计的评估读数（AER），这是一个契约边缘化、平局声明、种子规定、门限过滤的程序，其平局声明覆盖了声明 WMT19 网格上所有契约引发的翻转（14/14；留出集 73% 对平局并集 89%），并在 epsilon=0.10 等价下匹配最佳单指标契约。证据涵盖 DocRE、HacRED、一个 UD 探针及发布的金标修订；替代参考集复现将其扩展到我们的测试平台之外。失败的预测保留为边界；5% 违规门限标记不可验证的设置并约束幸存者选择偏差。我们发布 EvalLever，一个带修订轨迹的预注册工作流；在 LLM-as-judge 网格上，经审计的集成稳定了所有不稳定对（13-15 降至零；通用集成收缩：预注册相关性准则失败，配套稳定性准则通过）。
translation.brief: 该论文解决切片性能差距读数受评估契约影响而非纯模型能力的问题，提出评估杠杆理论及经审计的评估读数（AER）程序来审计和稳定此类读数。

papers.title: The Agent Board: Kanban for Machines; Durable Coordination for Agents That Outlive the Conversation
papers.abstract: Harnesses for large language models have converged on a single-threaded shape: one agent, one history, one machine, one sitting. That shape fails work that spans many agents, outlives any one model call, or waits on systems that are not agents. We describe the Agent Board, the coordination substrate in the Corvic harness. The board is a durable, shared table of semi-semantic tasks: a few exact fields the system routes on, and a free-form body that only language models read. Agents post tasks, watch tasks, and block on them, ending their turn and holding no process until a matching post wakes them. A system agent, the Board Keeper, acts as the interrupt handler for the board: it carries events from non-agent parts of the harness onto the board, matches them to waiting tasks by reading their prose, and allocates new agents for tasks that name a kind of agent rather than an instance. Loadable coordination policy kernels give statuses and roles meaning for a given pattern of work, without the board enforcing them. The design mirrors the kanban board a human team puts on a wall. We argue it is what persistent agent products such as Meta Muse, OpenAI dots and SpaceXAI Grok Bot need once an agent must wait, hand off work, or work with agents from another vendor. We view the board as an operating-system scheduler for agents and state where the analogy breaks. We separate what the mechanism guarantees from what it leaves to convention, and report a trace from a live board and three small simulated pilots. In the pilots, the wait cost of the board was flat in wait length while naive polling grew about 165-fold, but a plain external watcher was cheaper than the board. The Board Keeper matched prose waiters with no false wakes but missed 3.6 percent of real wakes.

translation.title: Agent Board：机器的看板；为超越对话存续的智能体提供持久协调
translation.abstract: 大语言模型的 harness 已收敛于单线程形态：一个智能体、一份历史、一台机器、一次会话。这种形态无法胜任跨越多个智能体、超出单次模型调用、或等待非智能体系统的工作。我们描述 Agent Board，即 Corvic harness 中的协调基底。看板是一个持久的、共享的半语义任务表：包含系统据此路由的少量精确字段，以及只有语言模型读取的自由格式正文。智能体发布任务、监视任务并在其上阻塞，结束自己的回合且不持有进程，直到匹配的帖子将其唤醒。一个系统智能体 Board Keeper 充当看板的中断处理器：它将 harness 中非智能体部分的事件带到看板上，通过阅读其文本将事件与等待中的任务匹配，并为指明智能体类型而非实例的任务分配新智能体。可加载的协调策略内核为特定工作模式赋予状态和角色含义，而无需看板强制执行。该设计模仿人类团队贴在墙上的看板。我们论证这是 Meta Muse、OpenAI dots 和 SpaceXAI Grok Bot 等持久智能体产品在智能体需要等待、交接工作或与其他厂商智能体协作时所需的东西。我们将看板视为智能体的操作系统调度器，并指出该类比的失效之处。我们区分机制所保证的内容与留给惯例的内容，并报告来自真实看板的轨迹和三个小型模拟试点。在试点中，看板的等待成本与等待时长无关，而朴素轮询增长约 165 倍，但普通外部监视器比看板更便宜。Board Keeper 匹配文本等待者无误唤醒，但漏掉了 3.6% 的真实唤醒。
translation.brief: 该论文解决多智能体跨会话、跨系统的持久协调问题，提出一个类似看板的持久共享任务表（Agent Board）及 Board Keeper 系统智能体作为协调机制。

papers.title: ModelBlaster: Closing the Performance Gap through Learning-Augmented Agents Across Models, Kernels and Hardware Backends
papers.abstract: Optimizing accelerator code across hardware architectures is difficult. ML compilers search predefined spaces of schedules and micro-kernels, while LLM-guided optimization can explore alternative algorithms, operator decompositions, and hardware-specific techniques. However, existing LLM agents typically target a single programming interface, toolchain, or accelerator family, focus on kernel-level optimization without model-level transforms, and offer limited reuse of experience across hardware targets. We present ModelBlaster, a Memory-Augmented In-Context Reinforcement Learning (MAIC-RL) framework for optimizing data-parallel kernels and whole models across heterogeneous SIMD and SIMT accelerators. Its mutable policy is a persistent knowledge base updated at inference time by Actor-Critic Textual Gradient Descent (AC-TGD). The knowledge base maps performance states to actions, outcomes, and constraints, enabling experience reuse across kernels, models, and hardware targets. A model-level optimizer uses kernel-level knowledge to inform whole-model decisions. The same optimization loop and knowledge schema support CUDA on NVIDIA GPUs, OpenCL on Qualcomm GPUs, and RVV intrinsics on RISC-V vector cores, with only lowering and measurement layers specific to each target. Compared with PyTorch, ModelBlaster achieves geometric-mean speedups of 1.85x, 5.58x, and 5.18x on KernelBench Levels 1, 2, and 3, and 1.69x on SOL-ExecBench Levels 1 and 2 on a B200 GPU. On Qualcomm Adreno GPUs, it achieves 5.8x over the vendor SDK and 1.7x over Apache TVM; on RISC-V vector cores, it achieves 2.7x over ExecuTorch with XNNPACK across 70 KernelBench problems.

translation.title: ModelBlaster：通过跨模型、内核与硬件后端的学习增强智能体缩小性能差距
translation.abstract: 跨硬件架构优化加速器代码十分困难。ML 编译器搜索预定义的调度和微内核空间，而 LLM 引导的优化可以探索替代算法、算子分解和硬件特定技术。然而，现有 LLM 智能体通常只针对单一编程接口、工具链或加速器家族，专注于内核级优化而缺乏模型级变换，且跨硬件目标的经验复用有限。我们提出 ModelBlaster，一个用于在异构 SIMD 和 SIMT 加速器上优化数据并行内核和完整模型的记忆增强上下文强化学习（MAIC-RL）框架。其可变策略是一个在推理时由 Actor-Critic 文本梯度下降（AC-TGD）更新的持久知识库。该知识库将性能状态映射到动作、结果和约束，实现跨内核、模型和硬件目标的经验复用。模型级优化器利用内核级知识指导整模型决策。同一优化循环和知识模式支持 NVIDIA GPU 上的 CUDA、Qualcomm GPU 上的 OpenCL 以及 RISC-V 向量核上的 RVV 内联函数，仅降低和测量层因目标而异。与 PyTorch 相比，ModelBlaster 在 KernelBench Level 1、2、3 上分别取得 1.85x、5.58x、5.18x 的几何平均加速，在 B200 GPU 上的 SOL-ExecBench Level 1 和 2 上取得 1.69x。在 Qualcomm Adreno GPU 上，它相对厂商 SDK 达到 5.8x，相对 Apache TVM 达到 1.7x；在 RISC-V 向量核上，跨 70 个 KernelBench 问题相对 ExecuTorch with XNNPACK 达到 2.7x。
translation.brief: 该论文解决跨异构硬件后端优化内核与整模型且经验难以复用的问题，提出基于持久知识库和文本梯度下降的 MAIC-RL 智能体框架 ModelBlaster。

papers.title: Say Less, Mean Better: Training-Free Verbosity Control for Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often generate responses longer than necessary, increasing inference latency and computational cost. While prompting can encourage conciseness, controlling output length without compromising response completeness remains challenging. Aggressive early stopping can reduce generation costs but risks terminating responses prematurely. We introduce MinimalLM, a training-free framework for reliable verbosity control that combines uncertainty-aware, length-dependent stop-token adjustment with structural completeness guardrails. MinimalLM separates the decision of when to stop from whether stopping is structurally appropriate, coordinating response-level instructions, decoding-time intervention, and completion checks without modifying model parameters or requiring auxiliary models. We evaluate MinimalLM across three open-source LLMs and 330 questions, producing 5,940 responses across baseline and ablation configurations. MinimalLM reduces generated tokens by 47.6%, accelerates individual responses by 19-68%, and eliminates structurally truncated outputs in the primary evaluation. Despite substantial token savings, it achieves an average quality score of 8.04/10, compared with 8.42/10 for unmodified models and 6.46/10 for length-matched truncation. Evaluations across diverse subject domains (such as healthcare, programming, law, and science) demonstrate robust efficiency gains, while ablations establish the complementary roles of decoding control and completeness constraints. Our findings highlight that efficient generation requires more than producing fewer tokens: it requires controlling when generation ends while preserving response integrity. MinimalLM offers a lightweight, training-free approach toward this goal.

translation.title: 少说但更有意义：语言模型的无训练冗长控制
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）常生成超出必要的长回复，增加推理延迟和计算成本。虽然提示可以鼓励简洁，但在不损害回复完整性的前提下控制输出长度仍然困难。激进的提前停止可以降低生成成本，但有过早终止回复的风险。我们提出 MinimalLM，一个可靠冗长控制的无训练框架，它将不确定性感知的、依赖长度的停止 token 调整与结构完整性护栏相结合。MinimalLM 将何时停止的决策与停止在结构上是否恰当相分离，协调回复级指令、解码时干预和完成度检查，而无需修改模型参数或辅助模型。我们在三个开源 LLM 和 330 个问题上评估 MinimalLM，在基线和消融配置下产生 5,940 条回复。MinimalLM 将生成 token 减少 47.6%，将单条回复加速 19-68%，并在主要评估中消除了结构性截断输出。尽管大幅节省 token，其平均质量得分为 8.04/10，而未修改模型为 8.42/10，长度匹配截断为 6.46/10。跨多领域（如医疗、编程、法律和科学）的评估展示了稳健的效率提升，消融实验确立了解码控制与完整性约束的互补作用。我们的发现表明，高效生成不仅仅是产生更少的 token：还需要在保持回复完整性的同时控制生成何时结束。MinimalLM 为此目标提供了一种轻量、无训练的方法。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM 回复冗长导致推理成本高的问题，提出无训练的 MinimalLM 框架，通过长度相关的停止 token 调整与结构完整性护栏控制输出长度。

papers.title: The Evolution Strategies Paradox: Better Models from Worse Perturbations
papers.abstract: How is it possible for perturbation-based methods like Evolution Strategies (ES) to optimize billion-parameter large language models (LLMs)? Classical search methods are highly dependent on finding good candidates within generated populations. However, when using ES to fine-tune LLMs, a phenomenon can occur where all offspring models consistently perform worse than the parent model, yet during training, the parent model consistently improves. This paradox occurs across models, tasks, and even modalities. This paper characterizes the paradox, then examines how the local reward landscape and properties of the ES estimator contribute to it: in high-dimensional spaces, exploration leads to worse performance, yet still highlights good directions; aggregating those directions then allows for making local improvements. The result can be seen as a new optimization paradigm where a principled interaction of noise and curvature produces the paradox as a byproduct of effective optimization. These findings provide guidance for taking advantage of perturbation-based methods in LLM fine-tuning and in high-dimensional optimization in general.

translation.title: 进化策略悖论：更差的扰动带来更好的模型
translation.abstract: 基于扰动的方法如进化策略（ES）如何能够优化十亿参数的大语言模型（LLM）？经典搜索方法高度依赖于在生成的种群中找到好的候选。然而，当使用 ES 微调 LLM 时，会出现一种现象：所有子代模型一致地表现差于父代模型，但训练过程中父代模型却持续改进。这一悖论跨越模型、任务甚至模态出现。本文刻画了该悖论，然后考察局部奖励景观和 ES 估计器的性质如何促成它：在高维空间中，探索导致更差的性能，却仍然凸显出好的方向；聚合这些方向便能实现局部改进。这一结果可被视为一种新的优化范式，其中噪声与曲率的原则性交互将悖论作为有效优化的副产品产生。这些发现为在 LLM 微调及一般高维优化中利用基于扰动的方法提供了指导。
translation.brief: 该论文研究 ES 微调 LLM 时子代一致劣于父代但父代仍持续改进的悖论，通过分析局部奖励景观与 ES 估计器性质解释噪声与曲率交互如何驱动优化。

papers.title: SciPhi-Chat: Training a Spatial Audio Agent for Question Answering, Dialogue, and Tool Use
papers.abstract: Spatial audio question answering requires associating sound identities with locations and reasoning about their relations. This paper introduces SciPhi-Chat, a spatial audio agent that answers questions, conducts multi-turn dialogue, and calls tools on first-order ambisonic recordings. The accompanying MASU benchmark contains 12,000 samples across 42 task categories, the widest task coverage of any spatial model, with real recordings and simulated audio scenes. SciPhi-Chat achieves a score of 44.9%, 7.4 percentage points above the previous state-of-the-art. On the external ASA-Bench, SciPhi-Chat achieves 74.5% azimuth and 60.0% elevation accuracy, the highest among locally evaluated models. Removing reasoning supervision reduces ASA-Bench accuracy by 17.4 percentage points. All materials will be released via this https URL

papers.title: GlucoAgent: Personalized Glucose Forecasting from Multimodal Personal Context
papers.abstract: Continuous glucose monitors, smartwatches, meal logs, and health profiles form a rich multimodal personal context that can significantly enhance glucose forecasting. However, existing methods struggle to effectively utilize these signals to improve glucose prediction because the relevance of different modalities varies drastically across individuals and time. We present GlucoAgent, an LLM-based agentic system that addresses this challenge through dynamic, case-by-case analysis at inference time. For each forecast, GlucoAgent writes and runs code over an individual's multimodal context and returns predictions with a reason and supporting evidence. The generated programs are highly diverse, ranging from retrieving similar past meals to fitting and back-testing physiological and statistical models. On CGMacros, a multimodal glucose dataset, GlucoAgent outperforms time series foundation models on every forecasting horizon, achieving an average RMSE of 22.5 mg/dL compared to 23.5 mg/dL of Chronos-2, the leading multimodal time series foundation model. Furthermore, GlucoAgent is highly effective at leveraging multimodal data. The addition of multimodal data reduces its average RMSE by 1.4 mg/dL (24.0 mg/dL to 22.5 mg/dL), compared to a marginal 0.3 mg/dL (23.8 mg/dL to 23.5 mg/dL) improvement for Chronos-2. This advantage is most pronounced in challenging post-meal windows, where GlucoAgent uses multimodal context to reduce 60-minute forecast RMSE by 4.6 mg/dL (31.0 mg/dL to 26.5 mg/dL), far exceeding the 0.8 mg/dL (31.9 mg/dL to 31.1 mg/dL) reduction achieved by Chronos-2.

On CGMacros, a multimodal glucose dataset, GlucoAgent outperforms time series foundation models on every forecasting horizon, achieving an average RMSE of 22.5 mg/dL compared to 23.5 mg/dL of Chronos-2, the leading multimodal time series foundation model. Furthermore, GlucoAgent is highly effective at leveraging multimodal data. The addition of multimodal data reduces its average RMSE by 1.4 mg/dL (24.0 mg/dL to 22.5 mg/dL), compared to a marginal 0.3 mg/dL (23.8 mg/dL to 23.5 mg/dL) improvement for Chronos-2. This advantage is most pronounced in challenging post-meal windows, where GlucoAgent uses multimodal context to reduce 60-minute forecast RMSE by 4.6 mg/dL (31.0 mg/dL to 26.5 mg/dL), far exceeding the 0.8 mg/dL (31.9 mg/dL to 31.1 mg/dL) reduction achieved by Chronos-2.

papers.title: Interpretable Early Termination of Web Navigation Agents via Closed Sequential Pattern Mining
papers.abstract: Web navigation agents built on open-weight language models fail often and fail late, with most of the tokens spent after the trajectory has become unrecoverable. Recent work has shown that early termination is a viable cost-reduction strategy, but existing approaches produce opaque termination decisions that do not support diagnosis or human oversight. In this work we apply closed sequential pattern mining (BIDE+) to K-step prefixes of agent execution traces to produce a small, human-reviewable failure-signature library that organizes into a four-category failure taxonomy with associated repair recommendations. We use a multi-variant evaluation protocol that explicitly removes contamination artifacts (zero-step crashes and trivially separable single-step successes) so that reported detection accuracy reflects behavioral discrimination rather than trace-length distributions. We evaluate our methodology on 1,544 MiniWoB++ traces collected from three open-weight language models, achieving the best F1 at K=3 on the Exclude-errors configuration across eight methods (0.717), recovering 88% of test-set failures within three steps, and supporting an early-termination policy that saves 26.3% of tokens at 92% precision.

papers.title: HyPAIC: Personal AI Computer with High Bandwidth Flash for High Performance Trillion-Parameter LLM Inference
papers.abstract: LLMs have rapidly expanded from simple chatbots to agentic AI, where models directly use tools to solve complex problems. To improve problem solving, most frontier LLMs adopt an MoE architecture, pushing model sizes into the trillion-parameter regime. While cloud services have dominated large-scale LLM inference, cost and security concerns drive demand for on-premises deployment. Thus, GPU manufacturers have introduced personal AI computers (PAICs). However, existing PAICs with LPDDR-based unified main memory suffer from severe capacity limitations, restricting hostable LLM size on a single device. If most memory holds model weights, little remains for the KV cache, reducing supported context length. In this paper, we propose HyPAIC, a PAIC architecture incorporating HBF to overcome these memory constraints. HyPAIC stores read-only model weights in HBF and mutable runtime data in LPDDR. HBF offers over 10x the capacity of HBM with comparable TB/s-scale bandwidth. HyPAIC addresses HBF's access latency, limited write endurance, and page-level access granularity through prefetching, read-only weight placement, and coarse-grained weight accesses, respectively; power and cooling remain significant implementation challenges. Through simulation-based evaluation, we show that a single HyPAIC improves end-to-end system throughput by up to 1.04x and TDP-normalized throughput by up to 3.59x during 1T-parameter MoE inference versus the aggregate of eight baseline systems without HBF, one HyPAIC thus approaches the raw performance of eight baselines with far superior power efficiency. For small model inference, HyPAIC increases the maximum number of concurrent tasks sustaining at least 50 decode TPS per task by up to 4x, enhancing user experience and productivity. Although HBF specifications are still evolving, this study demonstrates strong architectural synergy between HBF and PAICs.

papers.title: AdSteer: Native Advertising in Large Language Model Generation
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) services face rapidly rising serving costs. To sustain free or affordable access for a broad user base, alternative monetization mechanisms are needed. Native advertising offers a promising approach, as it creates economic value by aligning user intent with merchant offerings. Yet how to integrate sponsored content naturally into LLM responses remains largely underexplored. Existing approaches primarily rely on prompt-level injection, multi-pass rewriting, or fine-tuning, which can compromise response quality or introduce additional computational costs. We propose AdSteer, a lightweight decoding-time advertising framework that adaptively adjusts token probabilities to integrate contextually appropriate advertisement into responses. AdSteer calibrates the strength and duration of advertising influence, making sponsored content a natural part of the response. Experiments on GEM-Bench across three application scenarios show that AdSteer achieves an average improvement of 14.1% in overall score over the strongest baselines and 22.5% fewer total tokens on average than rewrite-based methods. These results demonstrate that AdSteer provides an effective and practical solution for native advertising in LLMs.

papers.title: Validation-Gated ML Pipeline Synthesis with Expert-Grounded Self-Evolving Skills
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models have enabled agentic systems that automate machine learning pipeline construction from minimal user input. However, existing agentic AutoML methods either depend on rigid templates that limit adaptability, target narrow task domains, or rely on free-form code generation that lacks reliability guarantees, leaving intermediate errors to propagate silently and degrade the final model. We present EvoML, an agentic framework for end-to-end ML pipeline synthesis built on expert-grounded skills that evolve across runs, executed through a validation-gated harness. The framework decomposes pipeline construction into four phases coordinated by three agents: an Orchestrator that enforces validation gates, advancing each phase only when its outputs pass structural, execution, and semantic checks, which precludes error propagation and keeps every artifact auditable; an Executor that runs expert-grounded skills, grounded in the nnU-Net workflow and pairing reusable templates with online adaptation; and a Curator that performs post-run evolution, consolidating the scripts and guidance recovered during a run into the skill library so it improves across datasets. We evaluate EvoML on eight datasets spanning six sophisticated, real-world ML task types, against agentic AutoML systems and command-line coding tools. EvoML achieves full automation and the best final model quality on all eight, spanning segmentation (up to 0.94 Dice), classification (0.99 accuracy), reconstruction (0.95 SSIM), and denoising (0.79 normalized PSNR), while transferring to broader ML tasks.

translation.title: 基于专家经验自演化技能与验证门控的机器学习流水线自动合成
translation.abstract: 大语言模型的最新进展使得能够从极少用户输入自动构建机器学习流水线的智能体系统成为可能。然而，现有的智能体 AutoML 方法要么依赖限制适应性的僵化模板，要么只针对狭窄的任务领域，要么依赖缺乏可靠性保证的自由形式代码生成，导致中间错误静默传播并降低最终模型质量。我们提出 EvoML，一个用于端到端机器学习流水线合成的智能体框架，它建立在跨运行演化的专家经验技能之上，并通过验证门控的执行框架运行。该框架将流水线构建分解为四个阶段，由三个智能体协调：Orchestrator 负责执行验证门控，只有当每个阶段的输出通过结构、执行和语义检查时才推进到下一阶段，从而阻止错误传播并保证每个产物可审计；Executor 运行以 nnU-Net 工作流为基础的专家技能，将可复用模板与在线适配相结合；Curator 执行运行后演化，将运行期间收集的脚本和指导整合进技能库，使其在数据集间不断改进。我们在涵盖六种复杂真实世界机器学习任务类型的八个数据集上，将 EvoML 与智能体 AutoML 系统和命令行编码工具进行对比评估。EvoML 在全部八个数据集上实现了完全自动化和最佳的最终模型质量，涵盖分割（最高 0.94 Dice）、分类（0.99 准确率）、重建（0.95 SSIM）和去噪（0.79 归一化 PSNR），同时可迁移到更广泛的机器学习任务。
translation.brief: 解决现有智能体 AutoML 依赖僵化模板或不可靠自由代码生成导致错误静默传播的问题，提出 EvoML 框架，通过验证门控执行、专家经验技能和运行后技能库演化实现端到端机器学习流水线自动合成。

papers.title: When the Consumer Is an Agent: Execution-Grounded Service-Level Agreements
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly act as service consumers. They select operations and report whether a task is complete. In an asynchronous distributed service, an accepted call or immediate state read does not establish that the required state became observable by its deadline. We introduce execution-grounded completion contracts, which treat completion as a service-level outcome. An independent control plane observes a deadline-bound service-state predicate, admits completion, and directs recovery while the agent performs the task. We evaluate placement and deletion in a live multi-provider data service with heterogeneous models and an injected transfer delay. Across policies, some tasks that missed the deadline were accepted and some that met it were rejected. Under enforcement, accepted completions remained consistent with later observations; all included healthy tasks completed, and unresolved faulted tasks terminated as unverified. The results show that completion of these tasks can be governed by independent observation of service state rather than by the agent's self-assessment.

translation.title: 当消费者是智能体：基于执行的服务级协议
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地充当服务消费者，它们选择操作并报告任务是否完成。在异步分布式服务中，一次被接受的调用或即时的状态读取并不能证明所需状态在截止期限内变得可观察。我们引入基于执行完成的完成契约，将完成视为一种服务级结果。一个独立的控制平面观察受截止期限约束的服务状态谓词，批准完成，并在智能体执行任务期间引导恢复。我们在一个具有异构模型和注入传输延迟的在线多提供商数据服务上评估了放置和删除操作。在各种策略下，一些错过截止期限的任务被接受，而一些满足期限的任务被拒绝。在强制执行下，被接受的完成与后续观察保持一致；所有被纳入的健康任务均完成，未解决的故障任务以未验证状态终止。结果表明，这些任务的完成可以由对服务状态的独立观察来治理，而不是由智能体的自我评估决定。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 智能体自我报告任务完成不可靠的问题，提出由独立控制平面观察截止期限约束的服务状态谓词来批准完成并引导恢复的执行落地完成契约。

papers.title: Agentic Path Maps: Exposing an Agent's Traversal Through the Garden of Forking Paths
papers.abstract: When an AI agent executes an underspecified task, it embeds choices that may contradict unarticulated user context and preferences. However, interrupting the user for clarification on all such decisions is untenable. How might agents communicate impactful, but unexplored, paths to the user after execution? To investigate, we first distill a design space for communicating alternative paths, supporting the generation of new systems and structuring dimensions of future study. We then measure the impact of one vital design space dimension on user comprehension: the number of alternatives displayed. Through a user study (n=48) in the data analysis domain, we find that participants rarely consider alternative paths of their own volition, but AI overreliance reduces when alternative paths are visualized for them. By revealing paths the agent did not take, we demonstrate how users can better interpret results and incorporate personal context.

translation.title: 智能体路径地图：揭示智能体在分岔路径花园中的行进轨迹
translation.abstract: 当 AI 智能体执行一个欠规范的任务时，它会嵌入可能与用户未明说的上下文和偏好相矛盾的选择。然而，对所有此类决策都打断用户进行澄清是不可行的。智能体如何在执行之后向用户传达那些有影响但未被探索的路径？为研究这一问题，我们首先提炼出一个用于传达替代路径的设计空间，支持新系统的生成并为未来研究的维度提供结构。然后，我们测量其中一个关键设计维度——展示的替代路径数量——对用户理解的影响。通过一项数据分析领域的用户研究（n=48），我们发现参与者很少主动考虑替代路径，但当替代路径被可视化呈现时，对 AI 的过度依赖会降低。通过揭示智能体未走的路径，我们展示了用户如何能更好地解读结果并融入个人上下文。
translation.brief: 解决智能体执行欠规范任务时嵌入的隐含选择与用户偏好冲突且无法逐一澄清的问题，提出传达替代路径的设计空间并研究展示替代路径数量对用户理解和 AI 过度依赖的影响。

papers.title: DoGNAVY-Exploit: Harnessing Parallel Open-Weight Agents for Stage-Aware Vulnerability Exploitation
papers.abstract: Frontier LLM agents can turn known vulnerabilities into working exploits, but are costly and often access-restricted due to their potential for malicious use. Open-weight models offer a more accessible alternative, but struggle to maintain progress across long exploitation chains. They also often fail to apply relevant security knowledge at the appropriate stage and in the right context to identify and evaluate promising attack directions. To address these limitations, we propose DoGNAVY-Exploit, a multi-agent harness built around two complementary designs: stage-aware decomposition with progressive expert knowledge disclosure, and hierarchical orchestration with parallel exploration. Specifically, DoGNAVY-Exploit uses configurable milestones to recast long-horizon exploitation as short, verifiable capability transitions and provides only the knowledge relevant to each stage. Within each milestone, a hierarchical architecture separates strategic planning from parallel execution: a planner proposes diverse attack routes, executors test them concurrently, and a controller accepts progress only when supported by runtime evidence. A shared structured memory consolidates verified facts, artifacts, replay steps, and failed routes across branches, allowing agents to build on collective progress and carry validated knowledge into subsequent milestones. In controlled benchmark environments, DoGNAVY-Exploit with GLM-5.2 achieves 97.5% Pass@1 on Cybench, and 97.5% zero-day and 100% one-day Pass@1 on CVE-Bench. On ExploitGym, it solves 79 tasks with GLM-5.2 and 157 with GLM-5.3, while the corresponding public Claude Code baselines solve 39 and 130 tasks, respectively. Ablation results further demonstrate that the stage-aware orchestration, expert knowledge, parallel exploration, and memory designs can substantially improve the exploitation capabilities of open-weight agents.

translation.title: DoGNAVY-Exploit：利用并行开源权重智能体实现阶段感知的漏洞利用
translation.abstract: 前沿 LLM 智能体能够将已知漏洞转化为可用的 exploit，但成本高昂且因潜在恶意用途而常受访问限制。开源权重模型提供了更易获取的替代方案，但难以在长漏洞利用链中保持进展，也常常无法在合适的阶段和上下文中应用相关安全知识来识别和评估有前景的攻击方向。为解决这些局限，我们提出 DoGNAVY-Exploit，一个围绕两个互补设计构建的多智能体框架：带渐进式专家知识披露的阶段感知分解，以及带并行探索的分层编排。具体而言，DoGNAVY-Exploit 使用可配置的里程碑将长程漏洞利用转化为短小、可验证的能力跃迁，并仅提供与各阶段相关的知识。在每个里程碑内，分层架构将战略规划与并行执行分离：规划器提出多样化的攻击路线，执行器并发测试这些路线，控制器仅在运行时证据支持时才接受进展。共享的结构化记忆整合跨分支的已验证事实、产物、重放步骤和失败路线，使智能体能够基于集体进展并在后续里程碑中携带已验证的知识。在受控基准环境中，使用 GLM-5.2 的 DoGNAVY-Exploit 在 Cybench 上达到 97.5% Pass@1，在 CVE-Bench 上达到 97.5% 零日和 100% 一日 Pass@1。在 ExploitGym 上，它用 GLM-5.2 解决 79 个任务、用 GLM-5.3 解决 157 个任务，而相应的公开 Claude Code 基线分别解决 39 和 130 个任务。消融结果进一步表明，阶段感知编排、专家知识、并行探索和记忆设计能显著提升开源权重智能体的漏洞利用能力。
translation.brief: 解决开源权重模型在长漏洞利用链中难以保持进展且无法在合适阶段应用安全知识的问题，提出带渐进式专家知识披露的阶段感知分解与分层并行编排的多智能体框架 DoGNAVY-Exploit。

papers.title: Toward User-Centered Agentic Recommendation: When Does Platform Competition Benefit Users?
papers.abstract: Conventional recommender systems operate within platform-specific catalogs, limiting access to potentially valuable resources across platforms. We propose user-centered agentic recommendation, a paradigm in which user agents compare recommendations from competing platform agents, and formalize their interaction as a repeated game. Platforms strategically modify descriptions without changing intrinsic item value, while each user agent assesses platform credibility using feedback from consumed items only. Our analysis shows that expanded resource access need not improve user welfare: strategic misrepresentation and limited verification can offset the benefits of platform competition. We quantify when platform credibility assessment allows users to benefit from broader access despite strategic exaggeration. Our analysis identifies resource and reporting conditions that guarantee higher average welfare than the original platform with an interaction budget linear in platform count. Experiments on synthetic and Amazon-grounded markets show that credibility assessment can improve finite-horizon utility, while its benefits depend on market size and mechanism parameters.

translation.title: 迈向以用户为中心的智能体推荐：平台竞争何时使用户受益？
translation.abstract: 传统推荐系统在平台特定的目录内运行，限制了对跨平台潜在有价值资源的访问。我们提出以用户为中心的智能体推荐，这是一种用户智能体比较来自竞争平台智能体的推荐的新范式，并将其交互形式化为重复博弈。平台在不改变物品内在价值的情况下策略性地修改描述，而每个用户智能体仅使用已消费物品的反馈来评估平台可信度。我们的分析表明，扩大资源访问未必改善用户福利：策略性虚假陈述和有限的验证能力可能抵消平台竞争的收益。我们量化了在何种条件下平台可信度评估能让用户在策略性夸大存在的情况下从更广泛的访问中受益。我们的分析识别了保证平均福利高于原始平台的资源和报告条件，且交互预算与平台数量呈线性关系。在合成市场和基于 Amazon 的市场上的实验表明，可信度评估可以提升有限时域效用，但其收益取决于市场规模和机制参数。
translation.brief: 研究用户智能体在竞争平台间比较推荐时平台竞争何时真正惠及用户的问题，将其形式化为重复博弈并分析基于消费反馈的平台可信度评估在策略性描述夸大下的作用条件。

papers.title: Are We Just Applying LLMs? What SE Research Studies, Underexplores, and Could Do Next in the LLM Era
papers.abstract: Is AI taking over software engineering research? By 2025, AI appeared in more than half of the research-track papers at ICSE, FSE, and ASE. Yet ubiquity alone cannot show whether AI expanded the publication portfolio, displaced other work, or redirected the intellectual agenda. We investigate this shift through a census of 4,790 research papers (three SE conferences; 2018--2026) and free-form responses from 244 SE researchers discussing the future of the SE research community (ICSE 2026 FoSE survey). We found that while AI is taking over, it is not simply replacing non-AI research; it is unevenly reorganizing SE research around its capabilities. AI accounted for 93.1% of publication growth, but expansion in some venues and problem areas concealed contraction in others. The LLM wave also changed the field's tools more than its problem boundaries: 92.6% of LLM-wave AI papers revisit established SE problems, while most new problems arise from the introduction of LLMs in the SE process themselves. Engagement with AI remains predominantly downstream: 95.7% of AI papers apply AI or evaluate and support its use, while only 4.3% interrogate the paradigm or develop alternatives. The FoSE survey reveals a similar imbalance between recognition and response. AI-driven change was the second-most frequent concern about the field's future 20.2%, yet only 7.0% of responses mentioned AI when researchers were asked to identify one change the community should make. Together, our findings reveal a field reorganizing an inherited agenda around AI faster than it is questioning that reorganization. We discuss how SE can respond by building cumulatively across technological waves, strengthening evaluation and assurance, developing SE-native foundations, and studying software engineering in an AI-transformed world.

translation.title: 我们只是在应用LLM吗？LLM时代软件工程研究在研究什么、忽视什么以及下一步可以做什么
translation.abstract: AI正在接管软件工程研究吗？到2025年，AI出现在ICSE、FSE和ASE超过一半的研究track论文中。然而，仅凭普及程度无法说明AI是扩展了发表版图、挤占了其他工作，还是改变了学术议程。我们通过对4,790篇研究论文（三个SE会议；2018–2026）的普查以及244位SE研究者关于社区未来的自由回答（ICSE 2026 FoSE调查）来考察这一转变。我们发现，虽然AI正在接管，但它并非简单取代非AI研究，而是围绕其能力不均衡地重组SE研究。AI占发表增长的93.1%，但某些会议和问题领域的扩张掩盖了其他领域的收缩。LLM浪潮改变的工具多于问题边界：92.6%的LLM浪潮AI论文 revisit 已有的SE问题，而大多数新问题源于LLM引入SE过程本身。与AI的互动仍以下游为主：95.7%的AI论文应用AI或评估、支持其使用，仅4.3%质疑该范式或开发替代方案。FoSE调查揭示了类似的认知与回应失衡。AI驱动的变化是对领域未来第二常见的担忧（20.2%），但当被问及社区应做出的一项改变时，仅7.0%的回答提到AI。我们的发现表明，该领域围绕AI重组既有议程的速度快于质疑这种重组的速度。我们讨论SE如何回应：在技术浪潮中实现累积性建设、加强评估与保障、发展SE原生基础，以及研究AI变革世界中的软件工程。
translation.brief: 通过论文普查和研究者调查考察LLM对软件工程研究议程的重组方式，发现AI应用占主导而范式反思不足。

papers.title: LENS: Reliability-Aware Stock Prediction via LLM-Extracted Priors and News-Driven Semantic Graphs
papers.abstract: Predicting stock returns requires modeling persistent company relations and time-varying market signals. Graph Neural Network (GNN) approaches combine static priors with dynamic relational graphs, but treat every extracted edge as a trustworthy binary fact, ignoring heterogeneous reliability across relational sources. We propose LENS (LLM-Extracted priors and News-driven Semantics), a static--dynamic graph framework for stock return prediction and ranking that models relational reliability as a first-class signal across the pipeline. On the static side, we extract a multi-relational company graph from a Large Language Model and aggregate it over multiple runs with confidence weighting to downweight low-consistency edges. On the dynamic side, we build a news-driven semantic graph with exponential-decay temporal aggregation to capture changing market context under uneven coverage. A context-dependent gated fusion module rebalances the two graphs at the per-stock, per-day level. On S&P 500, LENS improves AR@5 by 16.4% and SR@5 by 22.6% over the strongest baseline, and on NASDAQ 100 it achieves comparable improvements (15.5% and 20.9% respectively). Ablations isolate each component's contribution, and a human-validation study of sampled relations supports that the aggregation is grounded, providing evidence that reliability-aware LLM relations and news-based semantic graphs carry complementary information for graph-based financial prediction.

translation.title: LENS：基于LLM提取先验和新闻驱动语义图的可靠性感知股票预测
translation.abstract: 预测股票收益需要建模持久的公司关系和时变的市场信号。图神经网络（GNN）方法结合静态先验与动态关系图，但将每条提取的边视为可信的二元事实，忽略了不同关系来源间的异构可靠性。我们提出LENS（LLM-Extracted priors and News-driven Semantics），一个用于股票收益预测和排序的静态–动态图框架，将关系可靠性作为贯穿全流程的一等信号。静态方面，我们从大语言模型提取多关系公司图，并在多次运行中用置信度加权聚合以降低低一致性边的权重。动态方面，我们构建新闻驱动的语义图，采用指数衰减时间聚合以在不均匀覆盖下捕捉变化的市场环境。一个依赖上下文的门控融合模块在每只股票、每天层面重新平衡两个图。在S&P 500上，LENS较最强基线将AR@5提升16.4%、SR@5提升22.6%；在NASDAQ 100上取得相当提升（分别为15.5%和20.9%）。消融实验分离了各组件贡献，对抽样关系的人工验证支持聚合的可靠性，证明可靠性感知的LLM关系与新闻语义图为基于图的金融预测提供互补信息。
translation.brief: 针对GNN股票预测中忽略关系来源可靠性差异的问题，提出将LLM提取的公司关系图与新闻语义图进行可靠性加权融合的框架。

papers.title: IntentGEO: Intent-aware Generative Engine Optimization for Recommendation
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly shape recommendations across chatbots, e-commerce, and user-generated content (UGC) platforms, creating demand for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) to improve item visibility in generated responses. Existing GEO studies are mainly content-centric, optimizing visibility under general-purpose queries. However, a shared item description usually serves users with different needs and decision goals, resulting in its visibility gains being dependent on the request. To investigate how changing intent affects visibility, we formulate IntentGEO to evaluate shared rewrites across need specificity and decision progression. We revisit existing GEO methods and find that their visibility gains vary across user intents. More critically, learning-based prompt optimization can underperform its handwritten seed on average. Tracing these updates reveals prompt drift from explicit recommendation instructions toward generic promotional tactics. To address this drift, we propose AMO (Anchored Meta-Optimization), which preserves recommendation instructions in a fixed core while learning appended strategies from citation feedback. Across four domains and ten intent states, AMO improves average citation-rank gain by 35% over the strongest prior learning-based baseline and leads on nine states. Ablations show that learned additions improve on the fixed core alone and that AMO outperforms full-prompt optimization initialized from that core. It also achieves the highest gains in an agentic recommendation pipeline and, after separate adaptation, on Doubao, a commercially deployed, closed-source online assistant. These findings highlight user intent as a key dimension of GEO evaluation and support anchored adaptation across recommendation needs and decision stages.

translation.title: IntentGEO：面向推荐的意图感知生成式引擎优化
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）日益影响聊天机器人、电商和用户生成内容（UGC）平台上的推荐，催生了对生成式引擎优化（GEO）的需求，以提升物品在生成回答中的可见性。现有GEO研究主要以内容为中心，在通用查询下优化可见性。然而，同一份物品描述通常服务于具有不同需求和决策目标的用户，使其可见性收益依赖于请求。为考察意图变化如何影响可见性，我们提出IntentGEO，从需求具体性和决策进程两个维度评估共享改写。我们重新审视现有GEO方法，发现其可见性收益随用户意图而变化。更关键的是，基于学习的提示优化平均可能不如其手写种子提示。追踪这些更新发现提示从明确的推荐指令漂移为泛化的推广话术。为解决这种漂移，我们提出AMO（Anchored Meta-Optimization），将推荐指令固定在核心部分，同时从引用反馈中学习附加策略。在四个领域、十种意图状态下，AMO较最强学习基线将平均引用排名增益提升35%，并在九种状态上领先。消融显示学习到的附加内容优于仅用固定核心，且AMO优于从该核心初始化的全提示优化。它在agentic推荐流程中取得最高增益，并在单独适配后于商业部署的闭源在线助手Doubao上同样领先。这些发现凸显用户意图是GEO评估的关键维度，支持跨推荐需求和决策阶段的锚定适配。
translation.brief: 针对GEO方法在不同用户意图下收益不稳及提示漂移问题，提出固定推荐指令核心、从引用反馈学习附加策略的锚定元优化方法AMO。

papers.title: DualWorldBench: Can Agents Plan Deliveries across Symbolic and Grounded Worlds?
papers.abstract: Recent multimodal agents have shown promising progress in embodied planning and web interaction. However, existing evaluations often rely on simplified tasks with limited combinatorial structure, leaving it unclear whether current agents can robustly integrate perception and reasoning for multi-goal planning under temporal, physical, and multimodal constraints. We introduce DualWorldBench, a unified benchmark for evaluating agent planning under controlled symbolic--temporal and grounded--topological complexity. Built around a shared pickup--delivery interface, DualWorldBench consists of three complementary components: TextWorld, which isolates symbolic planning under varying task compositions and release dynamics; SimWorld, which evaluates grounded path planning under controlled topological variation with text, image, or multimodal inputs; and DualWorld-VQA, a diagnostic suite spanning perception, scene understanding, and planning. Experiments reveal a common gap between local understanding and globally consistent planning. In TextWorld, agents struggle to derive optimal task sequences under interacting temporal constraints; in SimWorld, grounded observations are not reliably converted into feasible action sequences. DualWorld-VQA further confirms that perception and topology understanding do not necessarily translate into constrained planning. Together, these results identify the central challenge as composing symbolic or grounded evidence into globally feasible and efficient multi-goal plans. These findings establish DualWorldBench as a challenging testbed for agents with tighter perception--reasoning--planning integration. All datasets and code are publicly available at our project website this https URL.

translation.title: DualWorldBench：智能体能否在符号世界与具身世界间规划配送？
translation.abstract: 近期多模态智能体在具身规划和网页交互方面进展可观。然而，现有评估往往依赖组合结构有限的简化任务，尚不清楚当前智能体能否在时间、物理和多模态约束下稳健地整合感知与推理以进行多目标规划。我们提出DualWorldBench，一个在受控的符号–时间与具身–拓扑复杂度下评估智能体规划的统一基准。围绕共享的取货–配送接口，DualWorldBench包含三个互补组件：TextWorld，在不同任务组合和发布动态下隔离符号规划；SimWorld，在受控拓扑变化下以文本、图像或多模态输入评估具身路径规划；以及DualWorld-VQA，一个涵盖感知、场景理解和规划的诊断套件。实验揭示了局部理解与全局一致规划之间的普遍差距：在TextWorld中，智能体难以在交互的时间约束下推导最优任务序列；在SimWorld中，具身观察未能可靠转化为可行的动作序列。DualWorld-VQA进一步证实感知和拓扑理解并不必然转化为受约束的规划。这些结果指出核心挑战在于将符号或具身证据组合为全局可行且高效的多目标规划。这些发现使DualWorldBench成为对感知–推理–规划更紧密整合的智能体的挑战性测试平台。所有数据集和代码已在项目网站公开。
translation.brief: 针对现有评估难以检验智能体在多约束下整合感知与推理进行多目标规划的问题，构建了包含符号、具身和诊断组件的统一规划基准DualWorldBench。

papers.title: Constructing a Regional Slang Lexicon for Electricity Demands via Soft-Label Bidirectional Anchoring and Active Learning
papers.abstract: Power-grid customer service increasingly relies on community social media, where customers describe outages, billing, and equipment faults in informal regional dialect. Such messages exhibit non-standard morphology, semantic drift, and out-of-vocabulary expressions that make manual lexicon construction costly and degrade conventional NLP tools. We propose a weak-supervision framework constructing a regional slang lexicon from curated dialect anchors and power-domain seed terms. Candidates are generated via Pointwise Mutual Information with soft-label bidirectional anchoring, retaining dialect-anchored terms while recording power-domain relevance as separate metadata, and are scored by combining Sentence-BERT semantic similarity with a jieba-based wordhood measure. Uncertainty-aware active learning with rule-based and retrieval-augmented LLM oracles is applied under three query strategies, and the resulting lexicon is evaluated by a higher-capability LLM calibrated against human expert annotations via Cohen's $\kappa$. On 11,177 real WeChat messages from Yuxi (Yunnan, China), the framework achieves an evaluator-estimated dialect precision of DP~$=$~1.0 with zero false positives. An ablation shows that soft-label layering retains 751\% more candidates than strict power-gating at identical precision, expanding the candidate pool from 41 to 349 terms. Human calibration ($n=46$) yields $\kappa_{\text{dialect}}=1.0$ and $\kappa_{\text{power}}=0.85$. The resulting 25--33-term lexicon, 4--5 of which are power-relevant, provides a preliminary resource for dialect-aware power-grid service NLP.

translation.title: 基于软标签双向锚定与主动学习的电力需求区域俚语词典构建
translation.abstract: 电网客服日益依赖社区社交媒体，客户在其中用非正式区域方言描述停电、计费和设备故障。此类消息呈现非规范形态、语义漂移和词表外表达，使人工词典构建成本高昂并降低传统NLP工具的效果。我们提出一个弱监督框架，从精选的方言锚点和电力领域种子词构建区域俚语词典。候选词通过点互信息结合软标签双向锚定生成，保留方言锚定词同时将电力领域相关性作为独立元数据记录，并结合Sentence-BERT语义相似度与基于jieba的成词性度量进行打分。在三种查询策略下应用不确定性感知的主动学习，使用基于规则和检索增强的LLM oracle，所得词典由经人工专家标注校准（Cohen's κ）的更强LLM评估。在来自中国云南玉溪的11,177条真实微信消息上，该框架达到评估器估计的方言精确率DP=1.0且零误报。消融显示，在相同精确率下软标签分层比严格电力门控多保留751%的候选词，将候选池从41个扩展到349个词。人工校准（n=46）得到κ_dialect=1.0、κ_power=0.85。最终25–33个词的词典（其中4–5个与电力相关）为方言感知的电网服务NLP提供了初步资源。
translation.brief: 针对电网客服社交媒体中区域方言导致的词典构建难题，提出结合软标签双向锚定、主动学习与LLM oracle的弱监督俚语词典构建框架。

papers.title: AceAction-5M: Hierarchical Goals for Generalist Action Learning Across 3D Game Worlds
papers.abstract: Video games provide a practical setting for collecting vision-language-action (VLA) data, whose acquisition in physical environments is costly. Existing datasets, however, remain limited by restricted game coverage, sparse language supervision, or temporal hierarchies that do not necessarily reflect changes in task objectives. We introduce AceAction, a dataset of human gameplay across multiple 3D games for learning skill composition and subgoal transitions. AceAction organizes demonstrations around complete tasks, linking overall instructions, ordered subgoals, and local skill instructions to temporally aligned visual observations and keyboard-and-mouse actions. To construct these annotations, we develop a vision-language model pipeline that identifies subgoals from changes in objectives or interaction targets, anchors navigation goals to visually recognizable waypoints, and composes adjacent subgoals into task instructions. The resulting demonstrations cover navigation, reconnaissance, combat, interaction, and recovery, with explicit stage boundaries that connect task progression to fine-grained control. We assess annotation quality through model-based verification and human inspection. An audit of 500 trajectories yields a 95.8% pass rate across independent reviewer assessments. AceAction provides a data foundation for studying how agents execute, combine, and switch skills to follow complex instructions in dynamic game environments.

papers.title: Navigating Runtime Dynamism in Semantic Query Serving
papers.abstract: LLM-powered semantic queries increasingly combine relational processing with multiple LLM-based operators over unstructured data. Efficiently serving such queries is challenging due to runtime dynamism at two coupled levels. Across queries, dynamic arrivals and heterogeneous resource demands continuously change scheduling priorities. Within a query, heterogeneous characteristics across fine-grained input batches cause operator costs and selectivities to vary throughout execution, making a statically optimized plan unreliable. These two forms of dynamism create a circular dependency: inter-query scheduling requires estimates of remaining LLM work, while the remaining work depends on runtime plan choices whose costs become observable only during execution. We present SeqoFlow, a runtime framework that jointly adapts query plans and schedules concurrent semantic queries. SeqoFlow enumerates equivalence-preserving plan alternatives under operator dependencies and decomposes queries into fine-grained units, enabling safe plan adaptation and query preemption at batch boundaries. To support both decisions without exhaustively profiling candidate plans on the target LLM, SeqoFlow uses lightweight speculative estimation to capture runtime costs. These estimates jointly guide plan adaptation and inter-query scheduling, closing the loop between query optimization and LLM inference. Experiments across diverse query structures, data distributions, and arrival rates show that SeqoFlow substantially reduces end-to-end latency compared to existing semantic query systems, adaptive query processing techniques, and conventional scheduling policies.
