papers.title: COMPREHEND: Ultra-Fine-Grained Benchmark Understanding by Entailment Hierarchy
papers.abstract: Understanding what kind of prompts users typically ask and how well an LLM performs on these prompt categories is crucial for LLM practitioners. The existing methods satisfy the demand by hierarchically clustering the user prompts and synthesizing the cluster names using an LLM to build a taxonomy. However, the cluster names from these methods are usually too general for humans to understand the detailed prompt distributions and identify the exact strengths and weaknesses of LLMs. In this study, we propose COMPREHEND, which automatically constructs an ultra-fine-grained entailment hierarchy for the prompts. The entailment hierarchy replaces the cluster names in the taxonomy with sentences to provide more precise cluster descriptions for more fine-grained categorization. Compared with EvalTree, a state-of-the-art taxonomy construction method, COMPREHEND improves an entailment/faithfulness metric from 22.6 to 41.7 and an informative metric from 16.3 to 39.1 in WildBench. Our experiments also show that the weakness report generated based on our entailment hierarchy is much more informative than EvalTree in terms of predicting the response scores in the benchmark. All the code is released in this https URL.

papers.title: UMLoad: Fast On-Demand Model Loading on Unified Memory Architecture
papers.abstract: On-demand model loading dominates response latency for interactive on-device AI, yet unified memory architectures (UMAs), now common on edge devices, should make it cheap by placing weights in memory the GPU already sees. However, frameworks still use the loading flow built for discrete GPUs, leaving significant inefficiencies. This paper presents UMLoad, a system-level model-loading accelerator that decouples a framework's logical allocations from their physical page backing. UMLoad uses on-demand reconstruction to eliminate the weight copy while preserving copy independence, and GPU-assisted page zeroing to accelerate runtime allocation while preserving its security guarantee. Implemented on Intel, AMD, and NVIDIA UMA platforms and evaluated with this http URL, PyTorch, and vLLM across six models, UMLoad reduces average loading time by 36.6%-71.9% over vanilla and 19.9%-62.7% over pipelined loaders, and cuts mean LLM-routing time to first token (TTFT) by 51.3%-59.3% and model-backed tool completion latency by 10.2%-31.6%.

papers.title: Weight-Space Programming for Improving Image-Restoration Diffusion Models: Technical Conjectures and a Recursive Improvement Loop
papers.abstract: Can an LLM directly edit the weights of a diffusion-based image-restoration model to \emph{improve} restoration quality---without gradients, paired data, or fine-tuning? Recent experiments show frontier LLMs can fix structural bugs by modifying as little as \(0.016\%\) of parameters, but cannot instill new capabilities. We ask whether weight-space programming (WSP) can move from \emph{debugging} to \emph{improvement} in the precise-regression setting of image restoration (deblurring, super-resolution, denoising, inpainting). Restoration diffusion UNets present a middle ground: low-level signal-processing layers are concentrated enough for targeted weight-direction edits, while high-level semantic layers remain distributed and resistant to sparse modification. We propose three technical conjectures: (C1) an LLM can localize the layer behind a quality gap (over-smoothing, color shift, hallucinated texture) within a 200 forward-pass budget; (C2) editing a small set of identified weight directions (e.g., scaling high-frequency filter norms, correcting output-bias channels) can measurably improve PSNR and perceptual quality; (C3) a recursive loop---diagnose \(\rightarrow\) edit \(\rightarrow\) evaluate \(\rightarrow\) re-diagnose---can compound gains across rounds, forming a minimal recursive self-improvement (RSI) loop for vision. We analyze the required AI capability (arguing targeted edits need not superintelligence, while general capability generation does) and detail the challenges of precise pixel-level regression. We provide a PyTorch-style deployment pipeline and outline a benchmark. This manuscript is conjectural, intended to open a new subtopic for image restoration.

We propose three technical conjectures: (C1) an LLM can localize the layer behind a quality gap (over-smoothing, color shift, hallucinated texture) within a 200 forward-pass budget; (C2) editing a small set of identified weight directions (e.g., scaling high-frequency filter norms, correcting output-bias channels) can measurably improve PSNR and perceptual quality; (C3) a recursive loop---diagnose \(\rightarrow\) edit \(\rightarrow\) evaluate \(\rightarrow\) re-diagnose---can compound gains across rounds, forming a minimal recursive self-improvement (RSI) loop for vision. We analyze the required AI capability (arguing targeted edits need not superintelligence, while general capability generation does) and detail the challenges of precise pixel-level regression. We provide a PyTorch-style deployment pipeline and outline a benchmark. This manuscript is conjectural, intended to open a new subtopic for image restoration.

papers.title: Harness-S: Learning from Sibling Harnesses for Generalizable Agent Training
papers.abstract: Harness evolution from a common base exhibits Locality, Complementarity, and Nonstationarity: variants repair different failures, and their utility changes as the policy learns. Rather than seeking a universally superior harness, we introduce Harness-S to selectively rescue failures of a base execution system through sibling harnesses and transfer the resulting capabilities into a single policy that remains effective under the original harness. Directional Harness Evolution develops specialized sibling harnesses along distinct repair directions, forming a reusable Sibling Harness Pool that remains fixed during policy training. Complementary Harness Rescue Training invokes this pool only when all initial attempts under the base harness fail. The same policy generates fresh rollouts under selected auxiliary harnesses, and these trajectories replace the failed group for reinforcement learning. An Adaptive Harness Router selects the Top-k variants using Harness Behavior Profiles and voting across multiple LLMs. Policy-aware profile re-anchoring refreshes this evidence as the policy learns. Across AppWorld, SWE-Gym, and DBBench, the trained policy substantially outperforms policy-only training when returned to the original base harness. Behavioral analyses and held-out cases support the transfer of harness-elicited behaviors into the policy itself. Reusing the router for Rank-1 inference provides additional gains at the same executor rollout count.

papers.title: When Debate Amplifies Risk: Social-Bias Vulnerabilities in Multi-Agent Safety Deliberation
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented Web applications increasingly employ multi-agent debate (MAD) to aggregate conflicting, noisy, and heterogeneous information, yet deliberation is fundamentally a social process susceptible to interpersonal dynamics. When retrieved Web sources contain latent hazards alongside safe factual content, social biases such as conformity pressure and authority deference can override evidence-grounded safety boundaries. In this work, we investigate whether the social structure of deliberation can paradoxically amplify latent Web safety risks. We introduce SafeConflict-Bias, a controlled counterfactual diagnostic protocol spanning six core Web risk categories, which holds queries and retrieved evidence strictly invariant while isolating conversational majority sway, authority cues, and confidence asymmetry. Empirical evaluation across diverse proprietary and open-source backbones reveals that while isolated models reliably reject unsafe guidance, standard MAD catastrophically capitulates to social pressure---surging unsafe adoption from 0.0\% up to 100.0\% and systematically silencing safe minority evidence. To resolve this systemic fragility without retraining or debate regeneration, we propose RiskTrace-Debias, an inference-time auditing framework uniting evidence-first precommitment, social-metadata masking, and consistency-gated arbitration. RiskTrace-Debias suppresses worst-case unsafe adoption to $\le 2.0\%$ across all architectures without inducing over-refusal, while generating verifiable provenance traces to audit interpersonal manipulation in Web deliberation.

papers.title: Can Benign Skills Induce Misaligned Behavior in LLM Agents?
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on reusable skills to plan tasks, invoke tools, recover from errors, and complete workflows without modifying model parameters. Although these skills are typically developed to enhance benign tasks, they may also make an agent more capable of executing procedures for harmful purposes. We study this risk, which we call skill-induced behavioral misalignment: adding benign skills may cause an agent to execute external actions that violate safety requirements. We first conduct a systematic study to validate the existence of this phenomenon. It compares agents with and without benign skills across five LLM backbones and three benchmarks under matched requests. On average, skill augmentation improves benign task accuracy by 10.3 percentage points (pp), but also increases unsafe action rate (UAR) by 10.3 pp. The regression also occurs with skills curated by experts. A paired trajectory analysis shows that 24 of 50 newly unsafe trajectories fail to complete the harmful objective, revealing violations that task completion alone would miss. We further disclose multiple factors and scenarios that could exacerbate this risk. (1) Evolving skills with benign feedback can amplify unsafe execution; (2) This regression is more pronounced when retrieved skills are matched to task and contain procedural guidance; (3) Distilling benign experience into reusable skills yield higher UAR compared with their source trajectories. (4) A guard that checks proposed tool actions before execution reduces violations while retaining gains on benign tasks. All these findings confirm the significance of skill-induced behavioral misalignment, and the urgent need for new mitigation solutions.

papers.title: OSGR: Observation-Support Graph Reasoning for Earth Observation Question Answering
papers.abstract: Answering geographic queries over Earth observation (EO) archives requires solving a joint retrieval-and-derivation problem under strict spatiotemporal constraints. Existing LLM agents fail to ground observation items or suffer from search-space explosion. We propose OSGR, a two-stage framework that factorizes this search into offline symbolic concept deduction and online Relation-Conditioned Grounding. OSGR leverages an offline Observation-Support Graph to deduce valid target-to-result support paths at the concept level, and applies spatiotemporal compatibility kernels to instantiate grounded observation-item sets. On Earth-Bench and DisasterM3-Reason, OSGR improves GPT-4o accuracy from 49.3\% to 63.7\% while reducing the execution-step ratio from 2.9 to 2.5.

papers.title: FlowTranslator: Training-Free In-Image Machine Translation with Flow-Based Editing
papers.abstract: In-image machine translation (IIMT) replaces text in an image with its translation while preserving the surrounding visual context. Existing task-specific models achieve convincing performance but require massive paired training images before and after translation. As advanced text-to-image (T2I) models have reached a practically usable level of multilingual text generation, we argue that this capability can be transferred to IIMT and present FlowTranslator. It is a training-free IIMT framework that first employs an OCR model and an LLM to generate the translation prompt, which is injected into the T2I-based diffusion model. To optimize the accurate and natural generation of translated text, we introduce two trajectory controls: Region Coupling Release (RCR) partially decorrelates target-branch noise inside the text region early in the trajectory, while Coupling Expansion (CE) amplifies the emerging edit displacement mid-trajectory. Under the EasyOCR read-back protocol, FlowTranslator achieves average PRIM BLEU and COMET scores of 20.6 and 57.2, respectively, substantially outperforming the strong training-based baseline UniTranslator. On the more challenging and realistic whole-image ScenePair photographs translated into Chinese, it reaches 40.1\% exact-match accuracy and surpasses existing editing systems, some of which only address the text-rendering stage rather than the complete IIMT task. These results establish flow-based editing as a strong, fully training-free baseline for IIMT.

papers.title: Coarse Semantic Blocks for Efficient Training-Free Sparse Attention
papers.abstract: We introduce a training-free sparse attention method that builds a prompt-specific key index to accelerate both prefill and decoding. The method clusters the keys into large semantic blocks that group tokens from noncontiguous positions. Each query position selects blocks by scoring their centroids and attends to the original keys and values within them. Queries that select the same block are processed together, so prefill stays fast even though each query chooses its own blocks. Large blocks make centroid scoring and this grouped processing cheap, so each query can attend to more tokens in the same time. Larger blocks with a larger token budget can thus be both faster and more accurate on long-context tasks than smaller blocks with a smaller budget. We evaluate two hybrid LLMs, Qwen3.5-4B and 35B-A3B, on one NVIDIA H200. Including the cost of building and using the index, whole-model wall-clock speedups over dense attention are 2.3-2.4x for prefill and 1.7-2.0x for decoding at 512K tokens, and 2.9-3.0x for prefill at 1M. The 35B-A3B model stays close to dense attention on five RULER tasks through 1M, on LongBench-v2 overall, and on MRCR through 256K. The 4B model loses accuracy mainly on multi-key retrieval, yet outperforms dense Qwen3.5-2B, whose latency is similar at 512K, on all three benchmarks.

translation.title: 用于高效免训练稀疏注意力的粗粒度语义块
translation.abstract: 我们提出一种免训练的稀疏注意力方法，通过构建针对特定提示的键索引来加速预填充和解码。该方法将键聚类为大型语义块，把来自非连续位置的 token 分组在一起。每个查询位置通过为块的质心打分来选择块，并关注块内原始的键和值。选择相同块的查询被一起处理，因此即使每个查询选择自己的块，预填充仍然保持快速。大块使得质心打分和这种分组处理开销很低，因此每个查询能在相同时间内关注更多 token。因此，在相同时间预算下，采用更大 token 预算的更大块在长上下文任务上可以比小预算的小块既更快又更准确。我们在一块 NVIDIA H200 上评估了两个混合 LLM：Qwen3.5-4B 和 35B-A3B。包括构建和使用索引的成本，在 512K token 下，整个模型相对稠密注意力的实际加速比为预填充 2.3-2.4 倍、解码 1.7-2.0 倍；在 1M token 下预填充加速 2.9-3.0 倍。35B-A3B 模型在五个 RULER 任务上直到 1M、在 LongBench-v2 整体上、以及在 256K 内的 MRCR 上都保持接近稠密注意力的表现。4B 模型的准确率损失主要出现在多键检索上，但在所有三个基准上都优于稠密的 Qwen3.5-2B（后者在 512K 下延迟相近）。
translation.brief: 提出免训练的稀疏注意力方法，通过将键聚类为粗粒度语义块并按质心打分选择块来加速长上下文的预填充与解码。

papers.title: Drift No More: Spectral Locking for Long-Horizon Open-Weight Multi-Agent AI
papers.abstract: Long-horizon multi-agent systems suffer from three tightly coupled failures: task drift, role drift, and state staleness. We test the hypothesis that these share a common representational cause: agent hidden states move away from the directions encoding the active task, assigned role, and current shared state. A pilot study over 14,832 annotated turns supports this: drifted turns collapse near-uniformly across all three anchor subspaces (pairwise r = 0.72-0.78). Existing methods address these failures separately, operating at the surface-text level or treating control directions independently. We introduce ATLAS (Algebraic Task-role Locking with Adaptive Spectral Memory), a training-free intervention acting on hidden states before a token is generated. ATLAS builds a positive-semidefinite anchor kernel over task, role, and state subspaces and steers hidden states toward their shared high-coherence eigendirections; a low-rank Gram decomposition keeps this tractable. Across long-horizon memory, state maintenance, tool use, least-privilege coordination, and embodied stress tests, ATLAS outperforms prompting, retrieval, memory, and activation-steering baselines. Against A-MEM it improves memory macro-average accuracy by up to 5.7 points and reduces write/read failures by up to 31.7%/24.8%; against MemoryArena-Agent it gains up to 4.8 points. It gains 10.7-12.1 points under perturbation, reaches 93.5% role consistency, and transfers to a 72B backbone (macro-average 61.0 vs. 56.2). Ablating the joint task-role-state span costs 7.2 points against 0.8 for a matched-rank random span, indicating these directions are functionally implicated, not incidental; supplying them by prompt or retrieval recovers 4.3 points less. ATLAS is therefore a representation-level controller for open-weight multi-agent systems, complementary to output-level protocols for black-box agents.

translation.title: 漂移不再：面向长程开放权重多智能体 AI 的谱锁定
translation.abstract: 长程多智能体系统存在三种紧密耦合的失败：任务漂移、角色漂移和状态陈旧。我们检验这样一个假设：它们共享一个共同的表征层面的原因——智能体的隐藏状态偏离了编码当前任务、分配角色和共享状态的方向。一项覆盖 14,832 个标注轮次的初步研究支持这一假设：发生漂移的轮次在所有三个锚定子空间中近乎均匀地塌缩（两两相关系数 r = 0.72-0.78）。现有方法分别处理这些失败，要么在表层文本层面操作，要么独立对待各控制方向。我们提出 ATLAS（Algebraic Task-role Locking with Adaptive Spectral Memory），一种在 token 生成前作用于隐藏状态的免训练干预方法。ATLAS 在任务、角色和状态子空间上构建半正定锚定核，并将隐藏状态引导至其共享的高相干特征方向；低秩 Gram 分解使这一过程保持可计算。在长程记忆、状态维护、工具使用、最小权限协调和具身压力测试中，ATLAS 优于提示、检索、记忆和激活引导等基线。相对 A-MEM，它将记忆宏平均准确率提升最多 5.7 个百分点，并将写入/读取失败减少最多 31.7%/24.8%；相对 MemoryArena-Agent 提升最多 4.8 个百分点。在扰动下它提升 10.7-12.1 个百分点，角色一致性达到 93.5%，并可迁移到 72B 骨干模型（宏平均 61.0 对 56.2）。消融联合任务-角色-状态张成空间损失 7.2 个百分点，而同秩随机张成空间仅损失 0.8，表明这些方向在功能上是关键而非偶然的；通过提示或检索提供这些方向只能恢复少 4.3 个百分点的性能。因此，ATLAS 是面向开放权重多智能体系统的表征级控制器，与面向黑盒智能体的输出级协议互补。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体系统的任务漂移、角色漂移和状态陈旧问题，提出在隐藏状态层面通过谱锚定引导（ATLAS）进行免训练干预。

papers.title: Planning-Coding Separation in LLM-Based Code Generation: An Empirical Study
papers.abstract: Planning has been identified as an important factor for improved code generation with Large Language Models (LLMs). However, the interaction between planning capability and coding capability remains largely underexplored, especially when the two capabilities are from different LLMs. In this paper, we conduct the first comprehensive empirical study of planning-coding interaction in LLM-based code generation, where planning and coding are assigned to different LLMs (i.e., planning-coding separation). Specifically, we explore different planner-coder combinations to investigate the effectiveness for coders to utilize planning information from various planners and the impact of further training of coders on planner-coder combinations. Our results demonstrate that almost all planner-coder combinations are as competitive as using the same LLM for planning and coding, and the combination of a stronger planner and a stronger coder typically achieves improved effectiveness. Furthermore, using a large model as the planner paired with a much smaller model as the coder can sometimes be as competitive as using the large model as both the planner and the coder, and further training of the coder can typically boost various planner-coder combinations. These findings provide empirical evidence that planning and coding can be separated to a considerable extent in LLM-based code generation, which may offer a more flexible way to construct code-generation systems.

translation.title: 基于 LLM 的代码生成中的规划-编码分离：一项实证研究
translation.abstract: 规划已被认为是提升大语言模型（LLM）代码生成能力的重要因素。然而，规划能力与编码能力之间的交互在很大程度上仍未被充分探索，尤其是当这两种能力来自不同 LLM 时。本文对基于 LLM 的代码生成中的规划-编码交互进行了首次全面的实证研究，其中规划和编码被分配给不同的 LLM（即规划-编码分离）。具体而言，我们探索了不同的规划器-编码器组合，以研究编码器利用来自不同规划器的规划信息的有效性，以及编码器进一步训练对规划器-编码器组合的影响。结果表明，几乎所有规划器-编码器组合都与使用同一 LLM 进行规划和编码一样具有竞争力，且更强的规划器与更强的编码器的组合通常能取得更好的效果。此外，使用大模型作为规划器、搭配小得多的模型作为编码器，有时可以与使用大模型同时担任规划和编码一样具有竞争力，而对编码器的进一步训练通常能提升各种规划器-编码器组合的表现。这些发现提供了实证证据，表明在基于 LLM 的代码生成中，规划与编码可以在相当程度上分离，这可能为构建代码生成系统提供更灵活的方式。
translation.brief: 首次系统实证研究将规划与编码分配给不同 LLM 的效果，发现规划-编码分离在多数组合下可行且有效。

papers.title: ATC: Agent Trajectory Control for Role-Contract Enforcement in Black-Box Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems assign different responsibilities to different agents: one plans, another retrieves evidence, another verifies, another executes. This division of labor is only meaningful if each agent stays within the functions it is authorized to perform. Over many turns, however, an agent can produce a locally reasonable message that exercises authority belonging to another role: a verifier that begins planning, a retriever that asserts unsupported conclusions, an executor that changes state no one approved. We formalize this as role drift, a turn-level breach of an agent's role contract. We introduce Agent Trajectory Control (ATC), which makes each role's authority explicit as a contract and enforces it at the point where a message would enter the shared conversation. ATC scores a proposed output for out-of-role deviation, leakage into the functions of other roles, impermissible speech acts, and logical contract breaches, then computes a leakage-regularized target that constrains regeneration; the revised message is re-checked before admission. Enforcement acts on the message rather than the generator, so ATC governs agents whose internal representations are unavailable. Across homogeneous and heterogeneous teams, ATC improves task performance and role consistency while lowering role-drift energy relative to strong baselines spanning prompting, memory, workflow control, and activation editing, with the largest gains under explicit role-confusion stress tests and in larger, more diverse teams.

translation.title: ATC：面向黑盒多智能体系统中角色契约执行的智能体轨迹控制
translation.abstract: 多智能体 LLM 系统为不同智能体分配不同职责：一个负责规划，另一个负责检索证据，另一个负责验证，另一个负责执行。只有当每个智能体都停留在其被授权执行的职能范围内时，这种分工才有意义。然而在多轮交互中，智能体可能产生一条局部合理但行使了其他角色权限的消息：验证者开始规划，检索者断言无依据的结论，执行者更改了未经批准的状态。我们将其形式化为角色漂移，即智能体在轮次级别上违反其角色契约。我们提出智能体轨迹控制（ATC），将每个角色的权限显式化为契约，并在消息即将进入共享对话的节点上执行该契约。ATC 对提议的输出进行越轨偏差、向其他角色职能的泄漏、不允许的言语行为以及逻辑契约违背的评分，然后计算一个经泄漏正则化的目标来约束重新生成；修订后的消息在准入前会被再次检查。执行作用于消息而非生成器，因此 ATC 可以治理内部表征不可获取的智能体。在同质和异质团队中，相对于涵盖提示、记忆、工作流控制和激活编辑的强基线，ATC 提升了任务性能和角色一致性，同时降低了角色漂移能量，在显式角色混淆压力测试和更大、更多样化的团队中收益最大。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体系统中的角色漂移问题，提出在消息准入层面通过角色契约评分与约束再生成来执行角色权限（ATC）。

papers.title: FP4Quant: Efficient 4-Bit Communication Compression for Model-Parallel LLM Training
papers.abstract: The rapid scaling of large language models (LLMs) has made communication overhead a critical bottleneck in distributed model-parallel training. Although existing low-precision compression methods can effectively reduce communication costs, further reducing the communication footprint to ultra-low-bit formats such as FP4 introduces new challenges, including limited numerical range, sub-byte storage overhead, and increased computational cost from fine-grained quantization. In this paper, we present \textbf{FP4Quant}, a micro-grouped FP4 compression framework for efficient model-parallel LLM training. FP4Quant integrates a micro-grouped dual-scale FP4 quantization mechanism to preserve local tensor distribution characteristics, a warp-cooperative FP4 packing scheme to enable efficient sub-byte data representation, and a hybrid two-level FWHT pipeline to mitigate quantization errors with GPU-aware execution optimization. Experiments on NVIDIA H100 GPUs with Qwen-7B demonstrate up to 1.56$\times$ end-to-end throughput improvement over BF16, revealing a trade-off between throughput and model quality.

translation.title: FP4Quant：面向模型并行 LLM 训练的高效 4 比特通信压缩
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速扩展使通信开销成为分布式模型并行训练的关键瓶颈。尽管现有的低精度压缩方法能有效降低通信成本，但将通信足迹进一步压缩到 FP4 等超低比特格式会带来新的挑战，包括数值范围有限、亚字节存储开销以及细粒度量化带来的计算成本增加。本文提出 FP4Quant，一个用于高效模型并行 LLM 训练的微分组 FP4 压缩框架。FP4Quant 集成了微分组双尺度 FP4 量化机制以保留局部张量分布特征、warp 协作的 FP4 打包方案以实现高效的亚字节数据表示，以及混合两级 FWHT 流水线以缓解量化误差并进行 GPU 感知的执行优化。在 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上使用 Qwen-7B 的实验显示，相比 BF16 端到端吞吐量提升最高达 1.56 倍，同时揭示了吞吐量与模型质量之间的权衡。
translation.brief: 针对模型并行训练中的通信瓶颈，提出微分组双尺度 FP4 量化与高效打包、FWHT 流水线相结合的通信压缩框架 FP4Quant。

papers.title: Warpline: Binary-Level Tracing and Unified Evidence for Agentic GPU Kernel Optimization
papers.abstract: LLM agents are becoming GPU kernel engineers, but they still tune kernels without seeing where the time goes. Hardware profilers report how busy each unit was, not where each warp's time went; intra-kernel tracers can show it, but only with hand-placed probes and a recompilation that alters the very kernel being measured. We present Warpline, which gives agents this view automatically while leaving the kernel essentially unchanged. Warpline analyzes the binary to decide which events to record and inserts probes into the binary itself without recompilation or any manual step. It then aligns the trace with hardware profiling data on one unified timeline. Because it needs only the binary, it can regenerate this evidence for every new version of the kernel at whatever level the agent edits it (source, IR, or PTX), closing the optimization loop without human intervention. On NVIDIA B200, across 35 kernels in Triton, CuTe DSL, and CUDA C++, Warpline adds a median overhead of 1.2% and leaves a median 99.9% of executed instructions unchanged, whereas existing tracers have median overheads of 1.6% to 13.2% and leave only 4.6% to 32.7% unchanged. Warpline also traces closed-source kernels, which these tracers cannot. On 10 SOL-ExecBench problems, agents using Warpline spend less time and fewer model requests than a bare coding agent and NVIDIA's Kernel Design Agents (KDA), yet lead both after every round in geometric mean and reach a 7.69$\times$ geometric-mean speedup, against 6.94$\times$ and 6.13$\times$. Two case studies further demonstrate that Warpline reveals hidden bottlenecks and provides actionable optimization insights.

translation.title: Warpline：面向智能体 GPU 核函数优化的二进制级追踪与统一证据
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体正在成为 GPU 核函数工程师，但它们在调优核函数时仍然看不到时间花在了哪里。硬件性能分析器只能报告每个单元有多繁忙，而不是每个 warp 的时间去向；核内追踪器可以显示这一点，但需要手工放置探针并重新编译，而重新编译会改变被测量的核函数本身。我们提出 Warpline，它能在核函数基本保持不变的情况下自动为智能体提供这种视图。Warpline 分析二进制文件以决定记录哪些事件，并将探针直接插入二进制文件，无需重新编译或任何手动步骤。然后它将追踪数据与硬件性能分析数据对齐到统一的时间线上。由于它只需要二进制文件，无论智能体在哪个层级（源码、IR 或 PTX）编辑核函数，它都能为每个新版本的核函数重新生成这些证据，从而在无需人工干预的情况下闭合优化循环。在 NVIDIA B200 上，针对 Triton、CuTe DSL 和 CUDA C++ 的 35 个核函数，Warpline 的中位开销为 1.2%，执行指令的中位保持率为 99.9%，而现有追踪器的中位开销为 1.6% 到 13.2%，指令保持率仅为 4.6% 到 32.7%。Warpline 还能追踪闭源核函数，这是现有追踪器无法做到的。在 10 个 SOL-ExecBench 问题上，使用 Warpline 的智能体比裸编码智能体和 NVIDIA 的 Kernel Design Agents（KDA）花费更少的时间和更少的模型请求，且在每一轮的几何平均上都领先于两者，达到 7.69 倍的几何平均加速，而对比方法分别为 6.94 倍和 6.13 倍。两个案例研究进一步表明，Warpline 能够揭示隐藏的瓶颈并提供可操作的优化洞察。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 智能体调优 GPU 核函数时缺乏时间去向可见性的问题，核心方法是在二进制层面自动插入探针进行追踪，并与硬件性能分析数据在统一时间线上对齐。

papers.title: Patching the Protocol: A Taxonomy of Pre-Registration Repairs in LLM-Proposer Experiments
papers.abstract: Pre-registration is increasingly proposed as a trust mechanism for machine-learning research involving LLM-generated content, but its canonical form assumes a frozen protocol can be executed unchanged. Software-intensive studies violate this assumption: the protocol is partly implemented, and implementations carry defects. We report a three-case study of protocol repairs ("patches") from a program where an LLM proposes executable rules that a programmatic verifier gates, across production scheduling, incentive design, and task assignment. Each protocol required exactly one defect-repair patch: three events in total. None modified a numbered judgment criterion, its threshold, or the scoring rule, and none altered already collected data; two changed pre-registered design parameters before any data were collected, each with a recorded rationale. We propose a two-axis taxonomy of patches (defect class: environmental / feasibility / correctness, x timing: pre-data / post-data), introduce a verifiable non-impact claim for post-data repairs, and distill a nine-item checklist; all nine items were exercised by at least one patch event -- an observation of use, not a validation of sufficiency. The credibility of verifier-bound, LLM-proposer studies depends less on whether patches occur than on whether they are auditable.

translation.title: 修补协议：LLM 提议者实验中预注册修复的分类法
translation.abstract: 预注册日益被提议作为涉及 LLM 生成内容的机器学习研究的信任机制，但其经典形式假设一个冻结的协议可以不加修改地执行。软件密集型研究违反了这一假设：协议是部分实现的，而实现会带有缺陷。我们报告了一项关于协议修复（"补丁"）的三案例研究，该研究来自一个由 LLM 提出可执行规则并由程序化验证器把关的项目，涉及生产调度、激励设计和任务分配。每个协议恰好需要一次缺陷修复补丁：共三个事件。没有任何补丁修改了编号的判断标准、其阈值或评分规则，也没有改变已收集的数据；其中两个补丁在收集任何数据之前更改了预注册的设计参数，且均记录了理由。我们提出了一个双轴补丁分类法（缺陷类别：环境/可行性/正确性 × 时机：数据前/数据后），为数据后修复引入了可验证的非影响声明，并提炼出一个九项检查清单——所有九项均被至少一个补丁事件所涉及，这是使用情况的观察，而非充分性的验证。绑定验证器的 LLM 提议者研究的可信度，与其说取决于补丁是否发生，不如说取决于它们是否可审计。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 提议者实验中预注册协议因实现缺陷需要修复的可信度问题，核心方法是基于三个真实案例提出补丁的双轴分类法、可验证的非影响声明和九项检查清单。

papers.title: When Is Fresh AI Stock Analysis Worth It? Allocating a Limited Research Budget Across Price Updates, Deep Forecast Refreshes, and Editorial Reviews of Top Stock Picks
papers.abstract: Must long-horizon AI investment research be rewritten every time stock prices move? Using 8,120 production reports on the same 203 stocks across four iPulse AI batches, we compare repricing existing targets, guarding them against price shocks, mechanically resetting old forecast growth, and generating fresh multi-agent reports. Ten matched configurations represent seven investment frameworks. Our primary economic evaluation selects Top 10 USD portfolios using one-year forecasts. Across two unchanged-model windows, guarded reuse averages 2.25%, versus 1.66% for SPY and 4.77% for fresh reports, after modeled trading costs and reference compute charges on a USD 100,000 account. Guarded reuse beats SPY in all three short windows, including the model-change transition. Extending the first holding window to nearly six months reverses the result: guarded reuse returns -11.26%, fresh reports +9.12%, and SPY +3.46%, motivating the thesis half-life question. Supporting quarter-forecast diagnostics show that mechanically re-anchoring old growth paths closes 98% of the MAE improvement over fixed targets, yet Fresh and Reset share only 1-4 of their Top 10 stocks. At Top 30, the unchanged-model portfolio comparison instead favors guarded reuse (4.17% versus 1.88%). Endpoint and concentration tests reveal the influence of horizon choices and exceptional winners. Nine production editions show substantial between-edition turnover, while every final editorial screen retains its own incoming list. Measured token workloads connect refresh costs to shared capital and realized break-even budgets. The resulting architecture separates continuous price monitoring from episodic thesis rebuilding and targeted editorial evidence checks.

translation.title: 何时值得重新生成 AI 股票分析？在价格更新、深度预测刷新与精选股票编辑审查之间分配有限的研究预算
translation.abstract: 长期 AI 投资研究是否必须在每次股价变动时都重写？我们利用四个 iPulse AI 批次中针对相同 203 只股票的 8,120 份生产报告，比较了重新定价现有目标价、防范价格冲击、机械重置旧预测增长以及生成全新多智能体报告等策略。十个匹配配置代表七种投资框架。我们的主要经济评估使用一年期预测选择 Top 10 美元投资组合。在两个模型不变的窗口中，在计入模拟交易成本和 10 万美元账户的参考计算费用后，防护式复用的平均收益为 2.25%，SPY 为 1.66%，全新报告为 4.77%。防护式复用在所有三个短窗口中均跑赢 SPY，包括模型更换过渡期。将第一个持有窗口延长至近六个月则逆转了结果：防护式复用收益为 -11.26%，全新报告为 +9.12%，SPY 为 +3.46%，这引出了论点半衰期问题。辅助的季度预测诊断显示，机械地重新锚定旧增长路径可达到相对固定目标 98% 的 MAE 改进，但 Fresh 和 Reset 的 Top 10 股票仅有 1-4 只重合。在 Top 30 层面，模型不变的投资组合比较反而偏向防护式复用（4.17% 对 1.88%）。端点和集中度测试揭示了持有期选择和异常赢家的影响。九个生产版本显示出版本间的大幅换手，而每次最终编辑筛选都保留了其自身的入选名单。测量的 token 工作量将刷新成本与共享资本和实际盈亏平衡预算联系起来。由此产生的架构将持续的价格监控与阶段性的论点重建和有针对性的编辑证据检查分离开来。
translation.brief: 解决 AI 股票研究中何时值得重新生成分析报告的预算分配问题，核心方法是比较价格重定价、防护式复用、预测重置与全新多智能体报告等多种策略的经济收益。

papers.title: Large Language Models for Forecasting of Electricity Price Spikes
papers.abstract: Can market notices read by a large language model (LLM) improve short-horizon electricity price spike forecasts? We study five regions of Australia's National Electricity Market. A local LLM extracted features once per notice, only notices visible at the forecast origin were used, and a gradient-boosting model produced onset probabilities. In an out-of-sample development back-test (July 2022 to July 2024), notice features did not lower the 60-minute Brier score of a numeric model including the market operator's next-hour forecasts. At 24 hours they did, but rule-based features did so almost equally and attribution to notice content was not established. A locally frozen protocol, not publicly deposited, governed a retrospective single-use holdout from 15 August to 17 October 2026. At 60 minutes, the hypothesis that LLM features lower the numeric model's Brier score was not established (H1; relative Brier skill -0.09%), so the planned comparison with rule-based features was not tested (H2). At 24 hours, the hypothesis that LLM features lower the score against a text-free control was not established (H3; +0.37%, 95% CI [-9.74, 1.39], inconclusive). By the frozen wording rule the non-significant 24-hour improvement comes mainly from recalibration and cannot be attributed to notice content, although post hoc the decomposition could not separate recalibration from resolution. The 24-hour base rate was 1.56% on the holdout against 14.0% in development. With 5 onsets on 3 days and 24-hour positives in 2 of 22 three-day blocks, the holdout neither established nor excluded a 24-hour effect.

translation.title: 用于电价尖峰预测的大语言模型
translation.abstract: 让大语言模型（LLM）阅读市场公告能否改善短期电价尖峰预测？我们研究了澳大利亚国家电力市场的五个区域。本地 LLM 对每条公告提取一次特征，仅使用预测起点可见的公告，并由梯度提升模型产生尖峰发生概率。在样本外开发回测（2022 年 7 月至 2024 年 7 月）中，公告特征未能降低包含市场运营商次小时预测的数值模型的 60 分钟 Brier 分数。在 24 小时尺度上有所降低，但基于规则的特征几乎同样有效，且无法将改进归因于公告内容。一项本地冻结但未公开存档的协议规定了 2026 年 8 月 15 日至 10 月 17 日的一次性回顾性留出测试。在 60 分钟尺度上，LLM 特征降低数值模型 Brier 分数的假设未成立（H1；相对 Brier 技巧 -0.09%），因此未测试与基于规则特征的计划比较（H2）。在 24 小时尺度上，LLM 特征相对无文本对照降低分数的假设也未成立（H3；+0.37%，95% CI [-9.74, 1.39]，不确定）。根据冻结的措辞规则，24 小时尺度上不显著的改进主要来自重新校准，不能归因于公告内容，尽管事后分解无法将重新校准与分辨率区分开。留出集上的 24 小时基础发生率为 1.56%，而开发阶段为 14.0%。由于仅有 3 天的 5 次尖峰发生，且 22 个三天区块中只有 2 个在 24 小时尺度为正，留出测试既未确立也未排除 24 小时效应。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 阅读市场公告能否改善短期电价尖峰预测的问题，核心方法是用本地 LLM 提取公告特征并结合梯度提升模型预测尖峰发生概率。

papers.title: CloakFEM: Agentic FEM Code Generation for Red-Teaming Computational Resource Exhaustion
papers.abstract: Finite element method (FEM) solvers are foundational to scientific and engineering simulation, yet their susceptibility to \emph{efficiency attacks} remains largely unexplored. An adversary can craft syntactically valid and runnable FEM programs that complete successfully while forcing excessive computational work, enabling computational denial-of-service (DoS) attacks. Finding such inputs is challenging because FEM programs occupy a vast, structured space constrained by numerical, geometric, and constitutive requirements. We introduce CloakFEM, a domain-guided LLM-agent framework for automatically generating runnable adversarial FEM programs that amplify solver computation. CloakFEM combines LLM-guided search with an FEM-specific intermediate representation and a deterministic validity gate that enforces runnable constraints. Across three FEM stacks, 17 problem classes, and 1,068 seeds, CloakFEM discovers adversarial inputs that substantially amplify solver work while remaining valid and solvable. In the most extreme case, solver iterations increase from 43 to 247,367, a \(5{,}752.72\times\) amplification. CloakFEM outperforms five generic black-box baselines and retains an advantage over evolutionary search under a controlled bounded action space. Cross-solver analysis further reveals both problem-intrinsic and solver-specific sources of vulnerability. Our results uncover an underexplored efficiency-attack surface in FEM solvers and show that runnable FEM programs can serve as adversarial inputs.

translation.title: CloakFEM：用于计算资源耗尽红队测试的智能体 FEM 代码生成
translation.abstract: 有限元方法（FEM）求解器是科学与工程仿真的基础，但其对效率攻击的易感性在很大程度上尚未被探索。攻击者可以构造语法有效且可运行的 FEM 程序，这些程序能够成功完成，同时迫使求解器进行过量的计算工作，从而实现计算拒绝服务（DoS）攻击。寻找此类输入具有挑战性，因为 FEM 程序占据一个受数值、几何和本构要求约束的庞大结构化空间。我们提出 CloakFEM，这是一个领域引导的 LLM 智能体框架，用于自动生成可运行的对抗性 FEM 程序以放大求解器计算。CloakFEM 将 LLM 引导的搜索与 FEM 专用中间表示以及强制可运行约束的确定性有效性门控相结合。在三个 FEM 求解器栈、17 个问题类别和 1,068 个种子上，CloakFEM 发现的对抗性输入在保持有效和可解的同时，显著放大了求解器的工作量。在最极端的情况下，求解器迭代次数从 43 次增加到 247,367 次，放大倍数为 5,752.72 倍。CloakFEM 优于五个通用黑盒基线，并在受控的有界动作空间下保持对进化搜索的优势。跨求解器分析进一步揭示了问题固有和求解器特定的脆弱性来源。我们的结果揭示了 FEM 求解器中一个未被充分探索的效率攻击面，并表明可运行的 FEM 程序可以作为对抗性输入。
translation.brief: 解决 FEM 求解器对效率攻击的易感性未被探索的问题，核心方法是结合 LLM 引导搜索、FEM 专用中间表示和确定性有效性门控来自动生成可运行的对抗性 FEM 程序。

papers.title: Do Coding Agents Follow AGENTS.md? The Effect of Policy Wording on Instruction Compliance
papers.abstract: Coding agents do not always follow the policies in an Agent Context File (ACF). We inserted one policy, in four styles, into the ACFs of 86 benchmark tasks across four harness-model combinations. Conditional phrasing was followed less often than Prescriptive and Explanatory. The better of those two varied by combination.

translation.title: 编码智能体遵循 AGENTS.md 吗？政策措辞对指令依从性的影响
translation.abstract: 编码智能体并不总是遵循 Agent Context File（ACF）中的政策。我们在四种 harness-模型组合的 86 个基准任务的 ACF 中插入了一条政策，采用四种措辞风格。条件式措辞的遵循率低于规定式和解释式，而后两者中哪种更优则因组合而异。
translation.brief: 研究编码智能体对 ACF 中政策措辞风格的依从性，通过在 86 个基准任务中插入四种措辞风格的政策进行对比实验。

papers.title: Distributed Marginal Return: A Communication-Efficient Algorithm for Multi-Agent Weapon Target Assignment
papers.abstract: The Weapon-Target Assignment (WTA) problem in distributed multi-agent systems is challenged by limited situational awareness and communication constraints. Existing distributed methods, such as auction-consensus algorithms, typically assume task-value independence, a simplification that fails to capture the coupled effects of multi-weapon assignments. This paper introduces the Distributed Marginal Return (DMR) algorithm, a novel decentralized approach that generalizes auction-consensus frameworks. DMR enables agents to compute bids based on marginal return and uses a consensus protocol to resolve conflicts, allowing multiple non-conflicting proposals to be accepted in parallel for cooperative optimization with minimal communication. A key theoretical contribution is our proof that the marginal returns of non-conflicting bids are additive, a property that ensures global consistency and validates our parallel acceptance mechanism. Extensive simulations demonstrate that DMR significantly outperforms baseline algorithms in both solution quality and communication efficiency, offering a scalable and robust solution for real-world distributed command and control applications.

translation.title: 分布式边际回报：一种面向多智能体武器目标分配的通信高效算法
translation.abstract: 分布式多智能体系统中的武器目标分配（WTA）问题面临态势感知有限和通信约束的挑战。现有分布式方法（如拍卖-共识算法）通常假设任务价值独立，这一简化无法刻画多武器分配的耦合效应。本文提出分布式边际回报（DMR）算法，一种泛化拍卖-共识框架的新型去中心化方法。DMR 使智能体能够基于边际回报计算投标，并使用共识协议解决冲突，允许多个互不冲突的提案并行接受，以最小通信实现协作优化。一个关键理论贡献是我们证明了互不冲突投标的边际回报具有可加性，该性质保证了全局一致性并验证了并行接受机制。大量仿真表明，DMR 在解质量和通信效率上均显著优于基线算法，为现实分布式指挥控制应用提供了可扩展且鲁棒的解决方案。
translation.brief: 针对分布式多智能体武器目标分配中任务价值耦合的问题，提出基于边际回报可加性的 DMR 去中心化算法，通过共识协议并行接受非冲突投标以降低通信开销。

papers.title: LLM-Generated Investment Research Memos Need Validation
papers.abstract: LLMs are increasingly adopted to draft long-form investment research memos, but their reliability is judged claim by claim, while readers read each memo as a whole. In this paper, we show that a low claim-level error rate does not necessarily mean that a memo is reliable: even with a refutation rate of just 1-2%, roughly four in ten memos contain at least one claim contradicted by official filings. First, we generate 1,440 memos with four recent LLM-powered agents for 30 companies over 12 quarters, decompose them into 77,272 financial claims, and verify each against the same official source bundle by retrieving evidence, matching it to the claim, and verifying the outcome. Second, we find that only 1.17-1.77% of claims are refuted, yet 36.94-41.11% of memos contain at least one refuted claim, and agents differ in severity: Codex has the lowest memo-level rate; a qualitative review further groups errors into four patterns (time, unit, context, concept).

translation.title: LLM 生成的投资研究备忘录需要验证
translation.abstract: LLM 被越来越多地用于起草长篇投资研究备忘录，但其可靠性是逐条声明评判的，而读者则将备忘录作为整体阅读。本文表明，低声明级错误率并不一定意味着备忘录可靠：即使反驳率仅为 1-2%，约四成备忘录仍包含至少一条与官方文件相矛盾的声明。首先，我们用四个近期基于 LLM 的智能体为 30 家公司跨 12 个季度生成 1,440 份备忘录，将其分解为 77,272 条金融声明，并通过检索证据、匹配声明、验证结果的方式逐条对照同一官方来源包进行核验。其次，我们发现仅有 1.17-1.77% 的声明被反驳，但 36.94-41.11% 的备忘录包含至少一条被反驳的声明，且各智能体严重程度不同：Codex 的备忘录级错误率最低；定性审查进一步将错误归为四类模式（时间、单位、上下文、概念）。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 生成的投资研究备忘录整体可靠性问题，通过大规模生成、声明分解与官方文件逐条核验，揭示低声明级错误率下备忘录仍普遍含错误的现象。

papers.title: Aligning Training and Rollout Policies for End-to-End FP4 RL on Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
papers.abstract: In this work, we study end-to-end FP4 reinforcement learning (RL) post-training for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models. Recent work on FP4 RL has introduced effective recovery recipes that restore accuracy under aggressive low-precision quantization for dense models, but we find that the same approach yields no improvement over the naive FP4 baseline in the MoE setting. We conduct an in-depth study to understand why. Our analysis identifies the root cause in the routing mechanism unique to MoE: because the router makes discrete expert-selection decisions, training-inference policy alignment becomes acutely sensitive to whether the same recovery technique is applied symmetrically on the training and inference sides. When an asymmetric recipe is used-including the dense-model approach, which corrects only the rollout-training-inference alignment deteriorates sharply, as measured by the Pearson correlation coefficient between training and inference probabilities, and router selection matching rates. Building on this finding, we propose MoeResQ, a quantization-recovery recipe for MoE RL post-training that enforces symmetry between the training- and inference-side corrections. MoeResQ restores training-inference alignment and substantially closes the accuracy gap to full precision, establishing symmetric recovery as the key principle in FP4 RL for MoE models.

translation.title: 面向 Mixture-of-Experts LLM 端到端 FP4 强化学习的训练与推理策略对齐
translation.abstract: 本文研究 Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）大语言模型的端到端 FP4 强化学习（RL）后训练。近期 FP4 RL 工作提出了在激进低精度量化下恢复稠密模型精度的有效恢复方案，但我们发现同样的方法在 MoE 场景下相比朴素 FP4 基线并无提升。我们深入研究了原因。分析表明根本原因在于 MoE 特有的路由机制：由于路由器做出离散的专家选择决策，训练-推理策略对齐对恢复技术是否在训练侧和推理侧对称应用极为敏感。当使用非对称方案时（包括仅修正 rollout 的稠密模型方案），训练-推理对齐会急剧恶化，这体现在训练与推理概率之间的 Pearson 相关系数以及路由器选择匹配率上。基于这一发现，我们提出 MoeResQ，一种面向 MoE RL 后训练的量化恢复方案，强制训练侧与推理侧修正的对称性。MoeResQ 恢复了训练-推理对齐，并大幅缩小了与全精度之间的精度差距，确立了对称恢复作为 MoE 模型 FP4 RL 的关键原则。
translation.brief: 针对 MoE 模型 FP4 强化学习中训练-推理对齐恶化的问题，发现根因在于路由机制对非对称恢复方案的敏感性，并提出强制两侧对称修正的 MoeResQ 方案。

papers.title: Twice as Fast, Until It Isn't: Quantized Serving of Mid-Size Open LLMs
papers.abstract: A team serving a 9B-20B open-weight language model on vLLM or SGLang must choose a quantization recipe, and needs two numbers: the speedup over BF16 and the accuracy given up. We assemble every public measurement of these numbers that we could verify and find that the record supplies them only in pieces. Only two checkpoints, both INT4 builds of Gemma 3 12B, have both a vLLM timing and an accuracy score, and that score covers a single MMLU subject, one that the AWQ build was calibrated on. The batch-1 timings predate current engine releases, AMD and Intel Gaudi have no timing in this band at all, and FP4 has none against BF16. The timings that do exist follow one rule. Decoding a small batch is limited by memory bandwidth, so 4-bit weights roughly double speed (2.12x for Qwen2.5-14B on an A100), but the gain vanishes once a large batch makes the GPU compute-bound (1.02x for Gemma 3 12B at batch size 256), where FP8 is the recipe that can still help. Many published accuracy deltas, including every HumanEval delta, lie within benchmark sampling noise. We close with a seven-item reporting checklist for future measurements.

translation.title: 快两倍，直到不再快：中型开源 LLM 的量化服务
translation.abstract: 在 vLLM 或 SGLang 上服务 9B-20B 开源权重语言模型的团队必须选择量化方案，并需要两个数字：相对 BF16 的加速比和损失的精度。我们汇集了所有可验证的公开测量数据，发现现有记录只能零散地提供这些信息。仅有两个检查点（均为 Gemma 3 12B 的 INT4 构建）同时具备 vLLM 计时和精度分数，且该分数仅覆盖单一 MMLU 学科——恰是 AWQ 构建校准所用的学科。现有的 batch-1 计时早于当前引擎版本，AMD 和 Intel Gaudi 在此参数区间完全没有计时数据，FP4 也没有与 BF16 的对比。已有的计时遵循一条规律：小批量解码受内存带宽限制，4-bit 权重约使速度翻倍（Qwen2.5-14B 在 A100 上为 2.12 倍），但一旦大批量使 GPU 进入计算受限状态，增益便消失（Gemma 3 12B 在 batch size 256 时仅 1.02 倍），此时 FP8 才是仍能带来帮助的方案。许多已发表的精度差异（包括所有 HumanEval 差异）都落在基准采样噪声范围内。最后我们给出一份面向未来测量的七项报告清单。
translation.brief: 针对中型开源 LLM 量化服务缺乏系统测量数据的问题，汇集并分析公开基准数据，揭示 4-bit 量化加速受限于批量大小的规律并提出报告规范。

papers.title: Beyond Compression Ratio: High-Throughput KV Compression for Disaggregated LLM Serving
papers.abstract: KV cache compression reduces the communication volume of disaggregated large language model serving, but its practical benefit depends not only on compression ratio and model quality, but also on how efficiently the compression pipeline executes. This requirement becomes increasingly important as modern serving systems adopt high-bandwidth interconnects, where inefficient compression can offset a substantial portion of the saved communication time. This paper presents \system, a high-throughput KV cache compression data path built on top of \kvserve. \system improves compression execution in two complementary ways. First, it fuses the distribution transformation and low-bit quantization stages into a KV-aware \tilelang kernel, eliminating intermediate tensor materialization and redundant memory accesses. Second, it replaces the original lossless compression backend with an open, extensible, and searchable backend based on \lc, enabling high-performance compression operator pipelines. The fused kernel achieves up to $5.9\times$ speedup, while the new lossless backend increases compression throughput from below 90~GB/s to over 500~GB/s. Across the evaluated workloads, \system reduces job completion time by up to $2.04\times$. End-to-end evaluation shows that these optimizations allow KV compression to retain meaningful communication benefits under modern high-bandwidth network.

translation.title: 超越压缩率：面向分离式LLM服务的高吞吐量KV压缩
translation.abstract: KV cache压缩可以降低分离式大语言模型服务的通信量，但其实际收益不仅取决于压缩率和模型质量，还取决于压缩流水线本身的执行效率。随着现代服务系统采用高带宽互连，这一要求变得日益重要，因为低效的压缩可能抵消相当一部分节省下来的通信时间。本文提出\system，一个构建在\kvserve之上的高吞吐量KV cache压缩数据路径。\system通过两种互补方式改进压缩执行。首先，它将分布变换和低比特量化阶段融合为一个KV感知的\tilelang kernel，消除了中间张量的物化和冗余内存访问。其次，它将原有的无损压缩后端替换为基于\lc的开放、可扩展、可搜索的后端，从而支持高性能压缩算子流水线。融合kernel实现了最高5.9倍的加速，新的无损后端将压缩吞吐量从不足90 GB/s提升到超过500 GB/s。在评估的工作负载中，\system将作业完成时间最多缩短2.04倍。端到端评估表明，这些优化使KV压缩在现代高带宽网络下仍能保留可观的通信收益。
translation.brief: 该论文解决高带宽网络下KV cache压缩执行效率不足的问题，核心方法是将分布变换与量化融合为单个KV感知kernel，并用基于\lc的可扩展无损压缩后端替代原有后端。

papers.title: Disposable Implementations: What Is Software Engineering For?
papers.abstract: Existing implementations are usually maintained for most of their life and replaced only as an exception. Coding agents may change that. If agents can produce new implementations from requirements, tests, architectural constraints, and operational records that survive replacement, changing a system may no longer require modifying its existing codebase. We call this process regeneration. An implementation is disposable when regeneration becomes a routine alternative to maintenance. Regenerating and verifying a clean implementation from current requirements and tests may be cheaper than having agents navigate (and potentially compound) existing technical debt, and could eliminate much of that debt. Yet existing code may contain knowledge absent from the preserved artifacts, including safeguards introduced after failures and assumptions that were never documented. A regenerated implementation may pass the available tests and still lose behavior that matters in production. This leaves open how to establish continuity across replacements and whether regeneration reduces maintenance effort or shifts it to the artifacts and processes that support it. We examine these questions through an exploratory review of practitioner literature. Published examples show that agents can replace existing implementations, but do not establish that repeated regeneration is safe or economical. If implementations become disposable, what should software engineering preserve?

translation.title: 一次性实现：软件工程为了什么？
translation.abstract: 现有实现通常在大部分生命周期中被持续维护，替换只是例外情形。Coding agent可能改变这一点。如果agent能够根据需求、测试、架构约束以及可在替换后留存的操作记录生成新实现，那么改变系统可能不再需要修改其现有代码库。我们将这一过程称为再生（regeneration）。当再生成为维护的常规替代方案时，实现就是一次性的（disposable）。基于当前需求和测试再生并验证一个干净的实现，可能比让agent在现有技术债务中穿行（并可能使之累积）更便宜，且能消除大量技术债务。然而，现有代码可能包含留存产物中缺失的知识，包括故障后引入的防护措施以及从未被记录的假设。再生实现可能通过现有测试，却仍丢失在生产环境中重要的行为。这就留下了开放问题：如何在替换之间建立连续性，以及再生是减少了维护工作量，还是将其转移到了支持它的产物和流程上。我们通过对从业者文献的探索性综述来考察这些问题。已发表的例子表明agent可以替换现有实现，但并未证明反复再生是安全或经济的。如果实现变得一次性，软件工程应当保留什么？
translation.brief: 该论文探讨coding agent按需再生整个实现（而非维护现有代码）的可行性与风险，核心方法是通过对从业者文献的探索性综述分析再生能否安全、经济地替代维护。

papers.title: Voluntary Servitude: Weaponized Safety Warning Mechanisms for Controlling AI Agents
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly act on information retrieved from public sources they treat as credible, which turns a manipulated recommendation into a transaction, a dependency, or a decision with physical consequences. The security literature models this threat as instruction injection, in which an adversary writes a command into retrieved content and deployed defenses learn to recognize command syntax. We show that an attacker can instead steer an agent through the agent's own harm-avoidance. A single fabricated hazard, written as an ordinary review, leads the agent to disqualify the legitimate options and select the attacker's target by its own reasoning, with no command for a detector to recognize. We call this voluntary servitude. These payloads steer agents about as often as instruction injection (60.4% vs. 66.0%), and deployed injection detectors score them as benign, so behind a filter they are 1.7-4.4x more effective. We measure this at the generation stage across six models and ten consumer-service domains, for three attack families, and show that it transfers to production browser agents, outperforming instruction injection, and to a retrieval pipeline (1.0-57.0% end-to-end success, depending on the retriever). We then show that a corroboration requirement added to the agent's instructions removes roughly 95% of the exposure against a non-adaptive attacker without retraining. With the requirement in place, the agent still reads the planted hazard and no longer acts on it.

translation.title: 自愿臣服：武器化安全预警机制以控制AI Agent
translation.abstract: LLM agent日益依据其视为可信的公开来源信息采取行动，这使得一次被操纵的推荐可以转化为交易、依赖关系或具有物理后果的决策。安全文献将这种威胁建模为指令注入（instruction injection），即对手在检索内容中写入命令，而部署的防御则学习识别命令语法。我们证明攻击者可以转而利用agent自身的危害规避机制来操纵agent。一条伪造为普通评论的危险信息，就能引导agent否定合法选项，并通过其自身推理选中攻击者的目标，全程没有任何可供检测器识别的命令。我们将此称为自愿臣服（voluntary servitude）。这类payload对agent的操纵频率与指令注入相当（60.4%对66.0%），且部署的注入检测器将其判定为良性，因此在过滤器之后其有效性提高1.7-4.4倍。我们在生成阶段跨六个模型、十个消费服务领域、三类攻击家族进行了测量，并证明其可迁移到生产级browser agent上，效果优于指令注入，也可迁移到检索流水线（端到端成功率1.0-57.0%，取决于检索器）。随后我们证明，在agent指令中加入交叉验证要求，无需再训练即可消除约95%的针对非自适应攻击者的暴露面。该要求生效后，agent仍会读到被植入的危险信息，但不再据此行动。
translation.brief: 该论文解决LLM agent被利用其自身安全规避机制间接操纵的新攻击问题，核心方法是通过伪造危害预警诱导agent自愿排除正确选项，并验证在指令中加入交叉验证要求可缓解该攻击。

papers.title: Silent Instrument Errors Reorder Agent Leaderboards
papers.abstract: On a public agent leaderboard, a general-purpose agent trails a scaffold built for an airline customer-service benchmark by 13 points on the tasks that touch its database, and a reader could conclude that generality costs accuracy. The gap comes from the grader. The general agent often ends its conversations in a way that never triggers grading, so only about half of its episodes were scored and the rest were stored as failures. Grading the ungraded half under the benchmark's own rule closes the pooled gap, without rerunning any agent. We audit two carefully maintained public leaderboards, HAL and tau2-bench, from their published artifacts alone and find three more instrument errors. A cost column counts nested model calls twice, unevenly across rows. Archived trajectories record grader-written actions as agent actions. Re-grading saved trajectories under a newer evaluator is itself a new measurement: a correct and announced fix reorders a leaderboard, and a mode check that misreads four files collapses their scores by 59 to 82 points while printing no error. Each produced a plausible number, and the HAL maintainers confirmed their three within five weeks. Together the cases show that the infrastructure of agent evaluation, meaning the code that grades, logs, replays and versions an evaluation, is part of the measurement and fails silently, so scores and orderings can move with no visible sign. These failure modes follow from how agent evaluation pipelines are built, and those pipelines change as fast as the agents they measure, so we expect more of them elsewhere. We propose cheap checks that expose the instrument: report the graded fraction, aggregate cost from root spans, tag the provenance of every recorded action, and pin evaluator versions with a published re-grade diff.

translation.title: 无声的测量工具错误重塑Agent排行榜
translation.abstract: 在某公开agent排行榜上，一个通用agent在与航空公司客服数据库相关的任务上落后于专为此基准构建的scaffold 13分，读者可能由此得出通用性以准确性为代价的结论。但差距来自评分器（grader）。通用agent常以一种永远不会触发评分的方式结束对话，导致其约一半的episode被评分，其余被记为失败。按基准自身规则对未评分的一半补评，即可消除汇总差距，无需重跑任何agent。我们仅凭公开产物审计了两个维护良好的公开排行榜HAL和tau2-bench，又发现三处测量工具错误。成本列将嵌套的模型调用重复计数，且在各行之间不均匀。存档的轨迹将评分器写入的动作记为agent动作。用较新的评估器重新对已保存轨迹评分本身就是一次新的测量：一次正确且已公告的修复使排行榜重新排序，而一个误读四个文件的mode检查使分数暴跌59至82分且不打印任何错误。每个错误都产生了看似合理的数字，HAL维护者在五周内确认了其中的三个。这些案例共同表明，agent评估的基础设施，即对评估进行评分、记录、回放和版本管理的代码，是测量的一部分，且会无声地失效，因此分数和排序可能在毫无可见迹象的情况下变动。这些故障模式源于agent评估流水线的构建方式，而这些流水线与其测量的agent一样快速变化，因此我们预计在其他地方还会出现更多此类问题。我们提出若干暴露测量工具的低成本检查：报告被评分的比例、从根span聚合成本、为每条记录的动作标注来源（provenance），以及固定评估器版本并发布re-grade diff。
translation.brief: 该论文解决agent排行榜因评分、记录和重放基础设施的静默错误而失真的问题，核心方法是仅凭公开产物审计两个公开排行榜找出具体测量工具错误，并提出低成本检查手段。

papers.title: LiquidCP: Decoupling Attention Tasks from Communication and Kernel Boundaries in Context Parallelism
papers.abstract: Context parallelism (CP) partitions long sequences across GPUs for LLM training and inference. For variable-length training and full prefill, attention-balanced placement can leave token loads uneven, while ring execution repeats overhead at each computation and communication step. In stage-serialized decode CP (DCP), long-running tasks delay dependent work and leave substantial GPU hardware idle. We propose LiquidCP, which unifies training and inference through a common model of Transfer, Compute, and Reduction tasks with tile-level dependencies, decoupling attention tasks from communication and kernel boundaries. For training and full prefill, MegaRing incorporates BuddyRing placement to balance attention and token loads, and coalesces ready KV regions during forward attention to amortize overhead. For decoding and mixed batches, MegaDCP selects history-KV splits by jointly modeling the completion of attention and its dependent reductions. A shared persistent GPU-resident engine executes both designs. Compared with the fastest baseline per configuration on eight H100 GPUs, MegaRing achieves geometric-mean core-attention speedups of $1.23\times$ forward and $1.18\times$ backward, and accelerates a Transformer layer by $1.08$--$1.16\times$. MegaDCP achieves geometric-mean core-attention speedups of $1.20\times$ for decode-only and $1.35\times$ for mixed batches. In vLLM serving with KV prefix cache, it achieves an average time-to-first-token speedup of $1.22\times$.

translation.title: LiquidCP：在Context Parallelism中将attention任务与通信及kernel边界解耦
translation.abstract: Context parallelism（CP）将长序列划分到多个GPU上进行LLM训练和推理。对于变长训练和完整prefill，attention均衡的放置可能导致token负载不均，而ring执行会在每个计算和通信步骤重复产生开销。在阶段串行化的decode CP（DCP）中，长时间运行的任务会延迟依赖工作，使大量GPU硬件闲置。我们提出LiquidCP，它通过一个由Transfer、Compute和Reduction任务及tile级依赖构成的统一模型，将attention任务与通信和kernel边界解耦，从而统一训练与推理。对于训练和完整prefill，MegaRing引入BuddyRing放置以均衡attention和token负载，并在前向attention期间合并就绪的KV区域以摊销开销。对于decoding和混合批次，MegaDCP通过联合建模attention及其依赖reduction的完成情况来选择history-KV切分。一个共享的常驻GPU persistent引擎同时执行两种设计。在八块H100 GPU上与每种配置下最快的基线相比，MegaRing的core-attention几何平均加速为前向1.23倍、反向1.18倍，并将一个Transformer层加速1.08-1.16倍。MegaDCP在decode-only下取得1.20倍、混合批次下取得1.35倍的core-attention几何平均加速。在带KV prefix cache的vLLM服务中，其time-to-first-token平均加速1.22倍。
translation.brief: 该论文解决context parallelism中负载不均、ring重复开销以及decode阶段任务依赖导致的GPU空闲问题，核心方法是用tile级依赖的Transfer/Compute/Reduction统一任务模型将attention任务与通信和kernel边界解耦，并辅以BuddyRing放置和history-KV切分策略。

papers.title: TxBench: A Benchmark of Attack Transactions and Evidence-Backed Negatives on Seven EVM Chains
papers.abstract: Researchers evaluate detectors of malicious smart-contract transactions on datasets that each paper assembles anew. Their positives come from incident trackers, whose citations mix attacks with setup steps and transactions that never ran, or from a detector's own output, which makes the evaluation circular; their negatives are ordinary transactions. A shared benchmark needs positives whose own execution shows the attack and negatives that use the attacks' mechanisms, with no detector deciding either label. We present TxBench, a benchmark of attack transactions and evidence-backed negatives on seven EVM chains, with the five-step pipeline that builds it. The pipeline collects every transaction that BlockSec's incident library or the EVM Hack Registry cites, maps its weakness to OWASP's SCWE taxonomy, and rebuilds its execution from free data sources. A cited transaction qualifies as a valid TxBench attack only if it extracts value from others during execution, is consistent with all verified source claims, and is independently linked to the reported incident by corroborating evidence. Negative examples are sampled from each chain's traffic near the attacks and retained only when positive evidence confirms their legitimacy. We present TxBench, a benchmark of attack transactions and evidence-backed negatives on seven EVM chains, with the five-step pipeline that builds it. The pipeline collects every transaction that BlockSec's incident library or the EVM Hack Registry cites, maps its weakness to OWASP's SCWE taxonomy, and rebuilds its execution from free data sources. A cited transaction qualifies as a valid TxBench attack only if it extracts value from others during execution, is consistent with all verified source claims, and is independently linked to the reported incident by corroborating evidence. papers.title: VidUEU-Agent: A Data-Curation Agent for Multimodal Understanding, Editing, and Unified Tasks
papers.abstract: The advancement of multimodal learning is heavily constrained by the scarcity and high annotation cost of high-quality instruction data. While raw videos offer an abundant and dynamic source of visual knowledge, transforming them into precise instruction data remains highly challenging. To bridge this gap, we present VidUEU-Agent, an automated pipeline that synthesizes instruction data from raw videos for multimodal understanding, editing, and unified tasks. VidUEU-Agent follows a four-stage pipeline: it performs global perception to filter low-quality shots, mines keyframes and multimodal signals, constructs metadata and routes the metadata to synthesize instruction samples. More importantly, our agent framework can autonomously iterate the data distribution based on downstream training results, thereby optimizing data quality, balance, and training effectiveness. Scaling this pipeline, we construct VidUEU-100K, a large-scale dataset of 100K training samples spanning multiple domains and tasks, providing a robust foundation for developing comprehensive multimodal capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that fine-tuning baseline models on VidUEU-100K yields significant and consistent performance gains across diverse representative benchmarks, validating the effectiveness of our proposed agent framework and dataset.

papers.title: Verifier strength does not buy discovery quality: a pre-registered two-domain test of LLM-based automated research, with post-hoc evidence pointing to proposer-pool composition
papers.abstract: Automated research pipelines pair an LLM proposer with a verifier on an implicit bet: discovery quality rises with verification strength. Under a pre-registered protocol we test this bet in two real-data domains -- job-shop scheduling and vehicular edge offloading on Beijing T-Drive trajectories -- across 100 matched LLM/random pairs per domain and three verifier tiers. The manipulation binds -- a 429-case mutation battery shows scores rising across tiers -- yet the paired LLM-over-random advantage does not scale with it (A, one-sided p=0.1115; D, p=0.9994), and in D shrinks under the strict tier (margin contrast -0.040, p=0.0013). The two lower gates promote identical candidates in 100/100 and 99/100 pairs, so the strict order is untestable when they coincide. Constructively, LLM proposals carry a real paired advantage over random controls, but a post-hoc union-pool analysis shows the fastest path to better discovery is widening the pool, not tightening the gate: mixing the two pools adds +1.52 holdout-value units in domain A (one-sided Wilcoxon, n=100, p=0.0002) -- evidence that pool composition, not verification strength, is the lever. Criteria, ledgers and scripts are archived on Zenodo (DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23308866).

papers.title: Typological Feature Induction as a Benchmark for Inductive Metalinguistic Reasoning
papers.abstract: Existing metalinguistic reasoning benchmarks require both inference of rules and their application, making failures hard to diagnose. We introduce typological feature induction (TFI) which targets the former step. Given sentences in an unnamed language paired with translations in a known pivot language, models must predict a typological feature of the unnamed language. From Grambank and multi-parallel corpora, we automatically build evaluation questions over 195 languages. We find that LLMs identify 59--80% of these languages from only 16 sentence pairs; and misaligning the translations barely affects their accuracy, suggesting reliance on prior knowledge of the language. Enciphering text to prevent recognition increases the corpus' utility, but mainly for features where target and pivot languages agree. On languages which models cannot identify, neither open model outperforms a majority-value baseline. Since induction from raw text aligns with field linguists' use-case, this work indicates the models tested are not yet ready for this role. TFI offers a scalable path to track progress in this direction.

papers.title: WiSI: Wireless-in-the-Loop Self-Improvement
papers.abstract: The growing autonomy of AI agents has enabled self-improvement, where agents iteratively refine their programs through execution feedback and performance evaluation. As these agents increasingly operate in physical environments and rely on wireless connectivity, communication conditions become an integral part of their improvement process. However, existing approaches largely assume ideal communication, overlooking how wireless conditions shape both the feedback that guides program modifications and the evaluation outcomes that determine which modifications survive. This challenge is further complicated by the coupling between agent behavior and wireless connectivity, as agents influence their own communication conditions through mobility and transmission decisions. To address this problem, we propose WiSI, a wireless-in-the-loop self-improvement framework that integrates spatiotemporal wireless channels, edge-assisted perception, and Large Language Model-driven program improvement. By incorporating wireless execution into the improvement loop, WiSI reveals how wireless execution experience shapes the generation and retention of program structures, and investigates the wireless conditions needed for robust improvement. Experiments show that agents improved under ideal links achieve only 40.0% task success under congestion, compared with 77.2% when improved under realistic wireless conditions. More importantly, wireless-aware feedback and selection jointly enable agents to discover and retain communication-efficient program structures that outperform parameter tuning and remain robust even with inaccurate run-time channel observations. We further find that moderate-load or mixed-network evaluation maintains strong performance across deployment conditions, while simplified models preserving link-rate statistics achieve comparable results without detailed spatial channel information.

papers.title: DualEvolve: Dual-Level Self-Evolution of Mechanism and Orchestration for Recommendation
papers.abstract: Recommender systems are widely used in e-commerce and content platforms, where improvement requires repeated model design, training optimization, and experimental validation. Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly automate this development cycle. Sustained autonomous improvement requires agents to improve both recommendation models and their development workflows. However, task-performance-driven approaches select updates mainly by candidates' final scores, without a separate optimization signal for experimentation quality. We therefore present DualEvolve, a dual-level framework that co-evolves recommendation mechanisms and agent orchestration toward recursive self-improvement. Inner evolution revises model and training code using task feedback to improve recommendation performance. Outer evolution scores the inner-loop experimental process, updates harness and skill rules using these scores and execution traces, and adjusts orchestration choices based on next-round scores to improve the quality of subsequent experiments. Experiments on MovieLens-1M and three Amazon Reviews 2023 subsets cover four recommendation methods and 16 settings. DualEvolve achieves higher test means than Base, OpenEvolve, and DeepEvolve in all 64 setting-metric comparisons, with macro-averaged relative gains over DeepEvolve of 7.6% (HR@5) and 9.0% (NDCG@5).

papers.title: How Agent Skills Evolve: A Large-Scale Empirical Study of Skills on GitHub
papers.abstract: Large language model-based agents increasingly rely on external skills to reuse task-specific knowledge without retraining the model. As skills become common for extending agent capabilities, understanding creation and evolution is critical for reliable agent systems. However, existing studies mainly examine agent skills from a static perspective, leaving their evolution in real-world repositories largely unexplored. This limits our understanding of the patterns and motivations behind skill changes. To fill this gap, we present a large-scale empirical study of agent skills, capturing 84,200 skills and 750,898 commits from GitHub. We manually construct taxonomies of skill components, change patterns, and evolution motivations, and build an automated annotation pipeline to label changes at scale. Based on the taxonomy, we conduct quantitative analyses of skill composition and post-creation evolution frequency, together with qualitative assessments of modified components, change patterns, and motivations. Our findings reveal five implications: (i) reliability receives less attention in skill composition and change, motivating execution-contract skill design that incorporates verification and recovery mechanisms; (ii) evolution changes concentrate in project-coupled skills, calling for automated just-in-time skill updating mechanisms; (iii) change patterns are dominated by incremental enrichment and refinement, motivating pattern-guided skill enhancers that diagnose and improve incomplete skill components; (iv) redundancy is a practical maintenance issue, highlighting the need for context-efficient skill representation; (v) security-motivated changes show limited risk reduction, suggesting skill regression testing methods that objectively verify skill functionality and security. Beyond these insights, our dataset provides a basis for future studies on automated skill techniques.

papers.title: Large Language Model-Assisted Adaptive Heuristic Search for Agile Earth Observation Satellite Scheduling
papers.abstract: Agile Earth observation satellites must coordinate imaging tasks within limited observation windows, while accounting for attitude maneuvering and onboard energy constraints. Competition among observation opportunities makes scheduling performance sensitive to the heuristic rules used for task selection. This letter proposes a large language model (LLM)-assisted adaptive heuristic search method for agile Earth observation satellite scheduling. The LLM generates an initial heuristic rule according to the characteristics of the scheduling instance. During the subsequent ant colony search, search performance and scheduling information are fed back to the LLM to refine the heuristic rule. The proposed modifications are evaluated through paired solution constructions before being incorporated into the search process. A unified scheduling procedure determines task selection, satellite assignment, and observation timing under the operational constraints. Experiments on six scheduling scenarios involving 50--200 imaging tasks demonstrate that the proposed method achieves 4.3\%--9.6\% higher mean observation benefit than the strongest baseline.

papers.title: $τ$-Rec-Books: A Disclosure-Controlled Benchmark for Requirement Elicitation in Agentic Recommender Systems
papers.abstract: While conversational recommendation systems provide a more natural user interface, they face the challenge of progressively discovering a user's needs before they can recommend an item that satisfies them. To evaluate the ability of AI agents at this elicitation process, we introduce $\tau$-Rec-Books, a benchmark that holds each user request fixed while varying only when the user reveals their requirements: all at the start (volunteer), one at the start and the rest when asked (mixed), or some never (hidden). A hidden requirement can be found only by proposing books and inferring it from the user's accept or reject verdicts. We generate 450 tasks over a catalog of 20,000 books from Wikidata, develop a rule-based simulated user to answer the agent, and score recommendations against catalog metadata without an LLM judge. Across four agents and two search interfaces, success rates fall for every agent and interface, on average from 0.975 (volunteer) to 0.756 (mixed) and 0.283 (hidden). Mixed tasks fail mainly because agents do not ask, and when told to ask, every agent reaches at least 0.931. On hidden tasks, most failures come from agents recommending a book they never proposed to the user. When told to propose first, agents only match a simple baseline that proposes popular books, and stay well below one that uses rejection to rule out possible requirements. We release the catalog pipeline, task generator, simulated user, validators, reference agents, and all agent traces at this https URL.

papers.title: Theoretical Analysis of Muon on Transformers for Next-Token Prediction
papers.abstract: Muon has recently shown strong empirical performance in training Transformer-based large language models (LLMs), yet its optimization dynamics remain poorly understood from a theoretical perspective. In this paper, we analyze the training dynamics of Muon for next-token prediction (NTP) in Transformers. The training procedure consists of two phases: the preprocessing phase learns the output-value component, while the main phase learns the key-query component. For the preprocessing phase, we characterize the optimization trajectory exactly and show that the normalized spectral margin is optimal after each update. For the main phase, we establish nonasymptotic convergence rates for the training loss and the normalized margin gap under softmax attention. These results suggest that Muon's update rule can help models efficiently learn which tokens matter for prediction, offering a possible explanation for its strong performance in large language model training. The learned weight structure also yields a generalization guarantee for unseen contexts. Furthermore, we validate our theoretical insights with experiments on next-token prediction tasks.

papers.title: From Watching to Steering: Enabling Human-Coding Agent Collaboration through Execution Traces
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled coding agents to autonomously perform complex software development tasks, yet their long-running execution remains difficult for users to inspect, understand, and steer. We present Vibetrace, an interactive trace visualization and intervention system for agentic programming built upon OpenCode. Vibetrace introduces a human-agent collaboration paradigm of Observe, Understand, Intervene, and Evolve. It (1) visualizes agent workflows as interactive execution traces for inspecting actions, intermediate states, and failures; (2) enables users to fork execution from prior steps and provide targeted corrections without restarting validated progress; and (3) distills traces and human feedback into reusable skills for continual agent evolution. On SWE-bench Verified, distilled skills reduce input tokens by 23.0% and cost by 15.5%, while improving pass rate from 65.0% to 68.0%. User studies further demonstrate improved accuracy and efficiency over conventional log-based interaction.

papers.title: Treating the Symptom, Missing the Cause: Anatomy of a Scientific Reasoning Failure
papers.abstract: Scientific agents can find interventions that work without understanding why they do. We study this failure mode in controlled synthetic regulatory systems, where agents must experimentally identify a hidden fault and rescue the resulting phenotype. Across seven LLMs, every model restores the healthy phenotypes more often than it identifies the fault. Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 rescue every organism while diagnosing only 55% and 35% of them. This failure is not simply due to insufficient exploration or unavailable evidence. In most cases, the cause is experimentally identifiable, and agents encounter evidence that distinguishes competing causes in 91% of relevant sessions, and still frequently misdiagnose the system. Targeted probes reveal where experimental reasoning breaks down. Models reliably interpret decisive evidence and revise hypotheses when the causal comparison is explicit, and can locate that evidence within a full experimental record. However, they struggle to predict the outcome of the experiment under each competing cause, a necessary step in using the observed result to distinguish between them. Agents can therefore gather the right evidence and still infer the wrong cause. As AI systems take on a growing role in synthesising scientific evidence, these findings highlight the need to evaluate how they use evidence to reach causal conclusions, alongside whether their interventions succeed.

papers.title: Goal-Driven Autonomous Optical Experimentation via a Self-Recursive Hardware-Software Harness
papers.abstract: We propose goal-driven self-recursive optical research in which agents use physical evidence to revise the hardware, software, models, and protocols used to pursue a scientific goal. The framework can be instantiated with different stimulus systems and measurement devices. We formalize its updates and derive a relation between physical attainability, command access, and model approximation error. We demonstrate the concept in an optical see-through color-matching case study using an iPad, RayNeo X3 glasses, and a TOP 300 probe coupled to a CAS140D spectroradiometer, both from Instrument Systems. A revised glasses application adds USB-controlled RGB holds and frame acknowledgements, keeping model-generated colors displayed during spectral acquisition. The interface passes 12 live control checks. Spectral feedback reduces one target color difference from 19.756 to 1.211 {\Delta}E_76^*; all five targets improve in a separate comparison. These measurements demonstrate the concept in one configuration. The resulting software and protocols remain available for subsequent investigations.

papers.title: TEMPO: Time Series Understanding via Discrete Tokenization
papers.abstract: Time-series interpretation often requires both numerical observations and textual context. Integrating these inputs into a pretrained language model raises a representation question: how should a signal enter the model's token sequence? We present TEMPO, which extends an LLM's vocabulary with discrete codes from a context-aware Transformer tokenizer using finite scalar quantization. A frozen tokenizer maps four-step patches to a 625-code vocabulary; signal tokens, scale statistics, and text are then processed by the LLM's existing self-attention layers. Adaptation updates the new token embeddings and DoRA adapters. With a Qwen3-4B backbone and task-specific fine-tuning, TEMPO achieves macro-F1 scores of 89.0% on activity recognition, 85.0% on sleep staging, and 86.0% on bearing-fault diagnosis. Time-series question answering and qualitative bearing-diagnosis examples further illustrate how this interface combines signal representations with textual context. Together, these results demonstrate the utility of discrete vocabulary extension for time-series understanding.

Together, these results demonstrate the utility of discrete vocabulary extension for time-series understanding.

papers.title: CogniLife: Continuous Cognitive Distillation for Deployed Multi-Expert Agent Marketplaces
papers.abstract: Multi-expert agent marketplaces -- where creators publish domain-specific AI experts for end users to consult -- are an emerging deployment pattern for language technology. A published expert can receive many requests yet little evidence about its creator, who remains active elsewhere: the cold-expert problem. We frame continuous cognitive distillation as converting attributed creator observations into revisable decision rules, communication patterns, and domain procedures. CogniLife proposes a cross-expert attribution design for this problem, with Creator Profiles for transferable creator patterns and Expert Journals for listing-specific knowledge; this design is not yet implemented or evaluated. A deployed platform partially realizes the surrounding lifecycle through creator-authorized authoring, capability-owned proposal filtering, and reversible consolidation of eligible owner-scoped memory. On ProfyBench-v1, an 85-task offline benchmark built from replay seeds and controlled internal tests, the Profy Full configuration as a whole achieves a mean overall score of 4.65/5 from the primary LLM judge, compared with 4.01 for Raw LLM and 4.28 for Expert Prompt, with the largest gains in completeness, specificity, and missing-information tasks. These configuration-level scores do not test cold-expert mitigation, cross-expert transfer, or longitudinal distillation.
