papers.title: Reducing Logprob Without Causal Verification: Diagnosing SAE-Based PII Suppression in LLMs
papers.abstract: SAE-based feature-level interventions to suppress PII leakage in LLMs are primarily evaluated by log-probability reduction. We show that this criterion cannot distinguish feature specific suppression from a magnitude artifact: a direction-agnostic effect of sufficiently large activation perturbations. Across 36 (model, layer, PII type) cases, we compare selected SAE feature interventions with coherencematched random direction controls using logprob and rank-aware metrics. While 17 cases (47%) appear successful under logprob-only evaluation, only 1 case (2.8%) passes our multimetric framework. The rest reveal two failure modes: random directions outperform selected features, and feature selection collapse across PII types. These results indicate that existing evaluations cannot verify whether interventions target causal pathways of PII leakage. A 9,000 run causal mediation feasibility study corroborates this: the verifier separates candidates reliably, but correlation-selected candidates rarely pass it. We therefore propose a new research mission for NLP: causally grounded PII suppression through circuit-level localization and causal mediation analysis.

translation.title: 无需因果验证的 Logprob 降低：诊断基于 SAE 的 LLM PII 抑制方法
translation.abstract: 基于 SAE 的特征级干预被用于抑制 LLM 中的 PII 泄露，其评估主要依赖对数概率（logprob）的降低。我们证明这一标准无法区分特征特异性抑制与幅度伪影——即足够大的激活扰动所产生的方向无关效应。在 36 个（模型、层、PII 类型）案例中，我们使用 logprob 和秩感知指标，将选定的 SAE 特征干预与连贯性匹配的随机方向对照进行比较。尽管 17 个案例（47%）在仅用 logprob 的评估下看似成功，但只有 1 个案例（2.8%）通过我们的多指标框架。其余案例揭示了两种失败模式：随机方向优于选定特征，以及特征选择在不同 PII 类型间崩溃。这些结果表明，现有评估无法验证干预是否针对 PII 泄露的因果通路。一项 9,000 次运行的因果中介可行性研究证实了这一点：验证器能够可靠地区分候选者，但通过相关性选出的候选者很少能通过验证。因此，我们提出 NLP 的一个新研究使命：通过电路级定位和因果中介分析实现因果扎实的 PII 抑制。
translation.brief: 针对现有仅用 logprob 降低评估 SAE 特征干预抑制 PII 泄露无法区分因果效应与幅度伪影的问题，提出结合随机方向对照与因果中介分析的多指标评估框架来诊断干预是否真正作用于因果通路。

papers.title: Training Specialist LLMs on Your Phone: Forward-Only Optimization via Block-Spectral Coordinates
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) on personal devices keep user data local, but limited memory restricts their general capability. Since most user-specific tasks do not require the breadth of frontier models, a practical solution is to adapt a shared on-device model into lightweight specialists. However, backpropagation is prohibitive in memory, and users rarely provide labeled data. We present MobileSpec, a system that trains specialists with forward passes alone and learns from automatically checked task outcomes, as in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Because forward-only updates are built from random perturbations, training is efficient only when these perturbations resemble the weight changes of RLVR, which largely preserve the singular values of pretrained weights and rotate their singular vectors. The core algorithm of MobileSpec, FuRA-S, produces such perturbations while training only the block-spectral coordinates of pretrained weights, namely the singular values of their column blocks. As we show theoretically and empirically, rescaling these blocks independently shifts their relative contributions to each weight matrix and thereby rotates its singular vectors. Since this update can be rewritten as a transformation of the layer input, FuRA-S also adapts INT4 models without modifying their weights. With specialists of only 1-5 MB that update 0.015-0.05% of the parameters, MobileSpec raises the success rate of a phone-use agent from 6-23% up to 89-100% and trains a personalized 8B model on an iPhone 16 Pro overnight. On RLVR benchmarks, FuRA-S is competitive with full-parameter evolution strategies (ES) and outperforms ES over LoRA adapters and quantized ES on INT4 models.

translation.title: 在手机上训练专用 LLM：基于块谱坐标的前向传播优化
translation.abstract: 个人设备上的大语言模型（LLM）可将用户数据保留在本地，但有限的内存限制了其通用能力。由于大多数用户特定任务并不需要前沿模型的广度，一种实用的解决方案是将共享的端侧模型适配为轻量级专用模型。然而，反向传播在内存上代价过高，且用户很少提供标注数据。我们提出 MobileSpec，一个仅通过前向传播训练专用模型、并从自动校验的任务结果中学习的系统，类似于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）。由于仅前向的更新由随机扰动构成，只有当这些扰动类似于 RLVR 的权重变化时训练才高效——RLVR 的权重变化在很大程度上保持预训练权重的奇异值并旋转其奇异向量。MobileSpec 的核心算法 FuRA-S 在只训练预训练权重的块谱坐标（即其列块的奇异值）的同时，产生此类扰动。正如我们从理论和实验上所证明的，独立缩放这些块会改变它们对每个权重矩阵的相对贡献，从而旋转其奇异向量。由于该更新可改写为对层输入的变换，FuRA-S 还能在不修改权重的情况下适配 INT4 模型。借助仅 1-5 MB、更新 0.015-0.05% 参数的专用模型，MobileSpec 将手机使用 agent 的成功率从 6-23% 提升至 89-100%，并在 iPhone 16 Pro 上一夜之间训练出一个个性化 8B 模型。在 RLVR 基准上，FuRA-S 与全参数进化策略（ES）相当，并优于基于 LoRA 适配器的 ES 和 INT4 模型上的量化 ES。
translation.brief: 针对端侧设备内存受限且无标注数据导致无法用反向传播训练专用模型的问题，提出 MobileSpec 系统，通过仅前向传播训练权重块谱坐标（列块奇异值）的 FuRA-S 算法，从自动校验的任务结果中学习。

papers.title: Extracting System Prompt of LLM Services in Complex (Agentic) Settings: Hierarchical Optimization and Reliable Evaluation Metrics
papers.abstract: System prompt is a critical intellectual property of large language model (LLM) services. To analyze its leakage, prompt extraction attacks have been extensively studied. However, we validate that existing attacks substantially degrade on recent LLM services, whose complexity has evolved in both the prompt itself and system-level constraints. Specifically, (1) system prompts become longer and more structured to contain pre-defined tool schemas, execution logic, safety guardrails, etc., and (2) only the final post-processed outputs (e.g., agent's actions) but not the raw textual response can be observed. In this paper, we address the above increased complexity by proposing Extraction with Hierarchical Optimization (ExtraHerO), which (1) decomposes the prompt extraction into a hierarchical reconstruction process with a pre-defined structural prompt template, and (2) iteratively updates the adversarial query with guidance of feedback-template differences to observe diverse outputs. In particular, we monitor the information gain of attack optimization to early stop or reset it for a good trade-off between effectiveness and efficiency. We also find that existing evaluation metrics for prompt fidelity can be misleading because they do not account for structural information. Therefore, we rely on global textual similarity and prioritize structural keywords. Moreover, we introduce a system-level metric, adversarial utility, to measure the help of prompt extraction for real-world downstream attacks. Experimental results demonstrate the consistent superiority of ExtraHerO, with average improvements of 12.5\% (fidelity), 2.3\% (functionality), and 6.0\% (adversarial utility) on chatbots, and 12.2\%, 34.3\%, and 30.5\% on agents.

translation.title: 在复杂（Agentic）场景中提取 LLM 服务的系统提示词：分层优化与可靠评估指标
translation.abstract: 系统提示词是大语言模型（LLM）服务的关键知识产权。为分析其泄露问题，提示词提取攻击已被广泛研究。然而，我们验证了现有攻击在近期的 LLM 服务上性能大幅下降，这些服务的复杂性在提示词本身和系统级约束两方面都有所提升。具体而言：（1）系统提示词变得更长、更结构化，以包含预定义的工具 schema、执行逻辑、安全护栏等；（2）只能观察到最终的后处理输出（如 agent 的动作），而无法观察到原始文本响应。本文通过提出分层优化提取方法（ExtraHerO）来应对上述复杂性提升：（1）将提示词提取分解为基于预定义结构化提示词模板的分层重建过程；（2）在反馈模板差异的引导下迭代更新对抗性查询，以观察多样化的输出。特别地，我们监控攻击优化的信息增益，以进行提前停止或重置，从而在有效性与效率之间取得良好权衡。我们还发现，现有的提示词保真度评估指标可能产生误导，因为它们未考虑结构信息。因此，我们依赖全局文本相似性并优先考虑结构化关键词。此外，我们引入一个系统级指标——对抗效用，用于衡量提示词提取对真实下游攻击的帮助。实验结果表明 ExtraHerO 具有一致的优势：在聊天机器人上平均提升 12.5%（保真度）、2.3%（功能性）和 6.0%（对抗效用），在 agent 上分别提升 12.2%、34.3% 和 30.5%。
translation.brief: 针对现有提示词提取攻击在结构化长系统提示词和仅可观察后处理输出的复杂 LLM 服务上失效的问题，提出 ExtraHerO 方法，通过分层重建与基于反馈模板差异的迭代对抗查询优化来提取系统提示词，并引入考虑结构信息和对抗效用的评估指标。

papers.title: Where Is the Truth When AI Agents Disagree? Dependence-Aware Belief Propagation for Unsupervised Truth Discovery (Extended Version)
papers.abstract: LLM agents often give conflicting answers to the same question, and many deployed agents are variants of one base model, so their errors are correlated. We study truth discovery among such agents: inferring the true answer and each agent's reliability without labels. Classical truth-discovery and crowdsourcing estimators reward an agreeing bloc and can fall below majority vote. We propose BP-TD, which adds per-agent decorrelation weights to mean-field variational inference on a one-coin Dawid-Skene model, so that agents sharing a base model count together as about one vote. Its first iteration is exactly a weighted vote; later iterations estimate agent reliability. With 13 local agents on MMLU, BP-TD beats majority vote without any labels (0.716 vs. 0.624 on 160 questions; 0.707 vs. 0.674 on 10,000) and ranks agents by their true accuracy, which classical estimators invert. The gain depends on the pool: over 2,852 sub-pools of four benchmarks, decorrelation helps when the largest correlated bloc is weaker than the other agents and hurts when it is the strongest, and we found no label-free statistic that tells the two cases apart. Labels change the picture quickly: with 20 labelled questions, selecting the single best agent is more accurate than every aggregator we tested on MMLU, ARC and TruthfulQA.

translation.title: 当 AI Agent 意见不一时，真相何在？用于无监督真相发现的依赖感知信念传播（扩展版）
translation.abstract: LLM agent 对同一问题常常给出相互矛盾的答案，且许多已部署的 agent 是同一基础模型的变体，因此它们的错误是相关的。我们研究此类 agent 之间的真相发现问题：在无标签的情况下推断真实答案及每个 agent 的可靠性。经典的真相发现和众包估计器会奖励达成一致的群体，其表现可能低于多数投票。我们提出 BP-TD，在单币 Dawid-Skene 模型的平均场变分推断基础上，为每个 agent 添加去相关权重，使共享同一基础模型的 agent 合计只算约一票。其第一次迭代恰好是加权投票；后续迭代则估计 agent 的可靠性。在 MMLU 上使用 13 个本地 agent，BP-TD 在无任何标签的情况下胜过多数投票（160 题上 0.716 对 0.624；10,000 题上 0.707 对 0.674），并能按真实准确率对 agent 排序，而经典估计器会颠倒排序。收益取决于 agent 池：在四个基准的 2,852 个子池上，当最大的相关群体弱于其他 agent 时去相关有帮助，而当它最强时则有害，且我们未找到能区分这两种情况的无标签统计量。标签会迅速改变局面：仅用 20 道标注题，选择单一最佳 agent 就比我们在 MMLU、ARC 和 TruthfulQA 上测试的所有聚合器更准确。
translation.brief: 针对共享基础模型的 LLM agent 错误相关导致经典无监督真相发现方法失效的问题，提出 BP-TD，在 Dawid-Skene 模型的变分推断中加入按 agent 的去相关权重，使相关 agent 合计约为一票。

papers.title: AgenticFinBench: Benchmarking Financial Agents on Diverse Tasks from Real-World Requests
papers.abstract: Financial agents are becoming an important class of real-world AI systems. Financial tasks vary widely in type and difficulty, and many are open-ended with no ground-truth answers. However, existing benchmarks neither capture this breadth and open-endedness nor separate grounding from correctness. To bridge this gap, we introduce $\textbf{AgenticFinBench}$, a benchmark of 230 real-world financial tasks spanning 8 categories, 2 languages, and 4 complexity levels. We also propose a reference-free evaluation framework that combines question-specific rubrics with a two-stage claim audit that detects hallucinations, defined as claims absent from the agent's trace and refuted by external evidence. This framework better matches how financial work is assessed in practice. Experiments across 18 agent configurations reveal three key findings: (1) Ignoring hallucinations can overstate agent performance: hallucination auditing lowers the baseline leader's score by 7.58 points and moves it to fourth place. (2) Harness differences explain more variation in evidence grounding than model differences (28.6% vs 8.8%). (3) Quality scores fall from 89.44 on direct retrieval to 79.18 on the most complex tasks. Case studies show that agents struggle to explain how events affect company profits or stock prices, compare financial data on a consistent basis, and justify their conclusions. By releasing AgenticFinBench, we aim to advance financial reasoning, factual verification, and agent design for more reliable responses to diverse real-world financial requests. Our project page is at $\textbf{this https URL}$.

translation.title: AgenticFinBench：基于真实世界请求的多样化任务金融 Agent 基准测试
translation.abstract: 金融 agent 正在成为现实世界 AI 系统的重要类别。金融任务在类型和难度上差异很大，且许多是开放式的、没有标准答案。然而，现有基准既未能捕捉这种广度和开放性，也未能将事实依据与正确性区分开来。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 AgenticFinBench，一个包含 230 个真实世界金融任务的基准，涵盖 8 个类别、2 种语言和 4 个复杂度级别。我们还提出一个无参考评估框架，该框架将针对具体问题的评分细则与两阶段声明审计相结合，以检测幻觉——定义为 agent 轨迹中不存在且被外部证据反驳的声明。该框架更符合金融工作在实践中的评估方式。跨 18 种 agent 配置的实验揭示了三个关键发现：（1）忽略幻觉会高估 agent 性能：幻觉审计使基线领先者的得分降低 7.58 分并使其降至第四名。（2）Harness 差异对证据依据变异的解释力大于模型差异（28.6% 对 8.8%）。（3）质量得分从直接检索的 89.44 降至最复杂任务上的 79.18。案例研究表明，agent 难以解释事件如何影响公司利润或股价、难以在一致口径上比较金融数据、以及难以论证其结论。通过发布 AgenticFinBench，我们旨在推进金融推理、事实核查和 agent 设计，以更可靠地响应多样化的真实世界金融请求。项目页面见 this https URL。
translation.brief: 针对现有基准无法覆盖金融任务的广度、开放性且未区分事实依据与正确性的问题，构建包含 230 个真实金融任务的 AgenticFinBench，并提出结合评分细则与两阶段幻觉审计的无参考评估框架。

papers.title: Feeling of Knowing in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Post-training updates change what large language models (LLMs) can answer, but may leave their answerability judgments misaligned. We study this knowledge-judgment desynchronization through functional feeling of knowing (FoK), which supports selective generation, retrieval triggering, and model routing without implying subjective experience. We propose two trainable channels: a knowledge channel that changes answerability and a FoK channel that judges the current knowledge state. Three stages train them: on-policy supervised fine-tuning (OP-SFT) updates knowledge from corrected on-policy answers; knowledge-delta FoK training (K$\Delta$-FT) adapts judgments across intermediate knowledge states; and FoK-guided policy optimization (FGPO) trains the subsequent answer or explanation. Factual-QA experiments, cross-dataset evaluation, and three sequential updates show that explicit FoK alignment improves judgment quality on updated knowledge. MMLU and ARC-Easy separately assess capability preservation.

translation.title: 大语言模型中的知晓感
translation.abstract: 后训练更新会改变大语言模型（LLM）能够回答的问题，但可能使其可答性判断与实际知识脱节。我们通过功能性知晓感（FoK）研究这种知识与判断的失同步现象，FoK 支持选择性生成、检索触发和模型路由，而不涉及主观体验。我们提出两条可训练通道：改变可答性的知识通道，以及判断当前知识状态的 FoK 通道。训练分三个阶段：在策略监督微调（OP-SFT）从修正后的在策略答案中更新知识；知识增量 FoK 训练（K$\Delta$-FT）使判断适应中间知识状态；FoK 引导的策略优化（FGPO）训练后续的回答或解释。事实问答实验、跨数据集评估和三次顺序更新表明，显式的 FoK 对齐能提升对更新后知识的判断质量。MMLU 和 ARC-Easy 分别用于评估能力保持。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 后训练后知识与可答性判断脱节的问题，提出通过知识通道与 FoK 通道的三阶段训练（OP-SFT、KΔ-FT、FGPO）实现显式知晓感对齐。

papers.title: HTCE: Homeomorphism-inspired Topological Cross-Scene Experience Canonicalization and Reuse for Object Navigation
papers.abstract: As embodied agents perform object-goal navigation across residential environments, they accumulate successful experiences whose semantic structure recurs across scenes even when geometric trajectories do not. Reusing such experience is challenging because differences in region naming and observation granularity produce distinct graph representations of similar approaches, while meaningful differences in anchors, branches, and endpoints must stay distinguishable. We introduce HTCE, a homeomorphism-inspired topological framework that canonicalizes and reuses navigation experience. Feature and topology subdivisions characterize representational variations, and their semantically constrained reductions produce comparable semantic sequences and structural signatures while preserving semantic anchors, branching relations, and navigation endpoints. HTCE then retrieves historical successful approaches through subdivision-aware matching as guidance for a frozen vision-language policy. Canonicalization compresses the experience index losslessly, merging 17.7--23.6\% of distinct stored route descriptions while retaining full task performance. Under a single frozen vision-language backbone shared by all compared systems, HTCE attains the best SR and SPL in every setting---59.9\%/31.8\% on HM3D v0.1, 71.0\%/31.5\% on HM3D v0.2, and 46.6\%/16.6\% on MP3D---with SR gains of up to 4.9 points and structured retrieval contributing up to 2.8 SPL points. The code is available in this https URL

translation.title: HTCE：面向目标导航的基于同胚启发的拓扑跨场景经验规范化与复用
translation.abstract: 随着具身智能体在住宅环境中执行目标导航，它们会积累成功经验，这些经验的语义结构在不同场景中反复出现，即使几何轨迹并不相同。复用此类经验具有挑战性，因为区域命名和观察粒度的差异会为相似的方法产生不同的图表示，而锚点、分支和端点的有意义差异又必须保持可区分。我们提出 HTCE，一个受同胚启发的拓扑框架，用于规范化和复用导航经验。特征与拓扑细分刻画表示变化，其语义约束下的约简产生可比较的语义序列和结构签名，同时保留语义锚点、分支关系和导航端点。HTCE 随后通过感知细分的匹配检索历史成功方法，作为冻结视觉-语言策略的引导。规范化无损压缩经验索引，合并了 17.7%–23.6% 的不同存储路线描述，同时保持完整任务性能。在所有对比系统共享单一冻结视觉-语言骨干的条件下，HTCE 在所有设置中取得最佳 SR 和 SPL——HM3D v0.1 上 59.9%/31.8%，HM3D v0.2 上 71.0%/31.5%，MP3D 上 46.6%/16.6%——SR 提升最高达 4.9 个百分点，结构化检索贡献最高 2.8 个 SPL 点。代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 针对跨场景导航经验因命名与粒度差异难以复用的问题，提出基于同胚启发的拓扑规范化框架 HTCE，通过细分与语义约束约简实现经验匹配检索并引导冻结视觉-语言策略。

papers.title: Found by Search, Broken by a Shortcut: Transfer and Tampering of Searched Intrinsic Rewards
papers.abstract: Can a search over innate drives find intrinsic rewards that help a reinforcement-learning agent learn, transfer to a task it never saw, and resist an exploit that was absent during the search? Each candidate reward combines four generic events (a new view, a pickup, a drop and a toggle), each with a weight, a relief and a refill rate. We ran three pre-registered stages; the search protocol was locked in a public, timestamped commit before any search result existed. CMA-ES and an equal-budget random search used 1,560 PPO training runs, and the final evaluation and tamper test used 340. On the held-out task, KeyCorridorS3R2, the CMA-ES-selected reward (E) beat task-only PPO, episodic novelty and the random-search-selected reward (R) in all 3 registered comparisons, all of them meaningful by the registered size rule. Among these generic rewards E transferred best; the earlier paper's satiation reward, which on this task is given hand-wired key and locked-door events, did better (20 of 20 seeds solved against 4 of 20; descriptive). On UnlockPickup, where that reward uses generic events, E's mean area exceeded it by 0.276 (descriptive). On the training tasks there was no registered difference between E and R: both E-over-R tests missed. A free reset action, absent during the search, collapsed E's learning on DoorKey-8x8 (mean area 0.829 without it, 0.136 with it; registered) to below task-only PPO (descriptive). The searched drives helped on every task tested, but a reward given task-specific events did better on the held-out task, and selection gave E no protection against an exploit absent from the search.

translation.title: 搜索所得，捷径所破：搜索到的内在奖励的迁移与篡改
translation.abstract: 对内在驱动的搜索能否找到既帮助强化学习智能体学习、又能迁移到从未见过的任务、并抵抗搜索期间不存在的漏洞利用的内在奖励？每个候选奖励组合四种通用事件（新视野、拾取、放置和切换），各带权重、缓解率和补充率。我们执行了三个预注册阶段；搜索协议在任何搜索结果产生之前就被锁定在一个公开的、带时间戳的提交中。CMA-ES 和等预算随机搜索使用了 1,560 次 PPO 训练运行，最终评估和篡改测试使用了 340 次。在留出任务 KeyCorridorS3R2 上，CMA-ES 选出的奖励（E）在全部 3 项注册比较中胜过仅任务 PPO、情景新颖性和随机搜索选出的奖励（R），且按注册的效应量规则均具有意义。在这些通用奖励中 E 迁移最好；早期论文的饱足奖励在此任务上被手工接入了钥匙和锁门事件，表现更好（20 个种子中解决 20 个对 4 个；描述性）。在 UnlockPickup 上，该奖励使用通用事件，E 的平均面积超出其 0.276（描述性）。在训练任务上 E 与 R 之间没有注册差异：两项 E-over-R 检验均未通过。一个搜索期间不存在的自由重置动作使 E 在 DoorKey-8x8 上的学习崩溃（无该动作平均面积 0.829，有该动作 0.136；已注册），低于仅任务 PPO（描述性）。搜索到的驱动在所有测试任务上都有帮助，但一个被赋予任务特定事件的奖励在留出任务上表现更好，且选择过程未能使 E 免受搜索中不存在的漏洞利用。
translation.brief: 研究搜索得到的内在奖励能否迁移到未见任务并抵抗搜索外的漏洞利用，通过预注册的 CMA-ES 搜索与大规模 PPO 实验进行系统评估。

papers.title: One Assistant, Many Memories: Benchmarking Real-World Group Assistance When Recall Is Not Enough
papers.abstract: The value of memory lies not only in recall but in using it to provide appropriate assistance. Recent benchmarks test memory use in personalisation and agentic tasks, but seldom evaluate assistance without fixed answers or integration across multiple participants. Group chats make both challenges more acute: an assistant must integrate information from multiple members, track revisions and conflicts over time, and produce one response for the group. Yet existing group memory benchmarks rely on synthetic conversations and inherit constrained evaluation from general memory benchmarks, focusing on recall against fixed answers or decisions over a closed set. We introduce GroupAssistBench, the first memory benchmark from real-world group conversations with a deployed group assistant, covering 80,299 messages in 50 groups and costing over $53K. Over the same histories, GroupAssistBench evaluates memory recall (L1) with reference answers and memory use (L2) with service requests without fixed answers across single, distributed, and conflicting memories (M1--M3). Requests are verified to require group history, memories are anchored to their sources, and L2 uses tailored rubrics with penalties derived from real user feedback. Across evaluations of frontier models with full context, retrieval methods, and memory systems, the strongest memory system rivals full context on recall but falls far behind on use, especially for distributed and conflicting memories. Together, two additions that relate retrieved memories and bind remembered facts as response constraints bring consistent gains, showing that group memory systems must improve use, not recall alone.

translation.title: 一个助手，多份记忆：当召回不足时对真实世界群组辅助的基准测试
translation.abstract: 记忆的价值不仅在于召回，更在于利用它提供恰当的辅助。近期基准测试了个性化和智能体任务中的记忆使用，但很少评估没有固定答案的辅助或跨多个参与者的信息整合。群聊使这两个挑战更加突出：助手必须整合多个成员的信息，跟踪随时间的修订与冲突，并为群组生成一个回复。然而现有群组记忆基准依赖合成对话，并继承了通用记忆基准的受限评估，聚焦于对照固定答案的召回或封闭集合上的决策。我们提出 GroupAssistBench，首个来自真实世界群组对话（配有已部署群组助手）的记忆基准，涵盖 50 个群组的 80,299 条消息，成本超过 5.3 万美元。在相同历史记录上，GroupAssistBench 用参考答案评估记忆召回（L1），用无固定答案的服务请求评估记忆使用（L2），覆盖单一、分布式和冲突记忆（M1–M3）。请求经验证确实需要群组历史，记忆锚定到其来源，L2 使用由真实用户反馈导出惩罚的定制评分细则。在对前沿模型（全上下文）、检索方法和记忆系统的评估中，最强的记忆系统在召回上可与全上下文媲美，但在使用上远落后，尤其是分布式和冲突记忆。两项将检索到的记忆相互关联并将记忆事实绑定为回复约束的改进带来一致增益，表明群组记忆系统必须改进使用，而不仅是召回。
translation.brief: 针对群组助手记忆使用（而非仅召回）缺乏真实评测的问题，构建首个基于真实群聊的记忆基准 GroupAssistBench，分层评估召回与无固定答案的辅助使用。

papers.title: TraceRouter++: Causal Semantic Routing Realignment via Optimal Transport
papers.abstract: Despite their remarkable capabilities, large foundation models (LFMs) remain susceptible to adversarial manipulation. Current safety intervention methods primarily rely on the \textit{locality hypothesis}, rigidly suppressing isolated neurons or features. However, harmful semantics manifest as distributed, cross-layer circuits, rendering localized ablations both brittle against complex jailbreaks and detrimental to general utility. To bridge this gap, we propose TraceRouter++, a routing-level safety intervention framework that explicitly traces safety-relevant causal routing pathways activated under harmful inputs and realigns their unsafe activation states. Our framework operates in a \textit{Discover-Trace-Realign} paradigm: it first pinpoints a sensitive onset layer via attention divergence and disentangles dense activations into interpretable routing features using sparse autoencoders (SAEs). Subsequently, it maps these features to downstream causal circuits via feature influence scores (FIS). Crucially, departing from rigid suppression paradigms, TraceRouter++ introduces a constrained optimal transport (OT)-based soft routing realignment. By formulating safety intervention as a tractable coordinate-wise marginal optimal transport approximation, our method redirects unsafe activation marginals toward safe-reference marginals within causally identified routing subspaces while preserving non-selected coordinates at the intervention point. This mechanism safely redirects malicious semantic flows while leaving orthogonal computational routes intact. Extensive experiments across representative large language models (LLMs), multimodal large language models (MLLMs), and diffusion models (DMs) show that TraceRouter++ outperforms evaluated baselines, improving adversarial robustness while maintaining a favorable safety-utility trade-off. WARNING: This paper contains unsafe model responses.

translation.title: TraceRouter++：基于最优传输的因果语义路由重对齐
translation.abstract: 尽管具备卓越能力，大型基础模型（LFM）仍易受对抗性操纵。当前的安全干预方法主要依赖局部性假设，僵硬地抑制孤立的神经元或特征。然而，有害语义表现为分布式的跨层回路，使局部消融既难以抵御复杂越狱，又损害通用能力。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 TraceRouter++，一个路由级安全干预框架，显式追踪有害输入下激活的安全相关因果路由通路，并重对齐其不安全激活状态。我们的框架遵循“发现-追踪-重对齐”范式：首先通过注意力散度定位敏感起始层，并使用稀疏自编码器（SAE）将稠密激活解耦为可解释的路由特征。随后，通过特征影响分数（FIS）将这些特征映射到下游因果回路。关键在于，不同于僵硬的抑制范式，TraceRouter++ 引入基于约束最优传输（OT）的软路由重对齐。通过将安全干预表述为可求解的逐坐标边际最优传输近似，我们的方法在因果识别的路由子空间内将不安全激活边际重定向到安全参考边际，同时保持干预点处未选坐标不变。该机制安全地重定向恶意语义流，同时保持正交计算通路完好。在代表性大语言模型（LLM）、多模态大语言模型（MLLM）和扩散模型（DM）上的大量实验表明，TraceRouter++ 优于所评估的基线，在提升对抗鲁棒性的同时保持良好的安全-效用权衡。警告：本文包含不安全的模型回复。
translation.brief: 针对局部抑制式安全干预脆弱且损害通用能力的问题，提出 TraceRouter++，通过 SAE 特征解耦、因果追踪与最优传输软重对齐来重定向有害语义路由。

papers.title: ScamWorld: An Interactive Environment for Evaluating Web Agents Against Online Fraud
papers.abstract: Web agents increasingly browse, shop, and manage accounts on behalf of their users. Prior work has shown that they can be misled by adversarial content, including prompt injections and deceptive interfaces. Beyond such attacks, agents operating on the open web also encounter online fraud designed to deceive humans, including fraudulent online stores, fake investment platforms, and advance-fee schemes. How web agents respond to such fraud during task execution remains underexplored, in part because scam websites are short-lived, making systematic evaluation difficult. To address this gap, we introduce ScamWorld, an interactive environment that reconstructs reported scam websites across diverse scenarios, fraud mechanisms, and languages. Each reconstructed website reproduces documented fraud mechanisms, making relevant signs of fraud observable before the agent's final action and enabling controlled, repeatable evaluation. Through an extensive study of web agents powered by six frontier LLMs, we find that baseline deception rates range from 11% to 35% across models. Agents proceed more readily with payments than with requests for credentials or wallet information. A closer analysis of agent trajectories shows that some agents acknowledge suspicious conditions yet proceed, at times treating the user's instructions as authorisation to accept additional terms imposed by the website. ScamWorld provides a reusable testbed for systematically evaluating and stress-testing web agents against real-world online fraud.

translation.title: ScamWorld：用于评估 Web Agent 应对网络诈骗能力的交互式环境
translation.abstract: Web Agent 越来越多地代表用户浏览网页、购物和管理账户。已有研究表明，它们可能被对抗性内容误导，包括提示注入和欺骗性界面。除此类攻击外，在开放网络上运行的 Agent 还会遇到旨在欺骗人类的网络诈骗，例如欺诈性网店、虚假投资平台和预付费骗局。Web Agent 在任务执行过程中如何应对此类诈骗仍缺乏研究，部分原因在于诈骗网站生命周期短暂，使系统性评估难以开展。为填补这一空白，我们提出 ScamWorld，一个交互式环境，可在多种场景、诈骗机制和语言下重建被举报的诈骗网站。每个重建的网站都复现了有据可查的诈骗机制，使相关诈骗迹象在 Agent 执行最终动作之前即可被观察到，从而实现可控、可重复的评估。通过对由六个前沿 LLM 驱动的 Web Agent 的广泛研究，我们发现各模型的基线受骗率在 11% 到 35% 之间。Agent 相比提供凭据或钱包信息的请求，更容易直接执行付款操作。对 Agent 轨迹的深入分析显示，某些 Agent 虽然察觉到可疑情况却仍然继续执行，有时甚至将用户指令视为接受网站附加条款的授权。ScamWorld 为系统性评估和压力测试 Web Agent 应对真实网络诈骗的能力提供了可复用的测试平台。
translation.brief: 针对诈骗网站短生命周期导致 Web Agent 抗诈骗能力难以系统评估的问题，构建了可复现真实诈骗机制的交互式测试环境 ScamWorld。

papers.title: Best-of-Many-Worlds MMS Allocation for Chores with Sublinear Disposals
papers.abstract: We study randomized allocations (lotteries) of indivisible chores under additive costs and introduce the notion of MMS1, which requires each agent's bundle to satisfy the maximin share (MMS) bound after the removal of at most one chore. Our main result establishes that every instance admits an ex-ante proportional lottery in whose support every allocation is MMS1 and all but $o(n)$ agents satisfy MMS. Consequently, every realized allocation can be made MMS by disposing of at most $o(n)$ chores. The proposed framework further achieves ex-ante proportionality alongside ex-post $4/3$-MMS, $o(n)$-AMMS, or $1$-out-of-$d$ MMS for $d=(1-o(1))n$. These guarantees substantially improve upon state-of-the-art bounds for MMS allocation for chores with disposal or subsidy, best-of-both-worlds fairness, approximate AMMS, and ordinal MMS approximations.

translation.title: 具有次线性处置的杂务分配的 Best-of-Many-Worlds MMS
translation.abstract: 我们研究加性成本下不可分割杂务的随机分配（彩票机制），并引入 MMS1 的概念，即要求每个 agent 的物品束在移除至多一件杂务后满足最大最小份额（MMS）界。我们的主要结果表明，每个实例都存在一个事前比例的彩票，其支撑集中的每个分配都是 MMS1 的，且除 $o(n)$ 个 agent 外所有 agent 均满足 MMS。因此，每个实际实现的分配都可以通过处置至多 $o(n)$ 件杂务而达到 MMS。所提出的框架还进一步实现了事前比例性与事后 $4/3$-MMS、$o(n)$-AMMS 或 $d=(1-o(1))n$ 的 1-out-of-$d$ MMS 的结合。这些保证大幅改进了带处置或补贴的杂务 MMS 分配、best-of-both-worlds 公平性、近似 AMMS 以及序数 MMS 近似方面的最新界限。
translation.brief: 针对不可分割杂务的公平分配问题，提出 MMS1 概念并构造事前比例的随机分配机制，使事后分配仅需处置次线性数量杂务即可满足 MMS。

papers.title: Modelling lock-in of AI adoption through skill erosion
papers.abstract: Generative AI can improve immediate performance but may erode the human skills required for future work. We study a model in which individuals tend to imitate successful peers, while their independent skills grow with practice and erode with reliance on AI. Because each agent's skill reflects their history, non-users and AI users develop different skill distributions, which we derive exactly. Skill erosion can produce bistability and hysteresis between a low-adoption, high-skill state and a high-adoption, low-skill state. When agents rarely change behaviour at random, the two transitions are asymmetric. A single AI user spreads through a population of experts only if AI-assisted work earns more than expert work, whatever the timescale of skill adaptation. A single non-user, by contrast, can lead an AI-dependent population back to independent work only if they regain enough skill before returning to AI, which becomes easier the more persistent behaviours are. As AI improves, adoption can jump abruptly, and a sufficiently long increase in its benefit, such as a period of low prices, can leave a population relying on AI after the benefit has returned to its initial value. Skill erosion thus creates a history-dependent switching cost that can make widespread AI adoption difficult to reverse.

translation.title: 通过技能侵蚀建模 AI 采用的锁定效应
translation.abstract: 生成式 AI 可以提升即时表现，但可能侵蚀未来工作所需的人类技能。我们研究了一个模型，其中个体倾向于模仿成功的同伴，而其独立技能随练习增长、随对 AI 的依赖而侵蚀。由于每个 agent 的技能反映其历史，非用户和 AI 用户会形成不同的技能分布，我们对其进行了精确推导。技能侵蚀可以在低采用、高技能状态与高采用、低技能状态之间产生双稳态和滞后效应。当 agent 很少随机改变行为时，两个转变是不对称的。只有当 AI 辅助工作的收益高于专家工作时，单个 AI 用户才能在专家群体中扩散，且与技能适应的时间尺度无关。相比之下，单个非用户只有在重新使用 AI 之前恢复足够技能的情况下，才能带领依赖 AI 的群体回归独立工作，且行为越持久这越容易实现。随着 AI 的改进，采用率可能突然跃升，而足够长的收益提升期（例如一段低价期）可能在收益回到初始值后仍使群体依赖 AI。因此，技能侵蚀造成了一种依赖历史的转换成本，使广泛的 AI 采用难以逆转。
translation.brief: 针对 AI 采用可能难以逆转的问题，建立个体技能随练习增长、随依赖 AI 而侵蚀的模仿传播模型，揭示技能侵蚀导致的滞后与锁定效应。

papers.title: VisSearch-Bench: Evaluating Long Horizon Visual Search in Multimodal Agents
papers.abstract: Multimodal agents use web and image tools to answer questions beyond their internal knowledge. Some search tasks use images mainly to identify an initial entity, then rely on text retrieval. These tasks offer limited insight into how agents connect information across images, objects, and search steps. We therefore focus on visual context management. This involves organizing and using visual information and linking it to other findings during search. Visually intensive tasks require agents to combine object appearance, local details, or spatial relations with external information. We introduce VisSearch-Bench, with 204 human-written tasks across 7 main domains and 25 subdomains. It covers Set-wise Visual Search, Sequential Visual Search, Hybrid Wide-Deep Search, Competitive Visual Disambiguation, and Visual-Structure-Guided Search. Each task provides a reference answer, traceable evidence, and scoring rules. Accuracy measures complete task success, while Process Score measures the correctness and completeness of individual results and subquestion answers. Across 16 multimodal models, the best system fully solves only 26.47% of tasks, even with search tools. These results highlight the challenge of linking visual evidence with search results to produce complete answers.

translation.title: VisSearch-Bench：评估多模态 Agent 的长程视觉搜索能力
translation.abstract: 多模态 Agent 使用网页和图像工具来回答超出其内部知识的问题。某些搜索任务中，图像主要用于识别初始实体，之后依赖文本检索。这类任务对 Agent 如何跨图像、对象和搜索步骤关联信息的揭示有限。因此我们聚焦于视觉上下文管理，即在搜索过程中组织和使用视觉信息，并将其与其他发现相关联。视觉密集型任务要求 Agent 将对象外观、局部细节或空间关系与外部信息相结合。我们提出 VisSearch-Bench，包含 204 个人工编写的任务，覆盖 7 个主领域和 25 个子领域，涵盖集合式视觉搜索、序列式视觉搜索、混合广深搜索、竞争性视觉消歧和视觉结构引导搜索。每个任务提供参考答案、可追溯证据和评分规则。准确率衡量任务的完整成功，而过程分数（Process Score）衡量单个结果和子问题答案的正确性与完整性。在 16 个多模态模型中，即使配备搜索工具，最佳系统也仅完全解决 26.47% 的任务。这些结果凸显了将视觉证据与搜索结果关联以产生完整答案的挑战。
translation.brief: 针对多模态 Agent 跨图像关联与视觉上下文管理能力缺乏评估的问题，构建了包含 204 个人工任务、覆盖多种视觉搜索范式的基准 VisSearch-Bench。

papers.title: Behind Video Generation: Observations and Insights on Multimodal Understanding from Kling
papers.abstract: Video generation has progressed from isolated clips to coherent short-form audiovisual sequences, and the bottleneck is shifting from rendering to semantic control. This report summarizes the observations and insights on multimodal understanding gained from successive generations of Kling. We argue that generation quality is the projection of multimodal understanding through the entire data--conditioning--alignment--evaluation chain, and we examine this chain module by module. Kling-MLLM, a shared multimodal foundation model that unifies image, video, audio, synchronized audio--video, and interleaved inputs, is specialized for each downstream module. Because a DiT is trained on far fewer training samples than a language model, we treat captioning as a semantic contract that maximizes description density, and extend it to reference-grounded captioning that makes reference bindings explicit. Prompt enhancement translates user intent into this caption distribution: basic PE is derived from captions of compelling videos and refined with text-level and generator-in-the-loop reinforcement learning, while agentic PE refines the story and retrieves compelling examples. We show that a reliable text encoder comes from perceptual training rather than from stronger language ability, and that candidates can be screened from text alone before end-to-end training. Reward modeling pairs a general reward model for explainable, localized critiques with a decision reward model for fast multidimensional scoring, treating perceptual bandwidth as a first-class design parameter. Finally, we review task-specific automatic evaluation, focusing on protocols that expose scoring shortcuts and help trace failures to their upstream source. We hope these lessons offer practical guidance for building the understanding stack behind controllable video generation.

translation.title: 视频生成背后：来自 Kling 的多模态理解观察与洞见
translation.abstract: 视频生成已从孤立片段发展到连贯的短音视频序列，瓶颈正从渲染转向语义控制。本报告总结了从 Kling 历代模型中获得的多模态理解方面的观察与洞见。我们认为生成质量是多模态理解经由数据—条件化—对齐—评估整条链路的投影，并逐模块考察这条链路。Kling-MLLM 是一个统一图像、视频、音频、音画同步及交错输入的共享多模态基础模型，并为每个下游模块进行专门化。由于 DiT 的训练样本远少于语言模型，我们将字幕生成视为最大化描述密度的语义契约，并将其扩展为使参考绑定显式化的基于参考的字幕生成。提示增强将用户意图翻译为该字幕分布：基础 PE 源自优质视频的字幕，并通过文本级和生成器在环的强化学习进行优化，而 agentic PE 则细化故事并检索优质示例。我们表明，可靠的文本编码器来自感知训练而非更强的语言能力，且候选方案可在端到端训练之前仅凭文本进行筛选。奖励建模将用于可解释、局部化批评的通用奖励模型与用于快速多维打分的决策奖励模型相结合，将感知带宽作为一等设计参数。最后，我们回顾了任务特定的自动评估，重点关注能暴露评分捷径并帮助将失败追溯到上游来源的协议。希望这些经验能为构建可控视频生成背后的理解技术栈提供实用指导。
translation.brief: 总结 Kling 视频生成系统在数据、条件化、对齐与评估全链路上的多模态理解实践经验，以解决生成中的语义控制瓶颈。

papers.title: The Complexity of Continuous Contract Design over Polymatroids
papers.abstract: We study optimal contracts when an agent allocates continuous effort subject to polymatroid capacity constraints. Effort produces a linear expected reward and incurs a cost. With binary outcomes and limited liability, the principal chooses a single reward share. For linear costs, an optimal contract can be computed in polynomial time. For quadratic costs, the agent has a unique best response computable by polynomially many submodular minimizations, yet optimizing the principal's share is NP-hard even for explicitly represented cut-based rank functions. With $n$ activities, the best-response path can have $2^{n-O(\log n)}$ breakpoints even when each reward coefficient and each rank value is an integer representable in $O(n\log n)$ bits. The construction also answers a question of Allman, Lo, and McCormick on polynomial bit length for source-sink monotone two-parameter minimum cuts. Despite this complexity, an optimal contract for quadratic costs always exists with a share of at most $1/2$. Consequently, $O(1/\varepsilon)$ best-response computations suffice for a $(1-\varepsilon)$-approximation. For rational quadratic costs on explicitly described rational polytopes containing zero, this gives a fully polynomial-time approximation scheme. More generally, a share of at most $1/p$ suffices for continuous convex costs homogeneous of degree $p>1$, on any compact convex action set containing zero. For general convex costs with an exact value and bounded-subgradient oracle, we obtain an oracle approximation scheme using approximate best responses and a supplied lower bound on positive welfare.

translation.title: 多面体拟阵上连续契约设计的复杂性
translation.abstract: 我们研究代理在多面体拟阵容量约束下分配连续努力时的最优契约问题。努力产生线性期望收益并产生成本。在二元结果和有限责任下，委托人选择单一收益份额。对于线性成本，最优契约可以在多项式时间内计算。对于二次成本，代理具有唯一的最优响应，可通过多项式次次模最小化计算，然而即使对于显式表示的基于割的秩函数，优化委托人的份额也是NP难的。当有 $n$ 个活动时，即使每个收益系数和每个秩值都是可用 $O(n\log n)$ 比特表示的整数，最优响应路径也可能有 $2^{n-O(\log n)}$ 个断点。该构造还回答了 Allman、Lo 和 McCormick 关于源汇单调双参数最小割的多项式比特长度的问题。尽管存在这种复杂性，二次成本下的最优契约总是存在，且份额至多为 $1/2$。因此，$O(1/\varepsilon)$ 次最优响应计算足以获得 $(1-\varepsilon)$ 近似。对于包含零点的显式描述的有理多胞体上的有理二次成本，这给出了全多项式时间近似方案。更一般地，对于任何包含零点的紧致凸动作集上 $p>1$ 次齐次的连续凸成本，至多 $1/p$ 的份额即可。对于具有精确值和有界次梯度预言机的一般凸成本，我们利用近似最优响应和给定的正福利下界得到了一个预言机近似方案。
translation.brief: 研究多面体拟阵约束下连续努力的最优契约设计，刻画了线性成本可多项式求解、二次成本份额优化为NP难的复杂性，并给出基于份额上界的近似方案。

papers.title: Local Visibility Roadmaps in Continous Multi-agent Path Finding
papers.abstract: We address the problem of smooth continuous multi-agent path finding (SC-MAPF), where agents move in a continuous environment along smooth curves in continuous time. The paths for individual agents are searched in local visibility roadmaps that consider obstacles and other agents. A new algorithm is proposed in this work, which combines the previous algorithm CE-CBS for high-level search with any-angle path finding for local single-agent planning, where agents are to avoid obstacles, both static and other agents. The new algorithm is tested and compared to CE-CBS, the algorithm building individual paths using RRT$^*$, and SMT-CCBS algorithm, an algorithm for MAPF$_R$. Experimental results show various advantages of the new algorithm over CE-CBS and SMT-CCBS in comparable settings.

translation.title: 连续多智能体路径规划中的局部可视性路图
translation.abstract: 我们研究平滑连续多智能体路径规划（SC-MAPF）问题，其中智能体在连续环境中沿连续时间内的平滑曲线移动。各智能体的路径在考虑障碍物和其他智能体的局部可视性路图中搜索。本文提出了一种新算法，该算法将先前用于高层搜索的算法 CE-CBS 与用于局部单智能体规划的任意角度路径规划相结合，其中智能体需避开静态障碍物和其他智能体。新算法与 CE-CBS、使用 RRT$^*$ 构建个体路径的算法以及面向 MAPF$_R$ 的 SMT-CCBS 算法进行了测试和比较。实验结果表明，在可比设置下，新算法相比 CE-CBS 和 SMT-CCBS 具有多种优势。
translation.brief: 针对平滑连续多智能体路径规划，提出将CE-CBS高层搜索与任意角度局部路径规划结合于局部可视性路图的新算法。

papers.title: PATTS: Parallel-Aware Test-Time Scaling for Thought-Image Generation in Multimodal Discrete Diffusion LLMs
papers.abstract: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves generative models by allocating additional inference-time computation to sampling, search, and verification. Existing image generation approaches, however, typically rank completed images or image-centric intermediate states. We study TTS for parallel multimodal discrete diffusion language models, in which reasoning tokens and image tokens are decoded jointly within a single generation trajectory. We first diagnose a limitation of conventional final-image selection: on GenEval, a CLIP-style image-prompt score is weakly aligned with within-prompt compositional correctness, leaving substantial headroom between verifier selection and oracle selection. We then propose PATTS, a novel parallel-aware TTS framework that searches over intermediate thought-image states using cross-modal verifier signals. PATTS uses a state-dependent reliability weight, derived from model-internal trajectory diagnostics, to modulate the influence of external semantic verification during generation. In the fixed N=32 evaluation on MMaDA-Parallel, the PATTS reaches a GenEval score of 0.844, compared with 0.628 without TTS, 0.787 for Best-of-N, and 0.810 for FKD. These results show that reliability-aware trajectory verification can improve test-time selection for parallel thought-image co-generation under the evaluated search budget. Our code release is at this https URL

translation.title: PATTS：面向多模态离散扩散大语言模型思维-图像生成的并行感知测试时扩展
translation.abstract: 测试时扩展（TTS）通过在推理时为采样、搜索和验证分配额外计算来改进生成模型。然而，现有的图像生成方法通常对已完成的图像或以图像为中心的中间状态进行排序。我们研究并行多模态离散扩散语言模型的 TTS，其中推理 token 和图像 token 在单一生成轨迹中联合解码。我们首先诊断了传统最终图像选择的局限：在 GenEval 上，CLIP 风格的图像-提示词分数与提示词内组合正确性仅有弱对齐，使得验证器选择与预言机选择之间存在较大提升空间。然后我们提出 PATTS，一种新颖的并行感知 TTS 框架，利用跨模态验证器信号在中间思维-图像状态上进行搜索。PATTS 使用从模型内部轨迹诊断中导出的状态相关可靠性权重，在生成过程中调节外部语义验证的影响。在 MMaDA-Parallel 上的固定 N=32 评估中，PATTS 达到 0.844 的 GenEval 分数，而无 TTS 为 0.628，Best-of-N 为 0.787，FKD 为 0.810。这些结果表明，可靠性感知的轨迹验证可以在评估的搜索预算下改进并行思维-图像协同生成的测试时选择。我们的代码发布于该 https URL。
translation.brief: 针对并行多模态离散扩散LLM的思维-图像联合生成，提出利用跨模态验证器信号和可靠性权重在中间状态上搜索的测试时扩展框架PATTS。

papers.title: Artifact-to-Capability: Diagnosing Breaks in Capability Formation of Self-Evolving Agents in a Controlled Environment
papers.abstract: Self-evolving agents write interaction experience into artifacts and reuse them in later tasks. Most work supports such methods with three proxy signals: artifacts accumulate, behavior changes once they are loaded, and metrics rise. We call this signal-based evaluation. What these signals are meant to indicate, however, has not been defined. To fill this gap, we define capability formation from artifacts as five sequentially dependent properties, two of which form a checkpoint for capability formation, and introduce three-scale diagnosis, which judges these properties at the state, game, and lineage levels. In freestyle Gomoku, Reflexion, Voyager, and DGM evolve with the same base model and all show the three signals, yet each exhibits a distinct capability-formation break. Reflexion shows a legalization gain: its pass rate rises only because more of its moves are legal. Voyager shows a compositional override: components that are sound on their own combine to miss all 20 available one-move wins. DGM shows loss-only drift: after passing the checkpoint, later versions only lose passing states. These counterexamples show that signal-based evaluation cannot determine whether a capability has formed.

translation.title: 从产物到能力：在受控环境中诊断自进化智能体能力形成的中断
translation.abstract: 自进化智能体将交互经验写入产物并在后续任务中复用。大多数工作用三个代理信号来支持此类方法：产物不断累积、加载产物后行为发生变化、指标上升。我们称之为基于信号的评估。然而，这些信号旨在表明什么尚未被定义。为填补这一空白，我们将从产物形成能力定义为五个顺序依赖的属性，其中两个构成能力形成的检查点，并引入三尺度诊断，在状态、博弈和谱系层面判断这些属性。在自由五子棋中，Reflexion、Voyager 和 DGM 使用相同的基础模型进化，均表现出这三个信号，但各自呈现出不同的能力形成中断。Reflexion 表现为合法化增益：其通过率上升仅仅因为更多走法是合法的。Voyager 表现为组合覆盖失效：各自健全的组件组合起来却错过了全部 20 个可用的一步获胜。DGM 表现为仅损失漂移：通过检查点后，后续版本只会丢失已通过的状态。这些反例表明，基于信号的评估无法判断能力是否已经形成。
translation.brief: 针对自进化智能体产物评估缺乏能力定义的问题，提出能力形成的五属性定义与三尺度诊断方法，并揭示基于信号的评估无法判断能力是否真正形成。

papers.title: Safeguarding Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Connected and Automated Vehicles with Recursively Feasible Control Barrier Functions
papers.abstract: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) shows promise in coordinating connected and automated vehicles but offers no safety guarantee. Although Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) can add this guarantee, their optimization problem can become infeasible in practice due to control bounds. Moreover, they often overapproximate vehicle and road geometry, which makes them conservative. This paper proposes the Backup-Horizon CBF (BH-CBF), which evaluates safety along a horizon until all vehicles stop. BH-CBF is recursively feasible under control bounds, and it considers the exact vehicle and road geometry. Based on BH-CBF, we derive a fully decentralized safety filter that only needs a single broadcast of vehicle states and routes per step and stays real-time in dense traffic. We use BH-CBF to safeguard a MARL policy over its life cycle: as a reward during pre-training, as a run-time filter at deployment, and as a filter in the training loop that keeps fine-tuning on unseen maps collision-free. In simulations on real-world maps of a roundabout and an intersection, BH-CBF avoids all collisions of unsafe MARL policies and keeps its safety guarantee at every step. Existing filters either collide, lose the guarantee, or fall back to full braking far more often. In recorded roundabout traffic with 1264 human-driven vehicles over 115 km, our safeguarded policies shorten the median travel time by 14% compared with the human drivers, without any collision.

translation.title: 基于递归可行控制障碍函数的网联自动驾驶车辆多智能体强化学习安全保障
translation.abstract: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）在协调网联自动驾驶车辆方面展现出前景，但不提供安全保证。尽管控制障碍函数（CBF）可以增加这一保证，但其优化问题在实践中可能因控制边界而变得不可行。此外，它们通常对车辆和道路几何进行过近似，使其过于保守。本文提出 Backup-Horizon CBF（BH-CBF），它沿一个时间范围评估安全性，直到所有车辆停止。BH-CBF 在控制边界下是递归可行的，并且考虑了精确的车辆和道路几何。基于 BH-CBF，我们推导出一个完全去中心化的安全滤波器，每步只需广播一次车辆状态和路线，并在密集交通中保持实时性。我们使用 BH-CBF 在 MARL 策略的整个生命周期中对其进行保障：作为预训练期间的奖励、部署时的运行时滤波器，以及训练循环中保持对未见地图微调无碰撞的滤波器。在环岛和交叉路口真实地图的仿真中，BH-CBF 避免了不安全 MARL 策略的所有碰撞，并在每一步都保持其安全保证。现有滤波器要么发生碰撞，要么失去保证，要么更频繁地退回到完全制动。在包含 1264 辆人类驾驶车辆、行驶 115 公里的环岛交通记录中，我们保障的策略相比人类驾驶员将中位行驶时间缩短了 14%，且无任何碰撞。
translation.brief: 针对MARL协调网联自动驾驶车辆缺乏安全保证的问题，提出考虑精确几何且在控制边界下递归可行的Backup-Horizon CBF安全滤波器，并贯穿策略训练与部署全生命周期。

papers.title: An Agentic Framework for Quality-Aware and Scenario-Adaptive Image Compression
papers.abstract: Despite decades of progress, image codecs remain difficult to adapt to diverse real-world compression scenarios for two main reasons. First, most image codecs are optimized for a specific objective and require substantial redevelopment when the compression goal changes. Second, they typically assume clean inputs, whereas sensor-captured images often contain degradations that alter rate-quality behavior. To address these challenges, we propose Practical Image Coding Agents (PICA), a multi-agent framework that adapts existing codecs to diverse user requirements and potentially degraded inputs. PICA consists of four collaborative agents: a Perception agent that interprets user intent and analyzes image content, an Improvement agent that jointly considers bitrate and reconstruction quality to guide pre-coding restoration, a Coding agent that refines quality-control settings from global to regional levels, and an After-coding improvement agent that addresses residual degradations and compression-induced artifacts through restoration guided solely by image quality. To enable codec-agnostic regional adaptation, we introduce Agentic ROI Coding (AROIC), which treats the codec as a black box and allows the agent to automatically schedule, execute, evaluate, and reflect ROI coding plans without architectural modifications or codec-specific retraining. We integrate these four agents with a Scenario-Guided Quality-Rate (SGQR) evaluation strategy to enable more effective scenario-adaptive compression across heterogeneous codecs. Comprehensive experiments on clean, noisy, and blurred images across standard, perceptual, and machine-vision compression scenarios demonstrate that PICA consistently enhances the compression performance of both the conventional H.266/VVC codec and the neural Cheng2020 codec, outperforming competing compression methods on the Kodak, CLIC2020, and HEVC datasets.

translation.title: 一个面向质量感知与场景自适应图像压缩的智能体框架
translation.abstract: 尽管经过数十年的发展，图像编解码器仍难以适应多样的真实世界压缩场景，主要有两个原因。首先，大多数图像编解码器针对特定目标进行优化，当压缩目标改变时需要大量重新开发。其次，它们通常假设输入是干净的，而传感器采集的图像往往包含会改变率-质量行为的退化。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了实用图像编码智能体（PICA），这是一个多智能体框架，可将现有编解码器适配到多样的用户需求和可能退化的输入。PICA 由四个协作智能体组成：感知（Perception）智能体解释用户意图并分析图像内容；改进（Improvement）智能体联合考虑码率与重建质量以指导编码前修复；编码（Coding）智能体从全局到区域层面细化质量控制设置；编码后改进（After-coding improvement）智能体仅以图像质量为引导，通过修复处理残余退化和压缩伪影。为实现与编解码器无关的区域自适应，我们引入了智能体 ROI 编码（AROIC），它将编解码器视为黑盒，使智能体能够在无需架构修改或编解码器特定重训练的情况下自动调度、执行、评估和反思 ROI 编码方案。我们将这四个智能体与场景引导质量-率（SGQR）评估策略相结合，以在异构编解码器上实现更有效的场景自适应压缩。在干净、噪声和模糊图像上，针对标准、感知和机器视觉压缩场景的全面实验表明，PICA 持续提升了传统 H.266/VVC 编解码器和神经 Cheng2020 编解码器的压缩性能，在 Kodak、CLIC2020 和 HEVC 数据集上优于竞争压缩方法。
translation.brief: 针对图像编解码器难以适应多样压缩目标和退化输入的问题，提出由四个协作智能体组成的多智能体框架 PICA，结合黑盒式 AROIC 区域编码与 SGQR 评估策略实现场景自适应压缩。

papers.title: Who is the Pronoun Pro? Comparing LLMs and Humans at Number-Disambiguation of 'they'
papers.abstract: This study evaluates whether large language models (LLMs) can reliably replace or complement human research assistants in linguistically complex annotation. In a controlled annotation task, 73 human annotators (local students and crowdworkers with and without a background in linguistics) and more than 40 LLM configurations number-disambiguated 174 authentic uses of 'they' from Reddit, including innovative and context-sensitive cases. The best LLM, Kimi K3, reached 94.5% accuracy, above the human majority vote (86.2%) and the mean of the top half of human annotators (78.5%); only the single best human annotator scored higher (95.7%). LLMs also offer substantial practical advantages in cost and speed. However, qualitative error analysis reveals a crucial complementarity: human reasoning in low-agreement cases exposes inconsistencies in the annotation typology and thereby improves the methodological framework itself. The study contributes (i) a benchmark-style human-LLM comparison for a semantically demanding task, (ii) transparent cost and time evidence, and (iii) a methodological argument against a purely replacement-oriented view of automation. LLMs are viable for large-scale annotation support in linguistics, but their responsible use requires human critical oversight. The dataset with its gold-standard labels, all human and LLM annotations, and the fully reproducible code are openly available as a Quarto-based, public repository.

translation.title: 谁是代词专家？比较 LLM 与人类在 'they' 单复数消歧上的表现
translation.abstract: 本研究评估大型语言模型（LLM）能否可靠地替代或补充人类研究助理完成语言学上复杂的标注任务。在一项受控标注任务中，73 名人类标注者（包括有或无语言学背景的本地学生和众包工作者）与 40 多种 LLM 配置对来自 Reddit 的 174 个 'they' 的真实用例进行单复数消歧，其中包括创新性和语境敏感的用例。表现最好的 LLM Kimi K3 达到 94.5% 的准确率，高于人类多数投票（86.2%）和人类标注者前半部分的平均值（78.5%）；只有单个人类最佳标注者得分更高（95.7%）。LLM 在成本和速度方面也具有显著的实用优势。然而，定性错误分析揭示了一种关键的互补性：人类在低一致性案例中的推理暴露了标注类型学中的不一致性，从而改进了方法论框架本身。本研究的贡献包括：(i) 针对语义要求高的任务提供了基准式的人机对比，(ii) 透明的成本与时间证据，(iii) 反对纯替代式自动化观点的方法论论证。LLM 可用于语言学大规模标注支持，但其负责任的使用需要人类批判性监督。包含金标准标签的数据集、所有人类与 LLM 标注以及完全可复现的代码均以基于 Quarto 的公开仓库形式开放提供。
translation.brief: 通过让 73 名人类标注者与 40 多种 LLM 配置对 Reddit 上 174 个 'they' 用例进行单复数消歧，评估 LLM 能否替代或补充人类完成复杂语言学标注任务。

papers.title: Software Design Patterns for Latency Measurements with eBPF in SDN Environments
papers.abstract: This work proposes, implements, and evaluates a modular architecture based on software design patterns applied to latency measurement in Software-Defined Networks (SDN) using the Extended Berkeley Packet Filter (eBPF) and the Express Data Path (XDP). Unlike approaches that focus solely on measurement precision, this study examines how design patterns can structure observability systems in an extensible and maintainable way while preserving data-plane efficiency. The proposed architecture applies the Observer, Strategy, and Factory Method patterns to modularize the metric collection and analysis pipeline, allowing dynamic integration of policies and data sinks. The experimental environment was implemented with Mininet, Python agents, and eBPF/XDP programs, and was evaluated in terms of processing time, overhead, and evolution effort. The results show that the introduction of design patterns shows no clear evidence of measurable performance degradation, maintaining continuous measurements with a minimum of 5% overhead. The findings suggest that software engineering practices may be applied to the construction of eBPF-based monitoring and observability systems.

translation.title: SDN 环境中基于 eBPF 的时延测量软件设计模式
translation.abstract: 本工作提出、实现并评估了一种基于软件设计模式的模块化架构，应用于使用扩展伯克利数据包过滤器（eBPF）和快速数据路径（XDP）在软件定义网络（SDN）中进行时延测量。与仅关注测量精度的方法不同，本研究探讨设计模式如何以可扩展、可维护的方式构建可观测性系统，同时保持数据平面效率。所提出的架构应用观察者（Observer）、策略（Strategy）和工厂方法（Factory Method）模式来模块化指标采集与分析流水线，允许动态集成策略和数据汇。实验环境使用 Mininet、Python 代理和 eBPF/XDP 程序实现，并从处理时间、开销和演进成本方面进行评估。结果表明，引入设计模式没有明显可测的性能退化证据，能以最低 5% 的开销维持连续测量。研究结果表明，软件工程实践可应用于构建基于 eBPF 的监控与可观测性系统。
translation.brief: 针对 SDN 中 eBPF 时延测量系统难以扩展维护的问题，提出应用 Observer、Strategy 和 Factory Method 设计模式的模块化架构来构建可观测性系统。

papers.title: GeoFaham: Domain-Specialized Multi-Agent Geospatial Analytics for Disaster Response
papers.abstract: Real-world geospatial decision support requires more than single-step retrieval or code generation. Disaster-response questions often involve multi-source workflows that combine spatial databases, map-derived features, satellite imagery, raster products, and reusable geospatial artifacts, where correctness depends on preserving spatial scope, temporal context, and intermediate execution state. While large language models and coding agents offer a promising interface for such workflows, they struggle with geospatial-specific failure modes, including handling large artifacts, selecting the wrong evidence source, losing spatial or temporal metadata, and applying invalid geometric operations. We introduce GeoFaham, a domain-specialized multi-agent system for geospatial disaster analytics. GeoFaham decomposes workflows into specialist agents for vector operations, map feature retrieval, imagery discovery, and raster analysis, coordinated by an Orchestrator with a dual-ledger control loop for dependency-aware planning, progress tracking, validation, and replanning. To support artifact-centric collaboration, GeoFaham uses a Response Store that persists full geospatial outputs and typed metadata outside the LLM context window while agents exchange compact identifiers and summaries. We also introduce GeoFaham-Bench, a 40-task benchmark grounded in 17 real-world disaster records, designed to evaluate multi-step geospatial reasoning, cross-source integration, raster-vector computation, artifact generation, and recovery under non-rigid ground truth. We evaluate GeoFaham on GeoFaham-Bench against strong general-purpose coding-agent baselines, including Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode. GeoFaham achieves the best overall performance, scoring 0.940 versus the next-best 0.879, while using 7.5 times fewer tokens. Our code and benchmark are publicly available at this https URL.

translation.title: GeoFaham：面向灾害响应的领域专用多智能体地理空间分析
translation.abstract: 真实世界的地理空间决策支持远不止单步检索或代码生成。灾害响应问题往往涉及多源工作流，结合空间数据库、地图衍生特征、卫星影像、栅格产品和可复用的地理空间工件，其正确性取决于保留空间范围、时间上下文和中间执行状态。虽然大型语言模型和编码智能体为此类工作流提供了有前景的接口，但它们难以应对地理空间特有的失败模式，包括处理大型工件、选择错误的证据来源、丢失空间或时间元数据以及执行无效的几何操作。我们提出 GeoFaham，一个面向地理空间灾害分析的领域专用多智能体系统。GeoFaham 将工作流分解为矢量操作、地图特征检索、影像发现和栅格分析等专家智能体，由一个带有双账本控制回路的编排器（Orchestrator）协调，实现依赖感知的规划、进度跟踪、验证和重规划。为支持以工件为中心的协作，GeoFaham 使用响应存储（Response Store），将完整的地理空间输出和类型化元数据持久化在 LLM 上下文窗口之外，而智能体之间交换紧凑的标识符和摘要。我们还提出 GeoFaham-Bench，一个基于 17 条真实灾害记录的 40 任务基准，旨在评估多步地理空间推理、跨源集成、栅格-矢量计算、工件生成以及在非刚性真值下的恢复能力。我们在 GeoFaham-Bench 上将 GeoFaham 与强大的通用编码智能体基线（包括 Codex、Claude Code 和 OpenCode）进行对比评估。GeoFaham 取得最佳整体性能，得分 0.940，次优为 0.879，同时使用的 token 少 7.5 倍。我们的代码和基准已在 https URL 公开。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 编码智能体在地理空间灾害分析中的特有失败模式，提出由专家智能体与双账本编排器组成、配合 Response Store 工件管理的多智能体系统 GeoFaham，并发布 40 任务基准 GeoFaham-Bench。

papers.title: Auditing Multi-Proxy Explanations of Web User Preferences: Identification Boundaries and Abstention
papers.abstract: Web systems infer user preferences from behavior, ratings, text, and LLM-generated profiles, yet explaining a proxy may reveal its measurement process rather than the preference of interest. We develop an audit framework distinguishing point identification, partial identification, and abstention relative to an explicit reference distribution. Under feature-dependent, arbitrarily signed proxy bias, a strict majority of uncontaminated proxy attributions lets the coordinatewise median recover latent-attribution support and direction and, with externally justified positive scales, magnitude. We prove this threshold sharp using response-valid indistinguishable worlds, characterize sharp minimax error and exact compatible-target sets under approximate cleanliness and scale uncertainty, and propagate clean-proxy attribution error. A frozen known-truth benchmark spans two response families, four proxy counts, all contamination counts, three bias strengths, and eleven methods, with a focal comparison confirmed on twenty unseen seeds. Under correct budgets, a direct attribution-tensor audit achieved 100% coverage, 95.40%-97.05% active-driver sign decisions, and no false signs. In a temporally separated Amazon study, median aggregation reduced comparator-relative conditional sign error for all four targets; six of eight prespecified target-metric contrasts had Bonferroni intervals excluding zero. A controlled real-covariate perturbation favored the median on the prespecified focal metric for all four targets. Compatible sets showed that the current proxy configuration rarely licensed strict-sign conclusions. Weak comparator calibration limits the Amazon evidence to fitted-surface alignment rather than latent-preference recovery.

translation.title: 审计网络用户偏好的多代理解释：可识别性边界与弃权
translation.abstract: 网络系统从行为、评分、文本和 LLM 生成的画像中推断用户偏好，然而解释一个代理（proxy）可能揭示的是其测量过程而非所关注的偏好。我们开发了一个审计框架，相对于显式参考分布区分点识别、部分识别和弃权。在特征相关、符号任意的代理偏差下，只要未受污染的代理归因占严格多数，逐坐标中位数即可恢复潜在归因的支持集和方向，并在有外部论证的正尺度下恢复幅值。我们利用响应有效但不可区分的世界证明了该阈值的尖锐性，刻画了在近似干净和尺度不确定下的尖锐极小极大误差与精确相容目标集，并传播干净代理的归因误差。一个冻结的已知真值基准涵盖两个响应族、四种代理数量、所有污染数量、三种偏差强度和十一种方法，焦点比较在二十个未见种子上得到确认。在正确预算下，直接的归因张量审计实现了 100% 覆盖率、95.40%-97.05% 的活跃驱动因素符号判定，且无错误符号。在一项时间上分离的 Amazon 研究中，中位数聚合降低了所有四个目标相对于比较器的条件符号错误；八个预设的目标-指标对比中有六个的 Bonferroni 区间不包含零。受控的真实协变量扰动在预设焦点指标上对四个目标均有利于中位数。相容集表明当前的代理配置很少允许严格的符号结论。较弱的比较器校准将 Amazon 证据限制在拟合表面对齐而非潜在偏好恢复。
translation.brief: 针对网络用户偏好代理解释可能反映测量过程而非真实偏好的问题，提出区分点识别、部分识别与弃权的审计框架，利用未污染代理归因的严格多数和逐坐标中位数恢复潜在归因。

papers.title: ForgeKernel: Self-Evolving Kernels Catching and Surpassing Experts and Agents
papers.abstract: Purpose-built kernel agents can write high-performance GPU kernels, but existing systems generally lack cross-run knowledge accumulation and architectural evolution. Each run starts from the same initial knowledge, and later iterations largely optimize within an architecture fixed early in the search. We present ForgeKernel, a kernel-generation system that accumulates and reuses knowledge across runs while enabling continued evolution of kernel architectures. It analyzes the hardware behavior of a high-performance reference and distills validated architectural decisions into reusable knowledge of hardware mechanisms rather than imitating source code. It then seals a kernel that passes correctness and performance validation and uses it as the reference for the next optimization run, enabling architectural decisions to be revisited. Across 27 operators and 29 input configurations on NVIDIA Hopper and Blackwell GPUs, ForgeKernel matches or beats its expert reference on 25 configurations, with a geometric-mean performance gain of 10%. On Ascend 910C, it outperforms the per-operator public best on the public case set of all 8 level-4 operators in the CANN-Bench Season 1 final leaderboard, with a geometric-mean gain of 25.1%, while its full-suite submission ranks first on the A3 leaderboard. As of 2026-10-30, public submissions generated by ForgeKernel rank first on all three CANN-Bench 2.0 solution leaderboards (Ascend 910C, 950DT, and 950PR) and on the SOL-ExecBench FlashInfer-Bench track.

papers.title: Unifying and Beyond the Theory of Pervasive Capability Degradation in LLM Post-training SFT from Feature Interference
papers.abstract: Pervasive Capability Degradation (PCD) refers to the phenomenon in which supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while adapting a large language model (LLM) to a target task, often erodes the general capabilities acquired during pre-training. Prevailing explanations attribute PCD to macroscopic distribution shift and therefore lack microscopic manipulability, leaving existing mitigation methods without a complete theoretical foundation. In this paper, we first develop a bottom-up geometric theory of PCD grounded in feature interference under superposition: narrow-domain SFT data disrupt the almost-orthogonal feature structure formed during pre-training, and the resulting interference drives activations across decision hyperplanes in the output Laguerre-Voronoi geometry, flipping predictions on general tasks. This theory unifies existing methods into six paradigms and reveals both the source of their efficacy and their theoretical limits. We then prove that cross-entropy under one-hot supervision cannot resolve PCD on its own, and accordingly propose the AEGIS loss, which directly constrains the drift of activation margins along all competing token directions, thereby decoupling interference suppression from task adaptation. Across 3 model families and 14 SFT tasks, AEGIS outperforms representative methods of every paradigm on target tasks and pervasive capabilities simultaneously, at only about 1.3 times the computational cost of standard SFT. Its generality, scalability, and mechanistic interpretability offer a new perspective on fully resolving PCD.

papers.title: One Strategy Does Not Fit All: Rethinking Data Labeling for Just-in-Time Vulnerability Prediction
papers.abstract: Just-In-Time Vulnerability Prediction (JIT-VP) identifies security risks in code changes at commit time, enabling early feedback before vulnerabilities enter software systems. However, its practical reliability is challenged by the difficulty of constructing accurate labels. Multiple strategies with different trade-offs have been proposed to identify vulnerability-fixing commits (VFCs) and vulnerability-introducing commits (VICs) for dataset construction, leading to substantially different datasets. This makes it difficult to separate model performance from dataset construction. Moreover, real-world quality assurance requires not only classification but also prioritizing high-risk commits and localizing vulnerable causes. This paper presents an extensive empirical study of how labeling strategies affect these downstream tasks. We constructed 28 datasets using four VFC and four VIC labeling strategies across OpenSSL and Linux kernel, then evaluated six representative JIT-VP models for classification, prioritization, and localization. Our results show that labeling effectiveness is strongly task-dependent. Manual VFC labeling combined with vulnerability-specific VIC labeling provides the most reliable performance for classification and prioritization, significantly outperforming 11 of 15 alternatives. Meanwhile, precision-first VFC labeling combined with LLM-assisted VIC labeling performs best for localization, significantly outperforming 7 of 15 alternatives. These findings demonstrate that no single labeling strategy is universally optimal and highlight the importance of task-oriented dataset construction.

papers.title: DRAP: Dynamics-Risk Adaptive Plasticity for Continual Learning in Physical AI
papers.abstract: Continual learning in physical AI differs from conventional continual learning because small per-step policy errors can accumulate over a trajectory. Each deviation may move the agent outside the training distribution, increase subsequent prediction errors, and ultimately cause closed-loop task failure. This work introduces Dynamics-Risk Adaptive Plasticity (DRAP), a replay-free method that estimates the historical importance of adaptable model tensors from sample-level action gradients weighted by local trajectory-amplification risk. A ridge-regularized local linear model is fitted to expert state-action transitions, and the largest singular value of its state-transition matrix provides a policy-independent, Lyapunov-inspired estimate of one-step perturbation amplification. After each task, risk-weighted squared gradients are accumulated in a tensor-level importance memory. During subsequent tasks, DRAP uses normalized cumulative importance to scale the effective AdamW learning rate of each tensor, immediately reducing the plasticity of components that supported previous behavior at dynamically sensitive trajectory points. We instantiate DRAP on a fixed KappaTune-selected subnetwork of OpenVLA and evaluate replay-free sequential adaptation across the LIBERO Spatial, Object, and Goal suites. Compared with standard AdamW fine-tuning and EWC, the results show substantially improved retention of previously learned behaviors while preserving strong new-suite acquisition.

papers.title: ToolSpace: Scaling Tool-Centric Environment Synthesis for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract: Large language models are deployed as long-horizon agents that compose diverse tools across MCP services into executable workflows. Existing MCP environment-scaling methods are data-centric: they first synthesize a database and scenario, then derive tools and tasks from them. As a result, tool interfaces may not match real ones, tool compositions are not grounded in execution, and tasks rarely span more than one environment. We propose ToolSpace, a tool-centric framework that reverses this order. ToolSpace mines data, state, and retry dependencies from adjacent calls in execution traces of real MCP services and open agent corpora, using deterministic rules rather than LLM judgment, and clusters the resulting weighted tool-composition graph into environments. Databases are synthesized only for state-mutating environments, while query and stateless tools replay recorded returns. ToolSpace then performs state-aware random walks with rollback and decompiles each chain into a natural-language task with assertion-based checks, keeping only samples that replay successfully from the initial state. Applied to AutomationBench and tau3-Bench Banking, the pipeline produces harder Pro versions on which 7 frontier models drop by up to 38.2 points. Across seven long-horizon tool-use benchmarks, ToolSpace raises Qwen3.6-35B-A3B from 23.0 to 41.0 average score (43.2 with RL) and GLM-5.2 from 44.6 to 56.6, on par with Claude Opus 5. Ablations show that execution-witnessed edges clearly outperform LLM-judged ones, and performance keeps improving with data and environment scale.

papers.title: ALBI: LLM-Guided Inductive Logic Programming via Iterative Generate-Test-Constrain Refineme
papers.abstract: We introduce ALBI (Agent for Learning By Induction), a neuro-symbolic ILP framework that replaces the ASP-based hypothesis generator in the Learning from Failures (LFF) paradigm with a Large Language Model (LLM), while retaining SWI-Prolog as a formal verifier. ALBI implements an iterative generate-test-constrain loop: the LLM proposes candidate hypotheses from structured prompts; Prolog tests each candidate; and diagnostic feedback drives refinement. We further introduce semantic anonymization, a metamorphic testing methodology, to distinguish structural symbolic induction from surface-level pattern matching on predicate names. Experiments on 30 standard ILP benchmarks show that ALBI achieves 100% success across three frontier LLMs (Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT 5.4 Pro, Claude Opus 4.6), matching Popper while requiring only 1.4-1.7 iterations on average. Under anonymization, all models maintain 100% success with a moderate iteration increase (1.36-1.67 times), providing evidence of robust symbolic reasoning.

papers.title: Toward Constant-Factor Maximin Share Guarantees for Subadditive Valuations
papers.abstract: For $n$ agents and $m$ indivisible goods, an agent's maximin share (MMS) is the largest minimum bundle value she can obtain by partitioning the goods into $n$ bundles. Constant MMS approximations are known for additive, submodular, or XOS valuations, but whether such a guarantee exists for general subadditive valuations remains open. We advance this question in two directions. For general subadditive valuations, we exponentially improve the guarantee from $\Omega(1/\log\log n)$ to $\Omega(1/\log^* n)$, where $\log^* n$ is the iterated logarithm. We then seek constant MMS guarantees under additional structure on subadditive valuations by studying $q$-partitioning valuations: every partition of a bundle into at most $q$ groups admits nonnegative group prices that sum to the bundle's value and whose sum on any collection of groups is at most the value of their union. This hierarchy ranges from subadditivity at $q=2$ to XOS for $q\ge m$. We give the first study of MMS in the intermediate classes and prove constant guarantees whenever $q/n$ has a fixed positive lower bound, including $1/6$ for $q\ge n$ and $1/4$ for $q\ge2n$. For XOS valuations, we further improve the universal guarantee from $4/17\approx 0.2353$ to $5/16=0.3125$. For subadditive valuations, we prove a bidding amplification theorem that gives an exponential bound on each agent's probability of receiving less than half her MMS, while satisfying her budget in every outcome. For $q$-partitioning valuations, we give a scalar criterion that converts bounds on the value lost from disjoint deletions within a bundle into bounds on potential losses, even when an agent contributes zero below the target bundle value. For XOS valuations, we prove a reservation theorem that selects goods for integral assignment together with auxiliary additive valuations and accounts for the loss in rounding.

translation.abstract: For $n$ agents and $m$ indivisible goods, an agent's maximin share (MMS) is the largest minimum bundle value she can obtain by partitioning the goods into $n$ bundles. Constant MMS approximations are known for additive, submodular, or XOS valuations, but whether such a guarantee exists for general subadditive valuations remains open. We advance this question in two directions. papers.title: LatentTriad: Pre-Action Risk Representations for Malicious Agent Skill Detection
papers.abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly extended with reusable skills, but untrusted skill content can induce operations outside the user's task. Detecting this contextual risk requires more than suspicious-pattern matching, while dynamic analysis incurs the cost of skill execution. We find that hidden states formed during prefill contain readable information about task-operation consistency, including across held-out expression forms in controlled evaluations. Matched Operation-state interventions also affect later Boundary states and shift fixed risk readouts toward the donor label. Based on these findings, we introduce LatentTriad, which combines contextual Boundary features, group-adjusted Operation directions, and departures from benign state relationships. All branches share one prefill: detection generates no output tokens, invokes no tools, and executes no skill code. Across 5,830 skill packages from five sources and seven backbones, LatentTriad achieves 99.0-99.2% pooled F1 and 93.0-94.6% source-macro F1. A separately measured compact implementation completes prefill and detection in a median of 259-284 ms. These results connect pre-action risk readability and functional influence to execution-free skill screening.

papers.title: Search and Verification for Strategyproof Facility Location on Metric Graphs
papers.abstract: We study automated design of strategyproof (SP) mechanisms for randomized facility location on continuous metric graphs, with the objective of minimizing total distance. We develop methods for computing upper and lower bounds on the optimal approximation ratio achievable by SP mechanisms for a given graph and number of agents. For the lower bound, we propose a cost-preserving reduction to a finite domain that yields lower bounds for unrestricted SP mechanisms through linear programming dual certificates. For the upper bound, we introduce finite representations of mechanisms, called piecewise-linear attributions (PL attributions), that mix piecewise-linear deterministic mechanisms using affine weights on a triangulation of the report space. We show that for mechanisms represented by PL attributions, checking SP and an approximation guarantee reduces to finitely many quadratic nonnegativity tests over compact polytopes. With exact arithmetic and comparisons, each verification certifies the proposed property or returns locations where it fails. In addition, we introduce a strengthening of the incentive notion called strong strategyproofness. We show that for fixed component mechanisms and regions of a PL attribution, the strong strategyproofness requirement can be expressed by a finite number of linear constraints on the attribution coefficients. Using these theoretical results, we propose a heuristic procedure for computing an upper bound on the approximation ratio. We compute certified upper and lower bounds on several metric graphs and numerically evaluate the proposed search procedure. Lastly, we show that deterministic SP onto mechanisms on graphs are strongly strategyproof and admit PL attributions. Thus restricting attention to strongly strategyproof mechanisms admitting PL attributions loses no deterministic SP onto mechanisms.

papers.title: A Gated Spec-Driven Workflow: An Audit-Trail Study of Coding-Agent Work
papers.abstract: Spec-driven development (SDD) asks a coding agent to work from specifications, plans, and task lists rather than from the chat transcript. We study one such workflow for Claude Code, in which almost every control is an instruction carried out by the same model that it constrains. The user must approve each stage before the next begins. A reviewer subagent checks each artefact against a fixed, stage-specific defect list, and an executor subagent may only touch the files listed in its task. After each block of tasks, the orchestrator runs a file-inventory check to detect undeclared changes. We analyse the logs and transcripts of nine features in seven projects, all run by the authors, ranging from a Fortran solver and Python programs to books and this paper. Of these, five finished with every planned task done, including the Fortran solver feature, and 288 of the 581 planned tasks were completed block by block. The executor kept to its declared files: it left only one undeclared change in the deliverable folder, and the check caught it, although its reports record other departures from the protocol. The weak point was the orchestrator, which runs and judges its own checks. It recorded undeclared changes in 11 of 247 block checks, mostly from the authors' in-round requests and the environment, and stopped work in only four.
