papers.title: Workload-Static Optical Circuit Switching For Scalable LLM Inference Decode
papers.abstract: LLM inference decode executes fine-grained collectives whose latency directly limits per-user interactivity, yet scale-up fabrics are still built from electronic packet switches designed for training. We observe that, for a given model deployment and parallelization, the communication structure of decode is fixed, and propose workload-static optical circuit switching (OCS): circuits are configured once per deployment, co-designed with model parallelism and with topology-aware collective schedules that turn spare accelerator ports into fewer communication phases or higher bandwidth. We evaluate this design with GXNET, a graph-based workload emulator coupled to analytical and flit-level network models grounded in hardware measurements. In a 576-accelerator scale-up domain serving 5T-parameter MoE models with up to 5M tokens of context, all-OCS fabrics improve interactivity by up to 65% and energy efficiency by up to 119% over 4:1 oversubscribed packet-switched fabrics.

translation.title: 面向可扩展LLM推理解码的负载静态光路交换
translation.abstract: LLM推理解码执行细粒度集合通信，其延迟直接限制每个用户的交互性，然而scale-up网络仍由为训练设计的电子包交换机构建。我们观察到，对于给定的模型部署和并行化方式，解码的通信结构是固定的，并提出负载静态光路交换（OCS）：电路在每次部署时配置一次，与模型并行协同设计，并配合拓扑感知的集合通信调度，将空闲的加速器端口转化为更少的通信阶段或更高带宽。我们使用GXNET评估该设计，这是一个基于图的负载模拟器，结合了基于硬件测量的解析模型和flit级网络模型。在一个服务5T参数MoE模型、上下文长达5M token的576加速器scale-up域中，全OCS网络相比4:1超订的包交换网络将交互性提升最高65%，能效提升最高119%。
translation.brief: 针对LLM解码集合通信延迟限制交互性的问题，提出按部署一次性配置的负载静态光路交换网络，并与模型并行和拓扑感知集合通信调度协同设计。

papers.title: From AutoResearch to Continual AutoResearch: Do Agents Learn Across Tasks?
papers.abstract: Autoresearch has shown that agents can autonomously write code, run experiments, and iteratively improve machine learning solutions. Yet most evaluations start a new agent session from scratch for each new problem, making them costly and leaving unclear whether agents can retain and apply prior insights when adapting to new tasks. We introduce CONTINUAL AUTORESEARCH, an open-ended environment that compares persistent and reset instances of the same agent under matched task streams, data, and time budget. Continual AutoResearch covers nine task families, spanning synthetic tasks, symbolic regression, time-series forecasting, and tabular AutoML. Across five frontier agents, we measure first-solution quality, research efficiency, and final held-out performance. To distinguish insight transfer from session continuity, we run a memory ablation that vary what information agents retain from prior tasks. We show that persistent state improves research efficiency of all five agents, allowing them to find stronger solutions sooner. However, these gains do not consistently translate into better final solutions. Overall, our findings suggest that retaining experience and utilizing it effectively are distinct capabilities.

translation.title: 从AutoResearch到持续AutoResearch：智能体能跨任务学习吗？
translation.abstract: AutoResearch表明智能体可以自主编写代码、运行实验并迭代改进机器学习方案。然而大多数评估为每个新问题从头启动新的智能体会话，成本高昂，且不清楚智能体在适应新任务时能否保留和应用先前洞见。我们提出CONTINUAL AUTORESEARCH，一个开放式环境，在匹配的任务流、数据和时间预算下比较同一智能体的持久实例与重置实例。Continual AutoResearch涵盖九个任务族，包括合成任务、符号回归、时间序列预测和表格AutoML。我们在五个前沿智能体上测量首个解的质量、研究效率和最终held-out性能。为区分洞见迁移与会话连续性，我们进行记忆消融实验，改变智能体从先前任务保留的信息。结果表明持久状态提升了所有五个智能体的研究效率，使其更快找到更强的解，但这些收益并不总能转化为更好的最终解。总体而言，我们的发现表明保留经验与有效利用经验是两种不同的能力。
translation.brief: 研究智能体能否跨任务保留并利用先前经验，通过在匹配条件下对比持久与重置会话及记忆消融来分离洞见迁移与会话连续性的作用。

papers.title: Distributed Linear Bandits for Freshness-Aware Preprocessing in MEC-Enabled Digital Twin Networks
papers.abstract: Digital twins (DTs) require timely updates from Internet of Things (IoT) devices to accurately represent the state of the corresponding physical systems, but transmitting large data volumes can compromise freshness. Moreover, different task classes have distinct computational demands and freshness requirements, while stochastic task generation and sizes complicate resource allocation. In this paper, we propose a freshness-aware framework in which multi-access edge computing (MEC) servers preprocess IoT data, reducing transmission volume and DT-server processing load. The framework establishes mutual support between DT and MEC servers. The DTs determine feasible CPU-allocation strategies guaranteeing class-specific age-of-information (AoI) requirements under specified workload, delay, and update-generation bounds. MEC servers collaboratively identify the feasible strategy minimizing expected freshness-normalized preprocessing delay. We formulate CPU-strategy selection as a fixed-confidence distributed best-arm identification problem in linear bandits, with MEC servers as agents and CPU allocations across task classes as arms. We employ DistLinGapE, a distributed collaborative learning method, to coordinate exploration and share observations. Numerical results show that the method identifies the optimal feasible strategy and reduces preprocessing delay when deployed under stationary task-class assignments and workload statistics. Collaboration yields an identification speedup nearly proportional to the number of participating MEC servers in the evaluated settings.

translation.title: 面向MEC赋能数字孪生网络中新鲜度感知预处理的分布式线性老虎机
translation.abstract: 数字孪生（DT）需要来自物联网（IoT）设备的及时更新以准确反映对应物理系统的状态，但传输大量数据会损害新鲜度。此外，不同任务类别有不同的计算需求和新鲜度要求，而随机任务生成和规模使资源分配复杂化。本文提出一个新鲜度感知框架，其中多接入边缘计算（MEC）服务器对IoT数据进行预处理，减少传输量和DT服务器处理负载。该框架建立DT与MEC服务器之间的相互支持。DT确定可行的CPU分配策略，在指定负载、延迟和更新生成约束下保证各类别的信息年龄（AoI）要求。MEC服务器协作识别最小化期望新鲜度归一化预处理延迟的可行策略。我们将CPU策略选择形式化为线性老虎机中固定置信度的分布式最优臂识别问题，MEC服务器作为智能体，跨任务类别的CPU分配作为臂。我们采用DistLinGapE这一分布式协作学习方法来协调探索并共享观测。数值结果表明，在平稳任务类别分配和负载统计下部署时，该方法能识别最优可行策略并降低预处理延迟。在评估设置中，协作带来的识别加速与参与MEC服务器数量近似成正比。
translation.brief: 针对数字孪生网络中IoT数据预处理的新鲜度与延迟优化问题，将MEC服务器CPU分配策略选择建模为分布式线性老虎机的最优臂识别问题并用DistLinGapE协作求解。

papers.title: The Right Source Is Not Enough: Understanding History Interference in Speech-LLM Memory
papers.abstract: Speech large language models retain audio history to support multi-turn conversations. Yet remembering an event does not ensure that its information is used only when relevant. We investigate why irrelevant historical audio changes answers even when the queried event remains represented. Controlled experiments on MOSS-Audio and MiMo-Audio show that historical values direct errors toward specific competing answers, beyond a generic effect of context length. Causal interventions distinguish two paths. In open-ended question answering, most history-value errors disappear when subsequent computation cannot directly access the irrelevant source. In multiple-choice answering, many errors persist: early historical influence is carried by question-candidate states even after direct source access is blocked. Low-dimensional interventions further separate source-role information from answer-value information. Their effects peak at different depths, and changing the source-role signal does not eliminate the causal influence of competing values. On naturally occurring errors, strengthening the queried role and counteracting the historical value each improve answers; their joint intervention gives the greatest recovery. These findings support a failure of downstream evidence use beyond source identification alone: source-role information can influence a decision without exclusively controlling which historical values affect it. Reliable conversational memory therefore requires not only retention and retrieval, but also control over how retained information enters answer computation.

translation.title: 正确的来源并不足够：理解Speech-LLM记忆中的历史干扰
translation.abstract: 语音大语言模型保留音频历史以支持多轮对话。然而记住一个事件并不意味着其信息只在相关时被使用。我们研究为何无关的历史音频即使在被查询事件仍被表示的情况下也会改变答案。在MOSS-Audio和MiMo-Audio上的受控实验表明，历史值会将错误导向特定的竞争答案，超出上下文长度的普遍影响。因果干预区分了两条路径。在开放式问答中，当后续计算无法直接访问无关来源时，大多数历史值错误消失。在选择题回答中，许多错误持续存在：即使直接来源访问被阻断，早期历史影响仍由问题-候选状态携带。低维干预进一步将来源角色信息与答案值信息分离。两者的效应在不同深度达到峰值，且改变来源角色信号并不能消除竞争值的因果影响。在自然发生的错误上，强化被查询角色和抵消历史值各自都能改善答案；联合干预带来最大恢复。这些发现支持一种超越来源识别的下游证据使用失败：来源角色信息可以影响决策，而不能独占地控制哪些历史值影响它。因此，可靠的对话记忆不仅需要保留和检索，还需要控制保留的信息如何进入答案计算。
translation.brief: 研究Speech-LLM多轮对话中无关历史音频为何干扰答案，通过因果干预和低维分析分离来源角色信息与历史答案值信息两条影响路径。

papers.title: Towards Multi-Method Evaluation of AI in Health: Integrating Benchmarks, Autoraters, and Expert Evaluation
papers.abstract: General-purpose generative AI (GenAI) models are being rapidly adopted in healthcare, but they are challenging to assess with traditional evaluation frameworks. These conceptual, methodological, and practical challenges parallel decades of work in evaluating clinician and health system quality and safety. We describe the adaptation of methods from several fields, combined with emerging technical approaches, into a structured, multi-method evaluation framework designed to give well-rounded assessments of GenAI in health at scale. The approach first anchors evaluation to Critical User Journeys (CUJs) to help prioritize out of a large choice space, and maps these to a phased AI system lifecycle (base model development, product development, and post-deployment monitoring), since evaluation at each stage requires different methodological approaches. In this context, the approach then integrates three distinct evaluation methods (closed-question benchmarks, LLM-as-a-judge autoraters, and expert human review) across three core domains: accuracy, safety, and usefulness. Taken together, this approach provides a strategic framework for bridging the gap between benchmarking results and performance in the real world with the goal of supporting decision-making and accountability across development, procurement, and deployment for product teams, health systems, and regulators.

translation.title: 迈向医疗AI的多方法评估：整合基准、自动评估器与专家评估
translation.abstract: 通用生成式AI（GenAI）模型正在医疗领域快速普及，但用传统评估框架对其进行评估充满挑战。这些概念、方法和实践层面的挑战与数十年来评估临床医生和医疗系统质量与安全的工作相呼应。我们描述了将多个领域的方法与新兴技术途径相结合，形成结构化、多方法的评估框架，旨在对医疗GenAI进行大规模的全面评估。该方法首先将评估锚定在关键用户旅程（CUJ）上，以帮助从大量选择空间中确定优先级，并将其映射到分阶段的AI系统生命周期（基础模型开发、产品开发和部署后监控），因为每个阶段的评估需要不同的方法论。在此背景下，该方法在准确性、安全性和有用性三个核心领域整合三种不同的评估方法（封闭式问题基准、LLM-as-a-judge自动评估器和专家人工评审）。综合起来，该方法为弥合基准测试结果与真实世界表现之间的差距提供了战略框架，旨在支持产品团队、医疗系统和监管机构在开发、采购和部署过程中的决策与问责。
translation.brief: 针对医疗GenAI难以用传统框架评估的问题，提出以关键用户旅程为锚点、按AI生命周期阶段整合基准、LLM自动评估器与专家评审的多方法评估框架。

papers.title: Sharp Bounds for Truthful-in-Expectation Scheduling
papers.abstract: We study randomized mechanisms for scheduling indivisible jobs on $n$ unrelated machines. Each machine is controlled by a selfish agent who privately knows its processing time for each job. A mechanism assigns every job to a machine and makes payments. We require truthfulness in expectation: no agent can increase its expected payment minus its expected processing cost by misreporting, regardless of the other agents' reports. The makespan is the maximum total processing time assigned to a machine; the objective is to minimize its expectation. We prove that the optimal approximation ratio is $(n+1)/2$ for every $n\ge7$, relative to the minimum makespan of an integral assignment. The lower bound holds for every $n$ and allows unrestricted computation and arbitrary correlations among assignments, assuming finite expected payments and a guarantee uniform over all finite job counts. The matching mechanism uses correlated rounding and runs in expected polynomial bit time on rational inputs. These guarantees hold for all finite nonnegative processing times. For two machines, we characterize the optimal approximation ratio exactly as an analytic constant, approximately $1.505995705434$, and give a mechanism attaining it. For three machines the optimal ratio is $2$. For four, five, and six machines we obtain upper bounds of $3$, $105/32$, and $29/8$, respectively, compared with the general lower bound $(n+1)/2$. The proofs for $n\ge7$ do not rely on computer-assisted certificates; the two- and three-machine results use exact rational computer-assisted certificates.

translation.title: 期望真实性调度问题的紧致界
translation.abstract: 我们研究在 $n$ 台不相关机器上调度不可分割作业的随机机制。每台机器由一个自私的智能体控制，其私下知道每个作业的处理时间。机制将每个作业分配给一台机器并进行支付。我们要求期望真实性：无论其他智能体如何报告，任何智能体都不能通过虚报来提高其期望支付减去期望处理成本。makespan（完工时间）是分配给一台机器的最大总处理时间；目标是最小化其期望。我们证明，相对于整数分配的最小 makespan，对每个 $n\ge7$，最优近似比为 $(n+1)/2$。该下界对每个 $n$ 都成立，允许无限制的计算和分配之间的任意相关性，假设期望支付有限且保证对所有有限作业数一致成立。匹配的机制使用相关舍入，并在有理数输入上以期望多项式比特时间运行。这些保证对所有有限的非负处理时间成立。对于两台机器，我们将最优近似比精确刻画为一个解析常数，约为 $1.505995705434$，并给出达到该值的机制。对于三台机器，最优比为 $2$。对于四、五、六台机器，我们分别得到上界 $3$、$105/32$ 和 $29/8$，与一般下界 $(n+1)/2$ 相比。$n\ge7$ 的证明不依赖计算机辅助证书；两机和三机的结果使用精确的有理数计算机辅助证书。
translation.brief: 研究不相关机器上期望真实性的随机调度机制，通过相关舍入机制和下界分析确定了各机器数下的最优近似比。

papers.title: From Opinions to Commitments: Unstable Assignments and Silent Choices in AI-Mediated Proposals
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used to turn citizens' opinions into collective proposals. These proposals can make assignments: who should act, what must be done, how much one should spend and by when. However, if the assignments change when the same opinions are processed again, publishing a single proposal can hide alternatives that participants never get to see. We examined this issue in four LLM mediators (three open-weight and one commercial) using opinions from DeliberationBank and Polis. For each task, a mediator drafted a proposal from thirty opinions five times, varying either the random seed or the order of the opinions. In 17% of five-run sets from the open-weight mediators and 20% from the commercial one, some runs contained assignments while others did not. Reordering the opinions changed the assignments almost as often as replacing them with opinions from different citizens. Three human annotators confirmed that the detected differences between runs were real, although the LLM judge overstated how often they occurred. Substantial variation remained under four safeguards: temperature zero, a commercial mediator, draft selection, and draft merging. The mediator's objective also shaped representation: prompts seeking agreement covered minority positions much less often than prompts asking to describe differences. A single proposal can therefore obscure choices in both the assignments it proposes and the views it excludes. We propose audits that make alternative assignments visible and disclose the objective behind each proposal.

translation.title: 从意见到承诺：AI 调解提案中的不稳定分配与隐性选择
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于将公民意见转化为集体提案。这些提案可以做出分配：谁应该行动、必须做什么、花费多少以及何时完成。然而，如果同样的意见再次处理时分配发生变化，发布单一提案可能隐藏参与者永远看不到的替代方案。我们在四个 LLM 调解者（三个开放权重和一个商业模型）上使用来自 DeliberationBank 和 Polis 的意见研究了这一问题。对于每个任务，调解者从三十条意见中起草提案五次，改变随机种子或意见顺序。在开放权重调解者的五次运行集合中有 17%、商业调解者有 20% 的情况，某些运行包含分配而其他运行不包含。重新排列意见顺序改变分配的频率几乎与用不同公民的意见替换它们相当。三位人类标注者确认了运行之间检测到的差异是真实的，尽管 LLM 评判者夸大了差异发生的频率。在四种保障措施下——温度为零、商业调解者、草稿选择和草稿合并——仍然存在显著变异。调解者的目标也塑造了代表性：寻求共识的提示词覆盖少数派立场的频率远低于要求描述分歧的提示词。因此，单一提案可能掩盖其提出的分配和其排除的观点中的选择。我们提出审计方法，使替代分配可见并披露每个提案背后的目标。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 将公民意见转化为集体提案时分配结果的不稳定性，通过多次重复生成实验检测变异并提出使替代方案可见的审计方法。

papers.title: Meta$^2$: Precomputing Reusable Knowledge for Online Harness Evolution in Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract: Harness optimization improves long-horizon agents by refining the prompts, tools, memory, and hooks around a frozen model. Offline methods can learn from completed trajectories, but deploy one shared harness that may overfit training tasks and cannot react to evidence revealed during a new run. Online evolution can adapt before, during, or after one run through an evolver, but may have to reason about every intervention from scratch or rely on verifier feedback that is usually unavailable at test time. We introduce Meta$^2$, which moves offline optimization one level up: rather than optimizing a shared harness, it learns reusable knowledge for harness evolution and applies it within each task online. Offline, Meta$^2$ learns a textual Meta-Skill $M$ by contrasting training rollouts of the same task agent under three configurations: without an evolver, with an evolver guided by the current version of $M$, and with an evolver given privileged verifier information available only in training. Contrasts in trajectories and outcomes are aggregated across tasks to refine $M$ into reusable guidance on when and how to evolve, when to leave the harness unchanged, and which interventions to avoid. Online, an evolver combines the frozen $M$ with emerging trajectory evidence to decide whether to KEEP the harness unchanged or EVOLVE it through a task-local edit. Each edit applies to the rest of the same run without resetting its environment or progress. Thus, evolution guidance transfers across tasks while harness edits remain task-local, and held-out verifier feedback is never available to the evolver. On two long-horizon benchmarks, Terminal-Bench 2.1 and DeepSWE 1.1, Meta$^2$ achieves the highest performance among evaluated methods with GPT-5.6-Terra, reaching 81.00% and 44.44%, respectively. Ablations support the value of contrastive evolution guidance and keeping online harness edits task-local.

translation.title: Meta$^2$：为长程智能体的在线 Harness 演化预计算可复用知识
translation.abstract: Harness 优化通过改进冻结模型周围的提示词、工具、记忆和钩子来提升长程智能体。离线方法可以从已完成的轨迹中学习，但部署的是单一共享 harness，可能过拟合训练任务，且无法对新运行中揭示的证据做出反应。在线演化可以通过演化器在单次运行之前、期间或之后进行适应，但可能必须从头推理每次干预，或依赖测试时通常不可用的验证器反馈。我们提出 Meta$^2$，它将离线优化提升一个层次：不是优化共享 harness，而是学习用于 harness 演化的可复用知识，并在每个任务中在线应用。离线阶段，Meta$^2$ 通过对比同一任务智能体在三种配置下的训练 rollout 来学习文本形式的 Meta-Skill $M$：无演化器、由当前版本 $M$ 引导的演化器、以及被赋予仅训练时可用的特权验证器信息的演化器。跨任务聚合轨迹和结果的对比，将 $M$ 精炼为关于何时以及如何演化、何时保持 harness 不变、以及避免哪些干预的可复用指导。在线阶段，演化器将冻结的 $M$ 与新出现的轨迹证据结合，决定是 KEEP（保持 harness 不变）还是通过任务局部编辑进行 EVOLVE（演化）。每次编辑应用于同一运行的剩余部分，而不重置环境或进度。因此，演化指导跨任务迁移，而 harness 编辑保持任务局部，且演化器永远无法获得留出的验证器反馈。在两个长程基准 Terminal-Bench 2.1 和 DeepSWE 1.1 上，Meta$^2$ 使用 GPT-5.6-Terra 在所评估方法中取得最高性能，分别达到 81.00% 和 44.44%。消融实验支持对比性演化指导和保持在线 harness 编辑任务局部的价值。
translation.brief: 针对长程智能体 harness 优化难以在线适应的问题，提出通过离线对比学习可复用的演化指导知识（Meta-Skill），在线结合轨迹证据进行任务局部的 harness 编辑。

papers.title: GM League Arena: An Interactive Long-Horizon Task Benchmark Based on Professional Sports League Management
papers.abstract: Long-horizon decision-making under sustained competition requires large language models (LLMs) to balance immediate investment with future resource needs. However, local success in multi-step interactions can not adequately capture cumulative decision effects or demonstrate long-term goal achievement under resource constraints and sustained competition. To address this gap, we introduce GM Bench, a benchmark for managing professional sports teams across seasons under resource constraints and competition among teams. We build the environment simulators for four sports and add financial constraints, player demands, and market mechanisms to establish a unified task across sports. Diverse rosters of comparable strength are constructed from real-world player data, and each LLM is evaluated as a team general manager to assess its long-term management capabilities. We evaluate competitive performance, cash reserves, and cross-season improvement across four sports. Over five NBA seasons, Claude Opus 5.5 ranks first among 29 LLMs, while GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol combine strong performance with larger cash reserves.

translation.title: GM League Arena：基于职业体育联盟管理的交互式长程任务基准
translation.abstract: 在持续竞争下的长程决策要求大语言模型（LLM）在即时投入与未来资源需求之间取得平衡。然而，多步交互中的局部成功无法充分体现累积决策效果，也无法展示资源约束和持续竞争下长期目标的达成。为填补这一空白，我们提出 GM Bench，一个在资源约束和球队间竞争下跨赛季管理职业球队的基准。我们为四种运动构建了环境模拟器，并加入财务约束、球员需求和市场机制，建立跨运动的统一任务。基于真实球员数据构建实力相当的不同阵容，每个 LLM 作为球队总经理接受评估，以考察其长期管理能力。我们在四种运动上评估竞技表现、现金储备和跨赛季进步。在五个 NBA 赛季中，Claude Opus 5.5 在 29 个 LLM 中排名第一，而 GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 在强劲表现的同时拥有更大的现金储备。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 长程决策评估不足的问题，构建了基于职业体育联盟跨赛季管理的交互式基准，以总经理角色评估模型的长期管理能力。

papers.title: What Sets the Serving Speed of Looped Language Models? Measurements and Optimizations Graded by Exactness
papers.abstract: Looped language models apply one block of layers many times per token, so a serving engine pays every per-layer overhead once per loop; we measure serving for Ouro and Huginn-0125 in an open-source looped-model engine and grade our optimizations from bitwise-identical changes to those that require an accuracy check. At batch 1, fusing all loop submissions leaves Ouro throughput at 0.99x; the 5689 small kernels per token are the real cost, and fusing them behind rounding fences raises throughput 1.11-1.59x while 1014/1014 requests remain identical. An approximate fusion is no faster and misses a one-point GSM8K rule on 87 questions (61 and 62 correct versus 64), so we do not ship it. Huginn's released defaults avoid dead KV slots, reuse prefix-cache pages, and serve 1.77-3.16x faster than the base engine; Ouro reaches 1.65-2.15x and agent sessions 1.91-3.21x, while Huginn's noise and prefix-reuse changes stay within one point on all 1319 Huginn test questions; Huginn's packed prefill, -0.61 points on the same questions, meets that rule only on its point estimate. Position-keyed noise makes CPU cache reuse exact but still leaves 20 of 128 GPU full hits different, while loop fusion delays prefill admission and a 64-graph cache prevents eager fallbacks. Under prefill-decode disaggregation ExactLoop reaches up to 3.3x the base throughput with peer error handling disabled, and 3.1x in two of three runs with it enabled. Its transfer budget, sized to hold one request's KV in flight, cuts the commit tail from about one second under the earlier budget to 16 ms (base: 2.8 s), removing the polling rounds that the engine's interval would otherwise impose.

translation.title: 是什么决定了循环语言模型的服务速度？按精确性分级的测量与优化
translation.abstract: 循环语言模型对每个 token 多次应用同一层块，因此服务引擎在每次循环中都要支付每层开销；我们在一个开源循环模型引擎中测量了 Ouro 和 Huginn-0125 的服务性能，并将优化按从比特级一致到需要精度检查的等级进行分级。在 batch 1 下，融合所有循环提交使 Ouro 吞吐量保持在 0.99x；每 token 5689 个小内核才是真正的成本，将它们在舍入栅栏后融合可将吞吐量提升 1.11-1.59x，同时 1014/1014 个请求保持完全一致。近似融合并不更快，且在 87 个问题上违反了 GSM8K 一分规则（61 和 62 正确对 64），因此我们不发布它。Huginn 的发布默认设置避免了死 KV 槽、复用前缀缓存页，比基础引擎快 1.77-3.16x；Ouro 达到 1.65-2.15x，智能体会话达到 1.91-3.21x，而 Huginn 的噪声和前缀复用改动在全部 1319 个 Huginn 测试问题上保持在一分以内；Huginn 的打包预填充在同一问题上降低 0.61 分，仅在其点估计上满足该规则。位置键控噪声使 CPU 缓存复用精确，但在 128 个 GPU 全命中中仍有 20 个不同，而循环融合延迟了预填充准入，64 图缓存防止了 eager 回退。在预填充-解码分离下，ExactLoop 在禁用对等错误处理时达到基础吞吐量的 3.3x，启用时三次运行中有两次达到 3.1x。其传输预算按容纳一个请求的在途 KV 设计，将提交尾部从先前预算下的约一秒降至 16 ms（基础：2.8 s），消除了引擎间隔原本会强制的轮询轮次。
translation.brief: 针对循环语言模型服务中每层开销被重复支付的问题，通过系统测量定位小内核开销为瓶颈，并提出按精确性分级的融合与调度优化方案。

papers.title: Catalyzing Interactive HTML Generation Capabilities via High-Fidelity Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Generating HTML from natural-language specifications is an important application of code large language models (LLMs). Despite producing renderable pages, current models often fail to ensure functionality and visual quality during actual interaction. Existing methods typically target task-specific webpage supervision, leaving demanding interactive artifact optimization underexplored. Using mini-games as a challenging testbed, we expose limitations in interaction experience, reward signal, and credit assignment fidelity that are obscured by shallow webpage interactions. We introduce WebCatalyst, a browser-interaction reinforcement learning framework with three complementary components: a game-level GUI assessor for sustained interaction and evaluation, Visual Anchor for mitigating VLM reward hacking, and Action-Trace Credit for grounding token-level credit assignment in runtime execution traces. Trained on fewer than 1K requests, predominantly for games, WebCatalyst raises the Cookie-Bench Mini Games score from 68.8 to 75.3 and also the WebGen-Bench accuracy from 48.8 to 56.9 on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, outperforming Claude Opus 4.7 in average rank across evaluated metrics. Further analysis shows that Visual Anchor prevents aesthetic degradation, while runtime-grounded credit assignment accelerates functional improvement. Together, our results show that improving feedback fidelity is the key to substantially advancing interactive HTML generation.

translation.title: 通过高保真强化学习催化交互式 HTML 生成能力
translation.abstract: 从自然语言规范生成 HTML 是代码大语言模型（LLM）的一项重要应用。尽管当前模型能够生成可渲染的页面，但在实际交互过程中往往无法保证功能性和视觉质量。现有方法通常针对任务特定的网页监督，对高要求的交互式工件优化探索不足。我们以小游戏作为具有挑战性的测试平台，揭示了在浅层网页交互中被掩盖的交互体验、奖励信号和信用分配保真度方面的局限。我们提出 WebCatalyst，一个浏览器交互强化学习框架，包含三个互补组件：用于持续交互与评估的游戏级 GUI 评估器、用于缓解 VLM 奖励作弊的 Visual Anchor，以及将 token 级信用分配建立在运行时执行轨迹之上的 Action-Trace Credit。在少于 1K 条请求（主要为游戏）上训练后，WebCatalyst 将 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在 Cookie-Bench Mini Games 上的得分从 68.8 提升至 75.3，并将 WebGen-Bench 准确率从 48.8 提升至 56.9，在所评估指标的平均排名上超过 Claude Opus 4.7。进一步分析表明，Visual Anchor 防止了美学退化，而基于运行时的信用分配加速了功能改进。总之，我们的结果表明，提升反馈保真度是大幅推进交互式 HTML 生成的关键。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 生成的 HTML 在实际交互中功能与视觉质量不足的问题，提出结合 GUI 评估器、Visual Anchor 和运行时轨迹信用分配的浏览器交互强化学习框架 WebCatalyst。

papers.title: DSL-Bench: Evaluating and Explaining LLM Code Generation Across Domain-Specific Languages
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software-engineering workflows, but code-generation benchmarks largely focus on general-purpose languages. Domain-specific languages (DSLs) have distinct syntax, semantics, and validation requirements, making results from individual DSL benchmarks difficult to compare. We present DSL-Bench, an executable benchmark and analysis framework for cross-DSL code generation. Starting from 13,045 DSL-related papers, LLM-assisted open card sorting identifies 18 representative application domains. For each domain, we select an evaluable DSL and provide a syntax checker and task-level semantic oracle. Evaluating 7 LLMs on 18 DSLs, we observe mean syntax and semantic pass rates of 31.37% and 11.64%, respectively, revealing a substantial gap between syntax acceptance and semantic correctness. A variance decomposition attributes 76.99% of semantic pass-rate variation to differences among DSLs and 7.86% to differences among models. Among four DSL-level factors, Knowledge Demand has the strongest negative association with semantic correctness (r = -0.508). We evaluate prompt engineering across all 18 DSLs and study five improvement methods on five targeted DSLs. Prompt engineering yields uneven gains; RAG-Refinement, the strongest targeted method, improves semantic correctness by 16.29 percentage points on average over matched baselines. We further derive capability profiles and DSL-Profiler summaries for interpreting data-scarce DSLs. These results highlight toolchain-specific semantic bottlenecks and the need to evaluate DSL code generation beyond syntax acceptance.

translation.title: DSL-Bench：跨领域特定语言的 LLM 代码生成评估与解释
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在软件工程工作流中的应用日益广泛，但代码生成基准大多聚焦于通用编程语言。领域特定语言（DSL）具有独特的语法、语义和验证要求，使得单个 DSL 基准的结果难以相互比较。我们提出 DSL-Bench，一个用于跨 DSL 代码生成的可执行基准与分析框架。从 13,045 篇 DSL 相关论文出发，借助 LLM 的开放式卡片分类法识别出 18 个代表性应用领域。针对每个领域，我们选择一个可评估的 DSL，并提供语法检查器和任务级语义 oracle。对 7 个 LLM 在 18 个 DSL 上的评估显示，平均语法通过率为 31.37%，语义通过率为 11.64%，揭示了语法接受与语义正确性之间的巨大差距。方差分解表明，76.99% 的语义通过率差异来自 DSL 之间的差异，7.86% 来自模型之间的差异。在四个 DSL 层面因素中，知识需求（Knowledge Demand）与语义正确性的负相关最强（r = -0.508）。我们在全部 18 个 DSL 上评估了提示工程，并在五个目标 DSL 上研究了五种改进方法。提示工程带来的收益不均衡；最强的针对性方法 RAG-Refinement 相对匹配基线平均将语义正确性提升 16.29 个百分点。我们进一步推导了能力画像和 DSL-Profiler 摘要，用于解释数据稀缺的 DSL。这些结果凸显了工具链特定的语义瓶颈，以及超越语法接受来评估 DSL 代码生成的必要性。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 在领域特定语言上代码生成难以比较和评估的问题，构建了覆盖 18 个 DSL 的可执行基准 DSL-Bench，并结合方差分解与 DSL 层面因素分析解释性能差异。

papers.title: AgentAM: An AI Agent for Spatter- and Defect-Aware Process Optimization in Laser Powder Bed Fusion
papers.abstract: Predictive models for laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) are rarely used on the shop floor because querying them requires programming and model-specific knowledge. We present AgentAM, a large language model (LLM) agent that gives process engineers natural-language access to CFD-trained surrogates of spatter and melt pool geometry for SS316L through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Polynomial surrogates trained on 279 single-track simulations predict melt pool dimensions ($R^2 \geq 0.95$) and spatter volume ($R^2 = 0.83$ on test data) at any power-velocity point in the trained range, and geometric criteria assign each point a geometry-derived defect regime (keyhole, lack of fusion, balling or stable) that matches the regime obtained from the simulated geometry in 93.4% of tracks under cross-validation. The agent selects and parameterizes tools for prediction, process-window scans and constrained optimization. Minimum-spatter optima often sat within 10 $\mu$m of the lack-of-fusion boundary; a margin-aware optimizer moved them away from all thresholds and raised the estimated probability of remaining classified Good from 0.94 to 1.00 under an assumed 2% process drift, and from 0.72 to 0.91 when jointly sampled cross-validated geometry residuals were added. About 40-50 well-spread simulations sufficed to reproduce the defect map. To evaluate the agent layer, we introduce a 145-prompt benchmark scored against direct tool calls, plus eight prompts (40 runs) on margin-aware requests. Over the 725 runs of the main benchmark the agent passed the intended inputs in 98.5% of parsing prompts, reported the scored spatter values and defect classes faithfully and met every stated constraint in the 65 feasible optimization runs, within a median 1.0% of the brute-force optimum.

translation.title: AgentAM：面向激光粉末床熔融中飞溅与缺陷感知工艺优化的 AI 智能体
translation.abstract: 激光粉末床熔融（LPBF）的预测模型很少在车间实际使用，因为查询它们需要编程和模型特定知识。我们提出 AgentAM，一个大型语言模型（LLM）智能体，通过 Model Context Protocol（MCP）让工艺工程师能够以自然语言访问针对 SS316L 的、由 CFD 训练的飞溅和熔池几何代理模型。基于 279 次单道扫描仿真训练的多项式代理模型，可在训练范围内的任意功率-速度点预测熔池尺寸（R² ≥ 0.95）和飞溅体积（测试数据上 R² = 0.83），且几何准则为每个点分配基于几何的缺陷状态（匙孔、未熔合、球化或稳定），在交叉验证中与仿真几何得到的状态在 93.4% 的扫描道上一致。该智能体可自动选择并参数化工具，用于预测、工艺窗口扫描和约束优化。最小飞溅的最优点往往位于距未熔合边界 10 μm 以内；一个考虑裕度的优化器将其移离所有阈值，在假设 2% 工艺漂移下将保持 Good 分类的估计概率从 0.94 提升至 1.00，在加入联合采样的交叉验证几何残差后从 0.72 提升至 0.91。约 40-50 个分布良好的仿真即可重现缺陷图。为评估智能体层，我们引入一个包含 145 条提示、以直接工具调用为评分标准的基准，以及针对裕度感知请求的 8 条提示（40 次运行）。在主基准的 725 次运行中，智能体在 98.5% 的解析提示中正确传递了预期输入，忠实报告了参与评分的飞溅值和缺陷类别，并在 65 次可行的优化运行中满足所有给定约束，与暴力搜索最优值的偏差中位数为 1.0%。
translation.brief: 针对 LPBF 预测模型在车间难以使用的问题，构建通过 MCP 以自然语言访问 CFD 代理模型并执行预测、工艺窗口扫描与裕度感知约束优化的 LLM 智能体 AgentAM。

papers.title: Correctness Firewalls for Synthesized Database Components
papers.abstract: For the first time in history, high-performance code is cheap. Today's coding agents can generate bespoke, instance-optimized data systems with excellent performance, and such agents will continue to improve as LLMs advance. But a purely agentic approach, even when validated with strong testing techniques, does not automatically inherit the correctness guarantees our community has spent decades building. We propose a middle ground between hand-crafted and agent-crafted systems: correctness firewalls, lightweight design patterns under which a synthesized component can affect a system's performance but never its results. Behind a correctness firewall, agents are free to synthesize fast components while the overall system remains correct. We present three case studies, each demonstrating a different type of firewall: cardinality estimation (advisory), searching sorted data (guarded), and data compression (certified). In early experiments, synthesized components search sorted data up to 3x faster than human-designed learned indexes and can compress text 1.5x smaller than Zstd. Drawing on these case studies, we outline a research agenda for how data management systems can exploit coding agents without giving up their hard-won correctness guarantees, from protecting synthesized code to measuring the cost of correctness.

translation.title: 面向合成数据库组件的正确性防火墙
translation.abstract: 历史上首次，高性能代码变得廉价。如今的编码智能体能够生成定制的、实例优化的数据系统，性能优异，且随着 LLM 的进步，这类智能体还会持续改进。但纯智能体的方法，即使经过强大的测试技术验证，也不会自动继承我们社区数十年来构建的正确性保证。我们提出手工构建与智能体构建系统之间的中间路线：正确性防火墙（correctness firewalls），一种轻量级设计模式，使合成组件可以影响系统的性能，但永远不会影响其结果。在正确性防火墙之后，智能体可以自由合成快速组件，而整个系统保持正确。我们给出三个案例研究，各自展示一种不同类型的防火墙：基数估计（advisory，咨询型）、有序数据搜索（guarded，守护型）和数据压缩（certified，认证型）。在早期实验中，合成组件搜索有序数据的速度比人类设计的学习型索引快至 3 倍，文本压缩比 Zstd 小 1.5 倍。基于这些案例研究，我们勾勒出一个研究议程，阐述数据管理系统如何在不放弃来之不易的正确性保证的前提下利用编码智能体，从保护合成代码到度量正确性的代价。
translation.brief: 针对编码智能体生成的组件缺乏正确性保证的问题，提出“正确性防火墙”设计模式，使合成组件只影响性能而不影响结果，并通过三个数据库组件案例加以验证。

papers.title: The Novelty Horizon H_N: Why Large Language Models Fail to Generate Scientific Data beyond Their Training Distribution
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) lack physical grounding and extrapolation. This paper formalises the Novelty Horizon as tasks needing extrapolation beyond training support, causal reasoning absent from learned correlations, or post-frontier information. A forensic analysis tests LLMs on unguided, guided, and ground-truth data from an underrepresented diode-clamped short-circuit experiment using temporal, spectral, and statistical validation against a first-principles Modified Ohm's Law. Both script-based approaches fail catastrophically with physical and spectral inconsistencies, extreme statistical pathologies, zero Generative Fidelity Score, and linear-regime outputs. Direct prompting corroborates distinct failure modes. This paper introduces the Past Information Boundary and physics-based authentication. LLM data generation cannot extrapolate past the Novelty Horizon essential for novel discovery. Hybrid neuro-symbolic systems must preserve human causal reasoning and experimental design.

translation.title: 新颖性视界 H_N：为什么大语言模型无法生成超出其训练分布的科学数据
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）缺乏物理基础和外推能力。本文将新颖性视界（Novelty Horizon）形式化为需要超出训练支持范围外推的任务、需要学习到的相关性中不存在的因果推理的任务，或涉及前沿之后信息的任务。一项取证式分析在来自一个代表性不足的二极管钳位短路实验的无引导、有引导和真值数据上测试 LLM，并依据第一性原理的修正欧姆定律进行时域、频域和统计验证。两种基于脚本的方法均灾难性失败，出现物理与频谱不一致、极端的统计病态、零生成保真度得分以及仅线性区的输出。直接提示也印证了不同的失败模式。本文引入过去信息边界（Past Information Boundary）和基于物理的认证方法。LLM 数据生成无法外推到对新颖发现至关重要的新颖性视界之外。混合神经符号系统必须保留人类的因果推理和实验设计。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 能否生成超出训练分布的科学实验数据的问题，通过二极管钳位短路实验的取证式验证形式化“新颖性视界”，证明 LLM 无法外推并需保留人类因果推理。

papers.title: OperAItor: An Agentic Framework for Fault-Tolerant Operation of Chemical Processes
papers.abstract: OperAItor, an open-source framework for developing and evaluating large language model agents for supervisory fault management in chemical processes. The framework is demonstrated on a dynamic reactor-distillation process representing isopropanol dehydrogenation, with physically based thermodynamics and modified reaction kinetics to permit liquid-phase operation. The process is represented by a 113-variable differential-algebraic model and operates at a nominal feed rate of 100kmol/h, producing approximately 4t/h of acetone. The simulated plant includes 8 PI control loops, 22 process alarms, 5 duty-standby pump trains, and 11 independent safety instrumented functions. The agent architecture integrates multivariate statistical process monitoring, fault diagnosis, knowledge-graph retrieval, action planning, and supervisory action generation. Five action-validation configurations are investigated, comprising operation without validation, an LLM-based judge, digital-twin simulation, and deterministic admissibility checks with and without consequence projection. The framework is evaluated using four LLMs across 20 scenarios involving single and multiple simultaneous faults. Without agent intervention, 18 scenarios result in plant stops, corresponding to an economic loss of $399,000 relative to fault-free operation under the assumed benchmark economics. For GPT-5 nano, Qwen3 8B, and Mistral 7B, validated agent configurations reduce the number of stops to 5-8 and recover $265,000 of the loss. The study provides a reproducible benchmark for comparing agent architectures, language models, and action-validation methods for supervisory fault management in chemical processes.

papers.title: What Does the Model See? Representation Validity in Multimodal LLM-Based Video Analysis
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) allow social scientists to analyze video at scale, but researchers must decide which parts of a video to provide as input. We use the term representation validity to examine how text, audio, video, and combined inputs affect measurement and subsequent analysis. We compare input representations across six open-weight MLLMs and three human-annotated video datasets. No representation consistently performs best. On seven news-related constructs, native-video performance varies little across models (macro-F1 = .70-.77), while extracted-text performance ranges from .52 to .80. Three models perform better with text and three with video. Combining inputs rarely improves performance. Higher classification accuracy also does not reliably produce estimates closer to those based on human codes. The highest-F1 representation best reproduces human-coded regression coefficients in 17 of 42 comparisons. Even when each model uses its highest-F1 deployable representation, 45% of sample-prevalence estimates differ from the human-coded benchmark by more than ten percentage points. Input representation therefore requires validation for both the construct being measured and the quantity estimated from the resulting labels.

papers.title: Santa Claus and Weighted Nash Social Welfare with Subadditive Valuations
papers.abstract: We study two fairness objectives for allocating $m$ indivisible items among $n$ agents with subadditive valuations: the max-min objective, also known as the Santa Claus problem, which maximizes the smallest value of an agent, and the weighted Nash social welfare, which maximizes the weighted geometric mean of the agents' values. For the max-min allocation problem, we give a randomized polynomial-time $O(\sqrt n)$-approximation algorithm for subadditive valuations with demand queries, improving the $2n-1$ bound of Khot and Ponnuswami. For additive valuations and for submodular valuations with value queries, we give simpler $O(\sqrt n)$-approximation algorithms. For additive valuations, this improves the $O(\sqrt{n\log n})$ bound of Saha and Srinivasan. For these two classes, $O(m^\varepsilon)$-approximation algorithms are also known for every constant $\varepsilon>0$. Our ratios depend only on $n$ and match, up to constants, the $\Omega(\sqrt n)$ integrality gap of the configuration LP. For the weighted Nash social welfare problem with subadditive valuations and demand queries, we give an $O(\Gamma(w))$-approximation algorithm, where $\Gamma(w)=\exp\bigl((\ln n-H(w))/2\bigr)$ and $H(w)$ is the entropy of the weight vector $w$. The factor $\Gamma(w)$ equals $1$ for equal weights and is at most $\sqrt n$ for all weights. We show that this ratio is tight for algorithms analyzed against the configuration LP: for every weight vector, the configuration LP has an integrality gap of $\Theta(\Gamma(w))$, even for XOS valuations, and this gap is $\Omega(\sqrt n)$ when one agent has almost all the weight. For submodular valuations, the configuration LP has a constant integrality gap for all weights.

papers.title: ARLoop: Fully-Open Pre-trained Looped Transformers with Attention Residuals
papers.abstract: Looped transformers increase effective depth by repeatedly applying a shared set of transformer layers, offering a parameter-efficient way to scale computation. However, standard residual connections aggregate information across recurrent depth into a single stream, providing limited control over which intermediate representations from preceding layers should be reused. In this paper, we introduce ARLoop, a looped transformer architecture based on attention residuals, where the input of each layer is selectively aggregated through attention over model depth. Distinct from standard transformers, we find that looped transformers do not require access to the full residual history: sliding-window depth attention matches or outperforms full-history attention at larger recurrent depths. Across controlled experiments with multiple parameter scales (140M and 370M) and recurrent depths (R = 1 to 5), ARLoop consistently outperforms prior residual designs for looped transformers. More importantly, we further scale ARLoop to 0.6B and 1.2B parameters under a realistic LLM pretraining recipe, demonstrating that the gains transfer to realistic pretraining, with particularly strong improvements on math and coding tasks. Our 1.2B model, pretrained on only 0.5T tokens with three recurrences, outperforms Huginn-3.5B (the only fully-open looped LLM as of our release date) across all evaluated tasks and is competitive with similar-sized non-looped models such as Qwen3.5-2B despite being trained on substantially less data.

papers.title: Computational Aspects of Distortion
papers.abstract: The distortion framework in social choice theory allows quantifying the efficiency of (randomized) selection of an alternative based on the preferences of a set of agents. We make two fundamental contributions to this framework. First, we develop a linear-programming-based algorithm for computing the optimal randomized decision on a given instance, which is simpler and faster than the state-of-the-art solutions. For practitioners who may prefer to deploy a classical decision-making rule over the aforementioned optimal rule, we develop an algorithm based on non-convex quadratic programming for computing the exact distortion of any (and the best) randomized positional scoring rule. For a small number of alternatives, we find that the exact distortion bounds are significantly better than the asymptotic upper bounds established in prior literature and lead to different recommendations on which rules to use. These results rely on a novel characterization of the instances yielding the worst distortion, which may be of independent interest.

papers.title: JHiMA-WebRL: A Joint Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Long-Horizon Web Tasks
papers.abstract: Multimodal web agents have shown promising capabilities for interacting with websites through graphical user interfaces (GUIs), yet realistic web tasks often require long-horizon, multi-step planning that remains challenging for monolithic policies. Such agents must jointly infer high-level plans, navigate through intermediate states, track progress over extended interaction histories, and execute visually grounded actions. Although prior work has explored modular multi-agent systems with a separate planner, the planner is typically not updated jointly with the actor. We investigate whether explicitly separating and jointly training planning and execution provides a stronger inductive bias for long-horizon web navigation. We introduce JHiMA-WebRL, a joint hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for web agents that couples a task decomposer with an actor. To train the decomposer, we use a strong teacher model to construct structured subtask supervision from multimodal GUI trajectories, and use these annotations to fine-tune both the decomposer and the subtask-conditioned actor. We then extend Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to jointly optimize the decomposer and actor in the interactive WebArena environment through hierarchical rollout grouping and role-specific advantages. On WebArena-Lite-v2, JHiMA-WebRL-14B, consisting of a 7B actor and a 7B decomposer, achieves an average success rate of 37.2%, compared with 24% for a ScaleCUA-32B agent that we fine-tune with RL on the same training tasks and evaluate under the same protocol. Ablations show that jointly updating the decomposer during RL outperforms updating the actor alone. These results suggest that jointly learned role factorization with smaller models can be a competitive alternative to scaling monolithic agents for long-horizon web tasks.

translation.title: JHiMA-WebRL：面向长程Web任务的联合分层多智能体强化学习框架
translation.abstract: 多模态Web智能体已展现出通过图形用户界面（GUI）与网站交互的能力，但真实的Web任务往往需要长程、多步规划，这对单体策略仍然极具挑战。此类智能体必须同时推断高层计划、在中间状态间导航、在漫长的交互历史中追踪进度，并执行视觉定位的动作。尽管已有工作探索了带有独立规划器的模块化多智能体系统，但规划器通常不与执行器联合更新。我们研究显式分离并联合训练规划与执行，能否为长程Web导航提供更强的归纳偏置。我们提出JHiMA-WebRL，一个面向Web智能体的联合分层多智能体强化学习框架，将任务分解器与执行器耦合。为训练分解器，我们使用强大的教师模型从多模态GUI轨迹中构建结构化子任务监督，并用这些标注微调分解器和以子任务为条件的执行器。随后我们扩展了组相对策略优化（GRPO），通过分层rollout分组和角色特定优势，在交互式WebArena环境中联合优化分解器与执行器。在WebArena-Lite-v2上，由7B执行器和7B分解器组成的JHiMA-WebRL-14B达到37.2%的平均成功率，而我们在相同训练任务上用RL微调并在相同协议下评估的ScaleCUA-32B智能体仅为24%。消融实验表明，在RL过程中联合更新分解器优于仅更新执行器。这些结果表明，用较小模型联合学习角色分解，可以成为扩展单体智能体以应对长程Web任务的有力替代方案。
translation.brief: 针对长程Web任务中单体策略规划与执行耦合困难的问题，提出将任务分解器与执行器联合训练的分层多智能体强化学习框架JHiMA-WebRL。

papers.title: Stabilizing On-Policy Targeted Guidance in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Naive on-policy RL is often bottlenecked by the capabilities of the base model --- insufficient coverage can result in an inability to learn from certain rewards. At the same time, rewards in modern post-training systems often come from rich textual sources, e.g. judge models with a rubric of criteria. Can we utilize such structures to provide a rich directional signal that enables improving on otherwise difficult to optimize rewards? In this work, we examine a framework we refer to as targeted guidance that learns from per-turn textual feedback via an on-policy self-distillation objective. Our focus is not only on directly improving hard-to-optimize behaviors, but on how to do so throughout the training process without degrading baseline RL performance. Over a range of settings across an agentic multi-turn software engineering environment, we find success by combining targeted self-distillation with a per-criteria RL reward, and by limiting feedback to turns where the policy specifically fails. We further examine the design choices that lead to stable entropy and reduce oscillatory behavior throughout training.

translation.title: 稳定智能体强化学习中的在线定向引导
translation.abstract: 朴素的在线策略RL常受限于基座模型的能力——覆盖不足可能导致无法从某些奖励中学习。同时，现代后训练系统中的奖励往往来自丰富的文本来源，例如带有评判标准的judge模型。我们能否利用这些结构提供丰富的方向性信号，从而改进原本难以优化的奖励？本工作研究一种称为定向引导的框架，通过在线策略自蒸馏目标从逐轮文本反馈中学习。我们的重点不仅是直接改进难以优化的行为，还在于如何在整个训练过程中做到这一点而不降低基线RL性能。在智能体多轮软件工程环境的多种设置中，我们发现将定向自蒸馏与逐标准RL奖励相结合，并将反馈限制在策略具体失败的轮次上，能够取得成功。我们进一步研究了能带来稳定熵并减少训练全程振荡行为的设计选择。
translation.brief: 针对在线RL难以优化某些奖励的问题，提出通过逐轮文本反馈的在线自蒸馏实现定向引导，并设计保持训练稳定性的机制。

papers.title: ToolSched: Resource-Efficient Tool Scheduling for Shared-Host LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Local LLM agents often work on shared hosts. Unlike multi-tenant cloud clusters, these hosts often have tightly bounded memory, CPU, and I/O resources. Concurrent agents frequently suffer from resource contention, leading to failures such as OOM and reduced resource efficiency. Considering that agents' resource demands are bursty and shell command delay is imperceptible to agents, there is a huge scheduling opportunity to arrange when and in what order commands are actually executed. Thus, we present ToolSched, a Shell MCP Server for shared local hosts that serves multiple agents and schedules their operations. ToolSched embeds a resource model into the MCP interface: agents estimate resource demands along with command requests. These hints, together with real-time host resource conditions, determine when commands are actually executed. Internally, ToolSched applies a scheduling algorithm to stagger commands, reducing contention and improving resource utilization. Prediction correction and checkpoint-based recovery mitigate estimation bias and resource errors. Our evaluation on Terminal Bench shows that, compared with unscheduled execution, ToolSched improves resource utilization by 148.4% and end-to-end command throughput by 29.4%, demonstrating its effectiveness and practicality.

translation.title: ToolSched：面向共享主机LLM智能体的资源高效工具调度
translation.abstract: 本地LLM智能体常在共享主机上运行。与多租户云集群不同，这些主机的内存、CPU和I/O资源通常受到严格限制。并发智能体经常遭受资源争用，导致OOM等故障和资源效率下降。考虑到智能体的资源需求具有突发性，且shell命令延迟对智能体不可感知，在何时以及以何种顺序实际执行命令方面存在巨大的调度机会。因此，我们提出ToolSched，一个面向共享本地主机的Shell MCP Server，可服务多个智能体并调度其操作。ToolSched将资源模型嵌入MCP接口：智能体在发出命令请求时同时估计资源需求。这些提示与实时主机资源状况共同决定命令的实际执行时机。在内部，ToolSched应用调度算法错开命令执行，减少争用并提高资源利用率。预测校正和基于检查点的恢复机制可缓解估计偏差和资源错误。在Terminal Bench上的评估表明，与无调度执行相比，ToolSched将资源利用率提升148.4%，端到端命令吞吐量提升29.4%，证明了其有效性和实用性。
translation.brief: 针对共享主机上并发LLM智能体的资源争用问题，提出嵌入资源模型的Shell MCP Server ToolSched，通过调度命令执行时机提升资源利用率。

papers.title: The Geometry of Ignorance: Detecting Suppressed Knowledge in LLMs through Activation Fragmentation
papers.abstract: Evaluating whether a large language model (LLM) genuinely knows a concept remains a fundamental problem, since behavioral metrics can be fooled by suppression: a model that refuses to answer may still harbor recoverable knowledge. The framework measures the geometric coherence of \textit{anon-vectors}, the differences in hidden states between a concept-specific query and its anonymized paraphrase, and shows that genuine knowledge forms a tight, low-entropy cluster while ignorance forces geometric fragmentation. Across ten instruction-tuned LLMs from three model families, all fragmentation metrics reliably separate known from unknown concepts, and post-unlearning, fragmentation geometry correlates with adversarial recovery across four attack types and five unlearning algorithms, though the direction of that relationship is shown to depend on attack methodology. Furthermore, a layer-resolved analysis reveals that different adversarial mechanisms exploit this geometry at varying depths, with high attack-specific correlations that are invisible to behavioral evaluation. Together, these results constitute a single-phase, attack-free proxy for unlearning robustness that captures aspects of parametric knowledge inaccessible to output-level metrics. A reference implementation is available at this https URL

translation.title: 无知的几何学：通过激活碎片化检测LLM中被抑制的知识
translation.abstract: 评估大语言模型（LLM）是否真正掌握某个概念仍是一个基本问题，因为行为指标可能被抑制所欺骗：拒绝回答的模型可能仍保有可恢复的知识。该框架测量anon向量的几何一致性，即概念特定查询与其匿名化改写之间隐状态的差异，并表明真正的知识形成紧密的低熵簇，而无知则导致几何碎片化。在来自三个模型家族的十个指令微调LLM上，所有碎片化指标都能可靠地区分已知与未知概念；在遗忘后，碎片化几何与四种攻击类型、五种遗忘算法下的对抗性恢复相关，尽管该关系的方向取决于攻击方法。此外，逐层分析揭示不同对抗机制在不同深度利用这种几何，其高攻击特异性相关性在行为评估中不可见。这些结果共同构成了一种单阶段、无需攻击的遗忘鲁棒性代理指标，能够捕捉输出级指标无法触及的参数化知识层面。参考实现见此URL。
translation.brief: 针对行为指标无法判断LLM是否真正掌握概念的问题，提出通过概念查询与匿名化改写间隐状态差异的几何碎片化来检测被抑制的知识。

papers.title: Beyond Accuracy: What Language-Subspace Interventions Capture, Remove, and Improve
papers.abstract: Language-subspace interventions aim to improve multilingual reasoning by suppressing language-related components in mid-layer activations. Using MATH and MGSM across four open-weight LLMs, we ask three questions: do estimated language subspaces capture translation-associated variation? Does projecting them out remove language information? And do they improve accuracy without compromising response language? For the first question, we build subspaces using the existing Mean-SVD construction and our DiffPCA. Both capture substantial translation-associated variation and show similar patterns across model depth. For the second, we project out each subspace and train linear probes to classify language from the projected activations. The probes still identify language almost perfectly, showing that neither subspace exhaustively captures language information. For the third, we evaluate several intervention configurations on Qwen2.5-7B, by varying subspace creation methods and intervention operators. We find that the intervention that most improves MGSM accuracy sacrifices response-language fidelity, with only one intervention improving joint accuracy--answers that are correct and in the target language--slightly, by 1.60 points. Interestingly, subtle changes in the prompt alone can reproduce the accuracy gains albeit with significant damage to language fidelity. We argue that causal interventions must be judged on more than accuracy, to fully account for language substitution trade-offs.

translation.title: 超越准确率：语言子空间干预捕获、移除和改进了什么
translation.abstract: 语言子空间干预旨在通过抑制中层激活中的语言相关成分来改进多语言推理。我们在四个开源权重LLM上使用MATH和MGSM，提出三个问题：估计的语言子空间是否捕获与翻译相关的变化？投影去除它们是否移除语言信息？它们能否在不损害响应语言的情况下提升准确率？对于第一个问题，我们使用现有的Mean-SVD构造和我们的DiffPCA构建子空间。两者都捕获了大量与翻译相关的变化，并在模型深度上呈现相似模式。对于第二个问题，我们投影去除各子空间并训练线性探针从投影后的激活中分类语言。探针仍能近乎完美地识别语言，表明两种子空间都未穷尽地捕获语言信息。对于第三个问题，我们在Qwen2.5-7B上通过改变子空间构建方法和干预算子评估多种干预配置。我们发现，最能提升MGSM准确率的干预牺牲了响应语言的保真度，仅有一种干预使联合准确率（答案正确且使用目标语言）略微提升1.60分。有趣的是，仅对提示做细微改动即可复现准确率提升，但会严重损害语言保真度。我们认为，评估因果干预必须超越准确率，以充分考量语言替换的权衡。
translation.brief: 针对语言子空间干预是否真正移除语言信息并提升多语言推理的问题，系统评估其捕获、移除效果及准确率与语言保真度的权衡。

papers.title: Knowingly Wrong: Training LLMs Against Their Own Beliefs can Induce Misalignment
papers.abstract: Fine-tuning a large language model (LLM) on harmful data in a narrow domain, such as bad medical advice, can make it broadly misaligned. How realistic this risk is remains unclear, since models are very rarely fine-tuned on explicitly harmful data in practice. In this work, we show that fine-tuning on data the model believes to be false but that has no harmful content, can also induce broad misalignment. Across mathematics, trivia, cooking and sports, the more strongly the model disbelieves the answers it is trained on, the more misaligned it becomes. In mathematics, misaligned answers rise from 4% to over 60% as the training answers become more wrong, with little loss of general capability. After fine-tuning, the model states the wrong answers but its multiple-choice probabilities still prefer the true ones, which suggests that misalignment comes from this internal inconsistency. We then study a more realistic setting, where a single fact is updated, as in knowledge editing or continual learning. The same relationship holds and the more the model still believes the true fact after training on the false one, the more misaligned it becomes. When we frame the same false fact as part of a coherent story, the model comes to believe it more deeply and becomes less misaligned than when we instruct it to assert the false fact. Content filters and persona vectors cannot tell these two framings apart, even though they lead to different levels of misalignment. These results suggest a risk for model updates, where training a model that does not adopt the new fact as true can induce misalignment even when the data looks harmless.

translation.title: 明知是错的：用违背模型自身信念的数据训练 LLM 可诱发失对齐
translation.abstract: 在狭窄领域（如不良医疗建议）的有害数据上微调大语言模型（LLM）可使其广泛失对齐。这一风险的现实性尚不清楚，因为实践中模型很少在明确有害的数据上微调。在本工作中，我们表明在模型认为是错误但不含有害内容的数据上微调，也会诱发广泛的失对齐。在数学、冷知识、烹饪和体育等领域，模型对所训练答案越不相信，失对齐程度越高。在数学领域，随着训练答案越来越错误，失对齐回答从 4% 升至 60% 以上，而通用能力几乎没有损失。微调后，模型会说出错误答案，但其多选题概率仍偏好正确答案，这表明失对齐源于这种内部不一致。随后我们研究了更现实的场景，即如知识编辑或持续学习中那样更新单个事实。同样的关系依然成立：模型在训练错误事实后仍越相信真实事实，失对齐程度就越高。当我们将同一错误事实包装为连贯故事的一部分时，模型会更深地相信它，且比被指示断言错误事实时失对齐程度更低。内容过滤器和 persona 向量无法区分这两种表述方式，尽管它们导致不同程度的失对齐。这些结果表明模型更新存在风险：当训练后的模型未将新事实采纳为真时，即使数据看起来无害，也可能诱发失对齐。
translation.brief: 研究在模型自身不认同的错误数据上微调会诱发广泛失对齐，并通过多领域实验和知识编辑场景揭示其源于模型内部信念不一致。

papers.title: False Reassurance in LLM Severe-Weather Guidance: A Replayable Evaluation Against Real NWS Alerts
papers.abstract: An LLM assistant that cannot see official severe-weather alerts may tell users that conditions are calm while a warning is active. We call this false reassurance and measure it by replaying 117 frozen cases built from real U.S. National Weather Service (NWS) alerts (69 alert cases, 32 no-alert controls, 16 non-U.S. locations) through five conditions of a Claude-based preparedness pipeline that differ in alert access and prompt design. One rater hand-labeled all 342 alert-case responses under a seven-category scheme written after an initial binary pass, which we disclose. False reassurance was 0.0% for the production pipeline (0/66, 95% CI 0.0-5.5) and for the same alerts under a neutral prompt (0/69), 37.7% for a blind neutral prompt (26/69), and 44.9% when the blind prompt also told the model to disclose its blind spot (31/69). Every case was implicit; no response explicitly denied an alert. Real alerts removed false reassurance (paired McNemar p < 0.0001); the disclosure instruction did not (p = 0.40). An automated regex measure suggested the opposite and missed 53 of 57 true cases, so we do not use it. Alert data alone was not enough for safe behavior: with a neutral prompt the model raised some alarm on 87.5% of no-alert controls, against 0% under the production prompt, and a preregistered single-sentence ablation showed that one production instruction explains part of that gap. We also report two failures common to similar systems, NWS test products ingested as real alerts and a token budget that fails on complex cases, and we release the dataset, labels and code.

translation.title: LLM 强天气指导中的虚假安心：基于真实 NWS 预警的可重放评估
translation.abstract: 无法看到官方强天气预警的 LLM 助手可能在预警生效时告诉用户情况平静。我们称之为虚假安心，并通过重放 117 个基于美国国家气象局（NWS）真实预警构建的冻结案例（69 个预警案例、32 个无预警对照、16 个非美国地点），在五种不同预警访问权限和提示设计的 Claude 备灾流水线条件下进行测量。一名标注者在初步二分类后制定的七分类方案下手工标注了全部 342 个预警案例回复，我们对此予以披露。生产流水线的虚假安心率为 0.0%（0/66，95% CI 0.0-5.5），相同预警在中性提示下也为 0（0/69），盲式中性提示下为 37.7%（26/69），盲式提示同时要求模型披露其盲点时为 44.9%（31/69）。所有案例均为隐性的；没有回复明确否认预警。真实预警消除了虚假安心（配对 McNemar p < 0.0001）；披露指令则没有（p = 0.40）。自动正则表达式度量给出了相反结论并漏掉了 57 个真实案例中的 53 个，因此我们不采用它。仅有预警数据不足以保证安全行为：在中性提示下，模型在 87.5% 的无预警对照中发出了一定警报，而生产提示下为 0%，且一项预注册的单句消融表明生产指令中的一条解释了部分差距。我们还报告了类似系统常见的两个失败：NWS 测试产品被当作真实预警摄入，以及在复杂案例上失效的 token 预算，并发布了数据集、标注和代码。
translation.brief: 通过重放真实 NWS 预警案例评估 LLM 天气助手在无法访问预警时给出虚假安心的风险，并分析提示设计与预警访问对安全行为的影响。

papers.title: LoopVQ: Sub 1-bit KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers
papers.abstract: Looped transformers are a parameter-efficient alternative to standard transformers for language modeling. By reapplying the same layers across multiple loop steps, recent looped language models match the performance of non-looped models several times their size. While this architecture effectively reduces parameter memory, each loop step still stores its own keys and values, so the key-value (KV) cache grows linearly with the number of loop steps and becomes the main memory bottleneck. We observe that the KV cache of looped models is highly redundant along the loop axis and that the loop steps differ substantially in their sensitivity to quantization. Based on these observations, we propose $\textbf{LoopVQ}$, a KV cache vector quantization method for looped transformers that codes channels of multiple loop steps jointly, and fine-tunes the codebooks to match the output of the full-precision model. At 0.5 bits per element, LoopVQ outperforms existing KV cache vector quantization methods for standard LLMs on general, long chain-of-thought reasoning, and long-context retrieval tasks with Ouro and Huginn models. Its design is orthogonal to these methods, and combined with TaSQ, it retains much of the BF16 accuracy even at 0.25 bits per element. We also implement LoopVQ in SGLang, where it nearly halves the decode latency at a 32K-token context and raises the peak serving throughput by up to $4.3\times$ and $6.1\times$ on the 1.4B and 2.6B Ouro models compared to the BF16 baseline.

translation.title: LoopVQ：面向循环 Transformer 的亚 1-bit KV 缓存量化
translation.abstract: 循环 Transformer 是语言建模中标准 Transformer 的参数高效替代方案。通过在多个循环步骤中重复应用相同的层，近期的循环语言模型可匹配数倍于其大小的非循环模型的性能。虽然这种架构有效降低了参数内存，但每个循环步骤仍存储自己的键和值，因此键值（KV）缓存随循环步数线性增长，成为主要内存瓶颈。我们观察到循环模型的 KV 缓存沿循环轴高度冗余，且各循环步骤对量化的敏感性差异显著。基于这些观察，我们提出 LoopVQ，一种面向循环 Transformer 的 KV 缓存向量量化方法，它联合编码多个循环步骤的通道，并微调码本以匹配全精度模型的输出。在每元素 0.5 bit 下，LoopVQ 在通用、长思维链推理和长上下文检索任务上，于 Ouro 和 Huginn 模型上超越了面向标准 LLM 的现有 KV 缓存向量量化方法。其设计与这些方法正交，与 TaSQ 结合后，即使在每元素 0.25 bit 下也能保留大部分 BF16 精度。我们还在 SGLang 中实现了 LoopVQ，在 32K token 上下文下解码延迟几乎减半，1.4B 和 2.6B Ouro 模型的峰值服务吞吐量相比 BF16 基线分别提升至 4.3 倍和 6.1 倍。
translation.brief: 针对循环 Transformer 中 KV 缓存随循环步数线性增长的问题，提出联合编码多循环步通道并微调码本的向量量化方法 LoopVQ。

papers.title: You don't need long context
papers.abstract: Later tokens are costlier to generate than earlier tokens. On frontier open weight models, the disparity in cost may rise to as much as 7x. Through frequent compaction, we show across a broad range of long-horizon and long-input tasks that frontier language models sacrifice little to no task accuracy when maintaining short contexts. We further demonstrate that LLM performance does not collapse on long-horizon software engineering tasks even when taking at most one action per context, and based on that we outline the concept of semantic state space models (SSSMs). Our findings question the need for long-context language models.

translation.title: 你不需要长上下文
translation.abstract: 生成靠后的 token 比靠前的 token 成本更高。在前沿开源权重模型上，成本差距可能高达 7 倍。通过频繁压缩，我们在广泛的长期和长输入任务上表明，前沿语言模型在维持短上下文时几乎不损失任务准确率。我们进一步证明，即使每个上下文最多执行一个动作，LLM 在长期软件工程任务上的性能也不会崩溃，并基于此提出语义状态空间模型（SSSM）的概念。我们的发现质疑了对长上下文语言模型的需求。
translation.brief: 通过频繁上下文压缩实验表明短上下文几乎不损失任务准确率，据此质疑长上下文语言模型的必要性并提出语义状态空间模型概念。

papers.title: MDSKILL: Learning to Internalize Skill Memory through Multi-View Distillation for Efficient Dynamic Agent Self-Evolution
papers.abstract: Skill memories encode past experiences as textual prompts to improve reinforcement learning (RL) for self-evolving agents. Complementing RL, On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) provides dense, fine-grained supervision to internalize knowledge from skill-guided trajectories and accelerate policy learning. However, self-generated memories often contain noisy supervision and functionally entangled, redundant, or conflicting knowledge, making direct distillation difficult. Under limited training budgets, these issues can hinder knowledge internalization and even degrade performance. To address this problem, we propose MDSKILL, a multi-view distillation approach for skill memory internalization. MDSKILL organizes skill memories into three complementary functional views (state grounding, action planning, and execution control) and selects high-quality skills using dynamic metrics to construct view-specific and integrated reasoning branches. OPSD then transfers and consolidates complementary experiential knowledge across these branches into a shared policy, enabling efficient skill internalization and continuous agent self-evolution. We evaluate MDSKILL on three agent benchmarks against RL, skill-augmented, and self-distillation baselines that do not rely on stronger external teacher models. Without additional computational overhead, MDSKILL improves upon SOTA performance by up to 7.1% and 8.1% on ALFWorld and WebShop. Extensive ablations and evolution analyses further validate its effectiveness in knowledge internalization and policy improvement. The code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: MDSKILL：通过多视角蒸馏内化技能记忆，实现高效的动态智能体自我进化
translation.abstract: 技能记忆将过往经验编码为文本提示，以改进自进化智能体的强化学习（RL）。作为 RL 的补充，在线自蒸馏（OPSD）提供密集、细粒度的监督，以内化技能引导轨迹中的知识并加速策略学习。然而，自生成的记忆常包含噪声监督以及功能纠缠、冗余或冲突的知识，使直接蒸馏变得困难。在有限训练预算下，这些问题会阻碍知识内化，甚至降低性能。为解决该问题，我们提出 MDSKILL，一种用于技能记忆内化的多视角蒸馏方法。MDSKILL 将技能记忆组织为三个互补的功能视角（状态定位、动作规划和执行控制），并使用动态指标选择高质量技能，构建视角特定和整合的推理分支。OPSD 随后将这些分支中互补的经验知识迁移并整合到共享策略中，实现高效的技能内化和持续的智能体自我进化。我们在三个智能体基准上，将 MDSKILL 与不依赖更强外部教师模型的 RL、技能增强和自蒸馏基线进行对比评估。在无额外计算开销的情况下，MDSKILL 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上分别将 SOTA 性能提升至多 7.1% 和 8.1%。大量消融和进化分析进一步验证了其在知识内化和策略改进方面的有效性。代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 针对自生成技能记忆中的噪声与知识纠缠问题，提出将技能记忆按三个功能视角组织并通过在线自蒸馏内化到共享策略的多视角蒸馏方法 MDSKILL。

papers.title: HARP: Training-Free Dual-Profile Agentic Communication for LLM-Based Recommendation
papers.abstract: In LLM-based recommendation, memory acts as a user-level agent in a memory-augmented backbone. Yet users and items remain asymmetric: only the user is given a structured profile; it enters a bandwidth-limited reranker prompt; and it is frozen after warmup. We recast LLM-based recommendation as an agentic-communication process in four stages: BUILD a self-description, TRANSMIT it along the collaborative graph, UNDERSTAND the other side, and SYNC it from the next interaction. This formulation reveals three unresolved communication challenges: the item side never produces a comparable self-description (one-sided BUILD); profile-level signals enter only the bandwidth-limited reranker prompt rather than retrieval, where they would not compete for context tokens (prompt-trapped UNDERSTAND); and the user's description is frozen after warmup with no principled update rule (absent SYNC). We instantiate the missing stages as HARP (Homophily-aware Agentic Recommendation via dual Profiles), a training-free, three-operator addition to a frozen LLM backbone: a rule-extracted symmetric item profile (zero extra LLM calls), a channel-decomposable profile-level homophily H(phi_u, phi_i) consumed at retrieval time rather than inside the reranker prompt, and a single-pass reflective update realising in-context profile evolution without any gradient step. On four public benchmarks (Yelp, Books, MovieTV, Goodreads), HARP lifts Hit@1 over the strongest published baseline by 6.9%-24.0%, with family-wise Holm-corrected p < 1e-9 on every dataset. Ablations and a per-case attribution study show that the operators contribute complementary gains, with the retrieval-side gate as the main source; we also report the trade-off introduced by the reflective pass. We formulate agentic communication and provide a training-free instantiation. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: HARP: Training-Free Dual-Profile Agentic Communication for LLM-Based Recommendation
translation.abstract: In LLM-based recommendation, memory acts as a user-level agent in a memory-augmented backbone. Yet users and items remain asymmetric: only the user is given a structured profile; it enters a bandwidth-limited reranker prompt; and it is frozen after warmup. We recast LLM-based recommendation as an agentic-communication process in four stages: BUILD a self-description, TRANSMIT it along the collaborative graph, UNDERSTAND the other side, and SYNC it from the next interaction. This formulation reveals three unresolved communication challenges: the item side never produces a comparable self-description (one-sided BUILD); profile-level signals enter only the bandwidth-limited reranker prompt rather than retrieval, where they would not compete for context tokens (prompt-trapped UNDERSTAND); and the user's description is frozen after warmup with no principled update rule (absent SYNC). We instantiate the missing stages as HARP (Homophily-aware Agentic Recommendation via dual Profiles), a training-free, three-operator addition to a frozen LLM backbone: a rule-extracted symmetric item profile (zero extra LLM calls), a channel-decomposable profile-level homophily H(phi_u, phi_i) consumed at retrieval time rather than inside the reranker prompt, and a single-pass reflective update realising in-context profile evolution without any gradient step. On four public benchmarks (Yelp, Books, MovieTV, Goodreads), HARP lifts Hit@1 over the strongest published baseline by 6.9%-24.0%, with family-wise Holm-corrected p < 1e-9 on every dataset. Ablations and a per-case attribution study show that the operators contribute complementary gains, with the retrieval-side gate as the main source; we also report the trade-off introduced by the reflective pass. We formulate agentic communication and provide a training-free instantiation. Code is available at this https URL.

papers.title: Adversarial Speculative Reasoning Improves Long Horizon Agents
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding has been treated purely as a systems optimization that speeds up large language model decoding without changing the model behavior. Under this view, the growing effort to train better draft models has been focused solely on acceptance rate. We argue that this view does not hold true for long-horizon agent reasoning. Measuring frontier open-weight models on complex agentic tasks with different speculative decoding approaches, we found that numerical noise grows within verification windows, and the draft acceptance results of the thinking process can change the output distribution of the model after 30 steps, thus noticeably influencing the reasoning accuracy of long-horizon agents in random directions. In this work, we improve the reasoning capability of target models by controlling such noise. While we cannot change the overall token distribution verified by the target model, we can encode critical reasoning with highest precision by training the draft model to be rejected. We identify these points in agent traces and train the draft model to favor adversarial preference. At inference the trained draft and the target part ways precisely at these decision points, verification restarts, so that critical thinking tokens are sampled from the target model and encoded under its least noisy conditions. This approach makes critical reasoning better indexed and more durable over a long horizon. On complex agentic coding benchmarks, our approach raises end-to-end success rate with no change to the target model or its output distribution. Our results recast the speculative decoding mechanism from a pure accelerator into an active allocator for context precision that improves the accuracy of long-horizon agents by training 0.06% to 0.28% of hosted parameters.

papers.title: Whose Guardrail? User Identity Shapes the Effectiveness of Model Disclaimers in Mitigating LLM Political Persuasion
papers.abstract: Politically biased AI can shift users' opinions, yet it remains unclear whether model disclaimers protect against such persuasion. We report a preregistered experiment (N=1,586) examining how disclaimer design and user characteristics shape susceptibility to politically biased AI. We varied whether disclaimers identified political bias versus potential inaccuracies and whether they included an explanation. Participants completed two decision-making tasks with an LLM biased against their political views, with outcomes assessed immediately and one week later. Disclaimers identifying political bias and including an explanation reduced persuasion, but effects varied across contexts and did not persist. Individual differences were more consistent predictors: Republicans were more persuaded and reported higher trust than Democrats across tasks. Similarly, participants who used AI more frequently were also more persuaded, whereas those with greater self-reported AI knowledge were less persuaded. These findings suggest that generic disclaimers are not enough: effective safeguards must account for user heterogeneity and context.

papers.title: Almost-MMS allocations with small agent redundancy
papers.abstract: For a fixed $\epsilon \ge 0$, let $\rho_{\epsilon, n}$ be the maximum value of $\rho_n$ such that, in every allocation instance with $m$ indivisible goods and $(1 + \epsilon)n$ agents, there is a subset of $n$ agents with the following property. The allocation instance restricted to only this subset of $n$ agents has an allocation that gives each agent at least $\rho_n$-fraction of her $n$-maximin share (MMS). When $\epsilon > 0$ we refer to $\epsilon n$ as the {\em agent redundancy}. The case $\epsilon = 0$ is the standard setting without agent redundancy, and we use $\rho_{0,n}$ and $\rho_n$ interchangeably. For allocation instances with additive valuations, % agents, it is known that $\frac{7}{9} \le \rho_n < 1-\Omega(\frac{1}{\log^2 n})$ for every $n \ge 2$ (with stronger lower bounds for small $n$). It is an open question whether $\rho_n$ tends to~1 as $n$ grows. We show that with agent redundancy, the answer to this question is positive. That is, for every $\epsilon> 0$, $\rho_{\epsilon, n}$ tends to~1 as $n$ grows. A straightforward corollary of this result is that for every $c > 0$, if the number of items satisfies $m \le (2 - c)n$, then the answer is positive also for $\rho_n$ (with no agent redundancy). Adapting our techniques to a related setting, we also improve a recent result of Ezra and Garbuz, and show that without agent redundancy, there always exists an allocation that gives $n - O(\log^2 n)$ agents their full MMS.

papers.title: Aligning Language Models with General Preferences: An Empirical Study of Direct Nash Optimization
papers.abstract: Direct Nash Optimization (DNO) aligns a language model to a general preference function by approximating the Nash equilibrium of a two-player preference game. Its practical variant, DNO-Prct, iterates on-policy sampling, LLM-based rating of the samples together with a teacher's gold response, large-margin preference-pair selection and a DPO-style contrastive update. We re-implement DNO-Prct independently and study it on two open-weight instruct models, Llama 3.1 8B Instruct and Mistral 7B Instruct v0.1, with GPT-4o or a larger open-weight model of the same family as the annotator. On AlpacaEval 2.0 with GPT-4o as judge, three iterations raise the length-controlled (LC) win rate against GPT-4o from 31.7% to 45.3% for Llama and from 6.8% to 18.4% for Mistral, and the tuned 8B model scores above Llama 3.1 70B Instruct on every reported win rate. With same-family open-weight annotators, the runs retain 62% (Llama) and 82% (Mistral) of the LC gain achieved with GPT-4o as annotator, so the rating step does not require a proprietary model. In a separate ablation configuration, variants that remove the gold responses, remove the data look-back, or accept only teacher-preferred pairs score 6 to 10 LC points below the full procedure, whereas varying the number of on-policy samples per prompt (1 to 7) moves the LC win rate by at most 2.1 points, and a margin sweep (1 to 5) run in its own pipeline by at most 2.4 points. We also report the cost of the pipeline and where the practical algorithm departs from the theory it approximates. All results are single runs, and GPT-4o is both the teacher and the evaluation judge; we discuss what this implies for the reported gains.
